# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py). While waiting, the main tab of browser 2 logs in and
passes the ERP's gates. Then the work runs as small jobs on up to ERP_TABS tabs of browser 2 (they share the login):

1. search: one job per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe): search it, save the result list. Nothing else.
2. As soon as a list is saved, the materials on it that fit a requirement (agents/analyze_materials.search_candidates:
   bore, pressure, mounting, certification equal where shown; stroke equal or covering the usable travel) become three
   jobs each, run in parallel: record (all tabs incl. status and lead times), prices (condition records with the
   quantity-scale register open) and stock (storage-location level).
   A material whose record turns out blocked gets no price/stock job (they wait behind the record jobs).

Small jobs finish inside their step budget (one big job per group used to run out of steps before prices and stock),
and no step is spent on materials the list already rules out. results["done.erp"] is set when the queue is empty.

Scheduling: the next job is chosen when a tab gets free, by what it adds to a submit-ready answer (`priority`): first
focused re-reads of something the bid calculation still misses, then prices and stock of materials that already match
a position (they finish that position), then searches and the best candidate record per requirement, then further
candidates; records of candidates for positions that already have a verified active match come last. A tab never
waits for its page's extraction: that runs in the background and queues the follow-up jobs when it is done. After a
material's prices / stock / record were read, the calculator's open dependencies for it (a condition without its price
unit, scales, stock, lead times, carton size, ...) queue one focused re-read naming exactly what is missing.
"""
import os
import asyncio
import itertools

from agents.analyze_materials import extract_erp, merge_materials, search_candidates
from swarm import Phase, register, timeline  # noqa: F401
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_TIME_S = 60    # what the material matcher needs after the last ERP page
# parallel ERP jobs (main tab included). 8 once stalled every sandbox browser at once; A/B on 2026-10-11 (same code):
# 6 tabs 17 ERP jobs / 4 positions priced / 10 failed browses (run_1efbfc7e6d2895e0) vs 4 tabs 12 / 1 / 16
# (run_db181692d8232b97); 4 tabs in run_7a11d3a90d55e1ce: 15 / 3. ERP throughput is the collection bottleneck.
ERP_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_ERP_TABS", "6"))

HINTS = ("Adapt to the observed software; these are possible patterns, not requirements. ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (start page / menu lists transactions for material display, stock "
         "overview, price conditions); system notice or access gate after login (copy displayed number exactly - "
         "read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; slider/robot gate passes with ONE fill_form: "
         "slider = its maximum (e.g. 100), robot checkbox = true, then the number and confirmation checkbox, then_click "
         "continue button); material search help (F4) lists results only for narrow search term; records with several "
         "tabs/registers (basic data, technical data, planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity "
         "scales; stock per plant and per storage location); status codes explained in legend or tooltip; short session "
         "timeout - log in again when login page appears. Save steps: once you see the links of a record's "
         "tabs/registers, read all with ONE read_page(urls=[...]); transactions often take the material number "
         "directly in their entry field.")

FOLLOWUP, FINISH, SEARCH, BEST_RECORD, RECORD, SPECULATIVE, COVERED = 0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6
MAX_FOCUSED = 1          # focused re-reads per (job kind, material) after the first read


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def describe(item: dict) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])


def search_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    term = item["group"] or "the attributes"
    return (f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{describe(item)}\n"
            "1. Log in if needed, open material search (search help of material display transaction).\n"
            f"2. Search {term}; read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}' (all result pages "
            "via next_page_link).\n"
            "3. done, listing the materials of the list with their attributes. Do NOT open records (other agents do).")


def material_goal(job: str, material: str, item: dict, missing: str = "") -> str:
    group = f" (catalogue group {item['group']})" if item.get("group") else ""
    find = (f"Open material {material}{group}: type the number into the transaction's material field, or search "
            f"{item.get('group') or material} in its search help and click the row of {material}.")
    focus = (f"\nA previous read of it did NOT show: {missing}. Find exactly that (other tab/register/record, "
             "header vs. detail view, tooltip) and read_page the page that shows it.") if missing else ""
    if job == "record":
        return (f"{find}\nread_page EVERY tab/register of its record (basic data, technical data, planning/status with "
                f"lead times and status; status legend or tooltip too) with topic 'erp material {material}', in one "
                f"read_page(urls=[...]) when the tabs are links. done with status and lead times.{focus}")
    if job == "prices":
        return (f"Price conditions of material {material}{group}: open the price condition display transaction for "
                f"it, open its quantity-scale register so every scale row shows, read_page with topic 'erp prices "
                f"{material}' (the header with validity, price unit and condition record number must be in the read "
                "too); several condition records (validity periods) -> read each one (next_page_link = exact "
                f"text of link to next record). done with validity periods, price unit and scale prices.{focus}")
    return (f"Stock of material {material}{group}: open the stock overview transaction for it, open storage-location "
            f"level so quantity per location and stock type shows, read_page with topic 'erp stock {material}'. done "
            f"with freely usable quantity per location.{focus}")


async def _items(ctx) -> list[dict]:
    requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
    used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
            for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
    if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
        requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
    items = work_items(requirements)
    await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
    return items


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 16
    hints = HINTS

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        super().__init__(ctx)
        self.jobs: list[tuple[int, tuple]] = []      # (insertion order, job); the next job is chosen when taken
        self.pending = 0                               # queued + running jobs + background extractions
        self.producer_done = False
        self.seen: set = set()
        self.focused: dict[tuple, int] = {}
        self.rank: dict[str, int] = {}                 # material -> its place among its search's candidates
        self._order = itertools.count()
        self.background: set[asyncio.Task] = set()

    # ---- queue ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def add(self, job: tuple, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        key = job[:2] if job[0] != "search" else ("search", job[1]["group"], repr(job[1]["requirements"]))
        if key in self.seen and not force:
            return False
        self.seen.add(key)
        self.pending += 1
        self.jobs.append((next(self._order), job))
        return True

    def matched(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        """material -> positions it currently matches (verified active exact match)."""
        out: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for pos, m in (self.ctx.board.get("materials") or {}).items():
            if m.get("material") and not m.get("unverified"):
                out.setdefault(norm_ref(m["material"]), []).append(pos)
        return out

    def positions_of(self, item: dict) -> list[str]:
        refs = {norm_ref(r.get("ref")) for r in item.get("requirements") or []}
        return [str(p.get("position")) for p in (self.ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []
                if norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref")) in refs]

    def priority(self, job: tuple) -> int:
        """What the job adds to a submit-ready answer (lower first)."""
        kind = job[0]
        if kind == "search":
            return SEARCH
        material, item = job[1], job[2]
        matched = self.matched()
        if len(job) > 3 and job[3]:                    # focused re-read of something the calculation misses
            return FOLLOWUP
        if kind in ("prices", "stock"):
            return FINISH if norm_ref(material) in matched else SPECULATIVE
        positions = self.positions_of(item)
        covered = {p for ps in matched.values() for p in ps}
        if positions and all(p in covered for p in positions):
            return COVERED
        return BEST_RECORD if self.rank.get(norm_ref(material), 0) == 0 else RECORD

    def take(self) -> tuple | None:
        if not self.jobs:
            return None
        best = min(self.jobs, key=lambda j: (self.priority(j[1]), j[0]))
        self.jobs.remove(best)
        return best[1]

    def blocked(self, material: str) -> bool:
        """True if the material's record page (read meanwhile) says it is blocked: its prices and stock are not needed."""
        info = merge_materials(list(self.ctx.shared.get("erp.extracted", {}).values())).get(norm_ref(material)) or {}
        return info.get("is_active") is False

    # ---- jobs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def extract_job(self, out: dict) -> dict:
        evidence = []
        for record in out.get("records") or []:
            data = record.get("data") or {}
            text = data.get("text") or data.get("_observed_text")
            if text:
                evidence.append(Evidence("erp.page", self.site_id,
                    {**data, "text": text, "url": data.get("url") or record.get("source"),
                     "topic": data.get("topic") or record.get("kind", "")}))
        return await extract_erp(self.ctx, evidence=evidence)

    def spawn(self, coro) -> None:
        """Background work that may queue jobs: counted as pending so no worker quits while it runs."""
        self.pending += 1
        task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
        self.background.add(task)
        self.ctx.shared.setdefault("background", set()).add(task)

        def finished(t):
            self.pending -= 1
            self.background.discard(t)
            if not t.cancelled() and t.exception() is not None:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"extraction: {type(t.exception()).__name__}: {t.exception()}")
        task.add_done_callback(finished)

    async def after_search(self, item: dict, out: dict) -> None:
        found = search_candidates(await self.extract_job(out), item)
        self.log.info("search %s: candidates %s", item["group"], found)
        for i, material in enumerate(found):
            self.rank.setdefault(norm_ref(material), i)
            self.add(("record", material, item))

    async def after_material(self, kind: str, material: str, item: dict, out: dict) -> None:
        await self.extract_job(out)
        from agents import analyze_materials
        await analyze_materials.publish(self.ctx)            # the match (and so the priorities) follows at once
        if kind == "record" and not self.blocked(material):
            self.add(("prices", material, item))
            self.add(("stock", material, item))
        self.focus(kind, material, item)

    def missing_for(self, kind: str, material: str) -> str:
        """What the bid calculation still misses from this material's `kind` pages ('' if nothing / not matched)."""
        from agents.compute_bid import build_bid
        try:
            bid = build_bid(self.ctx)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.log.debug("draft for focus failed: %s", error)
            return ""
        dep = (bid.get("dependencies") or {}).get(f"erp {kind} {norm_ref(material)}")
        return dep["need"] if dep else ""

    def focus(self, kind: str, material: str, item: dict) -> None:
        """One focused re-read when the calculation still misses something this kind of page should show."""
        if norm_ref(material) not in self.matched() or self.blocked(material):
            return
        missing = self.missing_for(kind, material)
        key = (kind, norm_ref(material))
        if missing and self.focused.get(key, 0) < MAX_FOCUSED:
            self.focused[key] = self.focused.get(key, 0) + 1
            self.log.info("%s %s still misses: %s -> focused re-read", kind, material, missing[:160])
            timeline.count("erp.focused")
            self.add((kind, material, item, missing), force=True)

    async def do(self, job: tuple, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        extra = ANALYSIS_TIME_S
        if job[0] == "search":
            item = job[1]
            out = await self.browse_until_done(search_goal(item), attempts=2, tab=tab, max_steps=14, stop_extra=extra)
            self.spawn(self.after_search(item, out))
            return
        kind, material, item = job[:3]
        missing = job[3] if len(job) > 3 else ""
        if kind != "record" and self.blocked(material):
            self.log.info("%s %s skipped: material blocked", kind, material)
            return
        out = await self.browse_until_done(material_goal(kind, material, item, missing), attempts=2, tab=tab,
                                           max_steps=16, stop_extra=extra)
        self.spawn(self.after_material(kind, material, item, out))

    async def worker(self, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        """Takes jobs until none is queued and no running job or extraction can add more (or time is up)."""
        try:
            while self.ctx.time_left() > 0:
                if self.ctx.time_left() <= ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                    # too late for a new job now, but the live reserve may shrink again (e.g. the wizard warm-up
                    # finishing): wait instead of quitting (run_e38e6666df284e76 ended collection with time unused)
                    if self.pending <= 0 and self.producer_done and not self.jobs:
                        return
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    continue
                job = self.take()

                                             "yet. done once search form open.", attempts=1, max_steps=12)

                        for item in await _items(self.ctx):
                            self.add(("search", item))
                        if self.ctx.board.get("requirements_final"):
                            return

                for _ in range(ERP_TABS - 1):
                    group.create_task(self.worker(Tab(self.browser)))
            if self.background:                       # the last extractions (time is up for new jobs)
                await asyncio.wait(set(self.background), timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))

"""Reads the mails that matter for this tender, saved as page evidence ("mail.page").

Every message is read once:
1. The main tab logs in while the brief is being read.
2. Index pass (main tab): one search for the exact tender reference alone, in inbox and archive; the model picks the
   messages about this tender from the result lists and reads them all with read_page(urls=[...]). Then
   results["done.mail_core"] (the discount analyst starts).
3. The analyst's extraction says which topics the brief names (authorised senders: discount approval, condition
   rules, technical release, packaging, ...) have no valid message yet. Only those get a topic search, in parallel
   tabs (each logs in: this webmail keeps its login per tab). Messages already saved by another agent are not opened
   again (read_page returns the saved text). Then results["done.mail"].
The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""
import os
import asyncio

from agents.analyze_discount import covered_topics, refresh
from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

TOPIC_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_MAIL_TABS", "2"))   # parallel mail topic tabs; was 3 (sandbox CPU)
MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S = 150   # mail browsing ends this long before collecting does (mail extraction is the slowest)

SEARCH_RULES = (
    "Mailbox search combines words with AND and shows limited hits. Look-alike references (same reference with "
    "suffix) and other tenders do not count; drafts, previews, superseded mails look similar: read each candidate "
    "message. Read selected messages with ONE read_page(urls=[their links], topic '<topic> mail') (read_page also "
    "reads collapsed or locked parts, no need to unlock). Reading pane shows no message text -> use message's own "
    "page link. Skip signing-TAN mails.")

INDEX_JOB = (
    "Search the exact tender reference ALONE (no other word), first inbox then archive. read_page each result "
    "page with topic 'mail index'. On EACH result page, immediately read the matching message links before "
    "moving to another index page or folder; do not spend the entire budget collecting indexes. Prioritize "
    "discount approval and technical release messages from the authorized senders, then other commercial terms. "
    "Use read_page(urls=[observed message links], topic='mail messages'), up to 12 URLs. Return to the observed "
    "index URL to continue pagination. Read all messages for the exact reference, excluding look-alike suffixes, "
    "other tenders and signing TANs. Then done, listing subjects read.\n" + SEARCH_RULES)


@register
class MailScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 24
    hints = ("Adapt to the observed software; these are possible patterns, not requirements. Webmail habits: cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close them, never follow their links); "
             "search may sit behind slider/robot gate: first try ONE fill_form (slider = its maximum, robot checkbox = "
             "true); still locked -> focus the slider and press End, or click its right end; never loop on evaluate; "
             "inbox and archive folder; paged result lists; message headers "
             "(sender, date) in collapsed 'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def browse(self, job: str, **kwargs):
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)
        return await super().browse(job, **kwargs)

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)

    async def login(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.browse("Log in, accept cookie wall, close popups, open inbox. Do NOT search yet. Then done.",
                              max_steps=8)
        except Exception as error:
            self.log.warning("login browse failed: %s", error)

    def topic_jobs(self, facts: dict, covered: set[str]) -> list[str]:
        """One search job per brief topic that has no valid message yet (discount approval first)."""
        senders = dict(facts.get("authorized_senders") or {})
        senders.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("director_sender") or "")
        words = dict(facts.get("topic_words") or {})
        words.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("discount_topic") or "Rabatt")
        missing = [t for t in dict.fromkeys([*senders, *words]) if t not in covered and t != "signing_tan"]
        missing.sort(key=lambda t: t != "discount_approval")
        jobs = []
        for topic in missing:
            word = words.get(topic) or topic.replace("_", " ")
            sender = senders.get(topic)
            jobs.append(f"Find mails on topic '{word}' ({topic.replace('_', ' ')}) for this tender"
                        f"{f' (sender {sender})' if sender else ''}: search '<reference> {word}' in inbox and "
                        f"archive; read every matching message.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\nThen done.")
        return jobs

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts, _ = await asyncio.gather(self.wait_brief(), self.login())
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts
            out = await self.browse_until_done(INDEX_JOB, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            try:        # the index pass's messages decide which topic searches are still needed (no duplicate reads)
                valid = await asyncio.wait_for(refresh(self.ctx), timeout=45)
            except TimeoutError:
                from agents.analyze_discount import publish
                valid = await publish(self.ctx)
            jobs = self.topic_jobs(facts, covered_topics(valid))
            if jobs and self.ctx.time_left() > 120:
                self.log.info("topics without a valid message: %d searches", len(jobs))
                groups = [jobs[i::TOPIC_TABS] for i in range(min(TOPIC_TABS, len(jobs)))]
                main, rest = groups[0], groups[1:]

                async def in_main() -> None:
                    for job in main:
                        await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=16)
                await asyncio.gather(in_main(), self.browse_in_tabs(["\n\n".join(g) for g in rest], attempts=1,
                                                                    max_steps=22))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (one new tab each, closed when its job ends); `self.browse` works
in the browser's main tab.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import timeline
from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S = 75     # scrapers stop browsing this long before collecting ends (analysts need the time)
IDLE_STEPS = 10             # a collection browse that saved pages, then saves nothing for this many steps, ends


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
        if kind.endswith(".page"):
            timeline.mark(f"first {kind}")

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        kwargs.setdefault("idle_steps", IDLE_STEPS)
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=kwargs.pop("author", self.name), **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    def time_for_retry(self, kwargs: dict, need: float = 120) -> bool:
        stop = kwargs["stop_reserve"] if kwargs.get("stop_reserve") is not None else self.ctx.stop_at(self.stop_extra(kwargs))
        return self.ctx.seconds_left() - stop >= need

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit, a crashed browser agent), start again
        with a note on what is already saved, while time allows. Saved pages are never collected twice."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        records = []
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
                timeline.count("browse.retries")
            try:
                out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed connection is one failed attempt, not the end
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"browse attempt {attempt + 1}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
                self.log.warning("browse attempt %d failed: %s", attempt + 1, error)
                out = {"summary": f"failed: {type(error).__name__}", "done": False, "records": [], "steps": 0}
            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
            if self.site_id in rejected:
                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
                out["done"] = False
            if out["done"] or not self.time_for_retry(kwargs):
                break
        return {**out, "records": records}

    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a new tab of this scraper's browser (the tabs share its login cookies). Each tab
        is closed as soon as its job ends, so no tab sits idle. A failed job returns {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
            tab = Tab(self.browser if browser is None else browser)
            try:
                return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
                return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
            finally:
                await tab.close()
        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.required_pass()
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

    async def required_pass(self) -> None:
        for keywords, job in self.required():
            if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=15)


def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)
    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
    if not main.locked():
        async with main:
            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]

async def _browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
                  max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False,
                  stop_reserve: float | None = None, stop_extra: float = 0.0, extra_tools=None,
                  max_actions_per_step: int = 4, flash: bool = True, careful: bool = False,
                  dedupe_reads: bool = True, stop_on_record: str = "", idle_steps: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.

    `tab`: the tab to work in (default: the main tab of `browser`). Screenshots are off by default
    (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page` already reads canvas labels and
    hidden text. `flash`: short replies + compact prompt (see module doc). `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this
    many seconds left (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)` may register more actions. Pages read with a
    `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
    A PopupGuard (swarm/guard.py) clears popups, notices and error pages next to the agent; `careful=True` limits it to
    noise without inputs (the bid submitter). `dedupe_reads`: read_page of a URL another agent already saved returns
    the saved text instead of opening it again (off for mails that change, such as TANs). `idle_steps`: after the
    first saved page/fact, stop once this many steps in a row saved nothing new (the caller resumes).
    """
    records: list[dict] = []
    progress = {"saved_at": None, "idle_stop": False}     # step of the last saved page/fact

    def reserve() -> float:
        """Seconds-left mark at which this browse stops: fixed, or the live submission reserve plus `stop_extra`."""
        if stop_reserve is not None:
            return stop_reserve
        return ctx.stop_at(stop_extra) if ctx is not None and hasattr(ctx, "stop_at") else stop_extra

    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
        records.append(rec)
        progress["saved_at"] = len(step_started)
        if on_record:
            await on_record(rec)

    step_started: list[float] = []
    tools = build_tools(ctx, site_id, author, emit, dedupe_reads=dedupe_reads, stop_on_record=stop_on_record)
    if extra_tools:
        extra_tools(tools)

    tab = await responsive_tab(tab or main_tab(browser))
    await tab.open()
    session = make_session(ctx, tab, vision=bool(use_vision))
    prompt = dict(flash_mode=True, override_system_message=FLASH_SYSTEM.format(max_actions=max_actions_per_step)) \
        if flash else {}
    tips = site_tips(ctx, site_id)
    hints = hints + ("\nTips from other agents on this site:\n- " + "\n- ".join(tips) if tips else "")
    # A tab an agent already worked in is on the site (logged in, past gates): start from its current page instead of
    # browser-use opening the site's start URL from the goal again.
    reused = tab.used and bool(browsers.cdp_urls())
    tab.used = True
    browsing_llm = make_llm(flash)
    browsing_llm._usage_ctx = ctx
    agent = Agent(task=goal + ("\n\nThis tab is already on the site: start from the current page." if reused else ""),
                  llm=browsing_llm, browser_session=session, tools=tools, use_vision=use_vision,
                  use_judge=False, generate_gif=False, max_failures=6, max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step,
                  llm_timeout=min(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, BROWSE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S if flash else SUBMIT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S) + 2,
                  step_timeout=120, directly_open_url=not reused,
                  extend_system_message=SYSTEM_EXTRA + (f"\n{hints}" if hints else ""), **prompt)
    guard = PopupGuard(ctx, author, careful=careful,
                       fill=lambda pairs, then_click, item_id: fill_page(session, pairs, "", then_click, item_id))
    evaluate = lambda js, *a: _evaluate(session, js, *a)  # noqa: E731
    guard_task: asyncio.Task | None = None

    async def before_step(_agent) -> None:
        nonlocal guard_task
        if ctx.seconds_left() <= reserve():
            agent.stop()
            return
        with timeline.span("guard", "sweep"):
            try:                    # the page the model is about to see: cleared first
                await asyncio.wait_for(guard.sweep(evaluate), 25)
            except Exception as error:
                log.debug("guard before step failed: %s", error)
        if guard_task is None:  # from now on also between steps (popups that appear while the model thinks)
            guard_task = asyncio.create_task(guard.loop(evaluate))
        step_started.append(timeline.now())

    secrets = [str((s.get("credentials") or {}).get("password") or "") for s in (ctx.task.get("access") or [])] \
        if ctx is not None else []

Input-token cuts are in, but I haven't run them yet. Imports load, and the repo's tests couldn't run because `pytest` isn't installed. The local run and the sandbox test run are still to do.

**Per-step cuts** (`swarm/browser_agent.py`). Each browse step resends its context, so this is where most of the saving is:
- `max_history_items=8` (env `SWARM_HISTORY_ITEMS`) keeps only the last 8 steps in context. Before, all of them were kept.
- `max_clickable_elements_length=20000` (env `SWARM_DOM_CHARS`) caps page elements at 20k characters. The browser-use default is 40k, which is about 10k tokens a step.
- `include_attributes` drops validation attributes (`pattern`, `minlength`, `aria-valuenow` and similar) from the page elements the model sees.
- `FLASH_SYSTEM` and `SYSTEM_EXTRA` are rewritten in compressed style. Every rule is kept, including the JSON output contract, the one-action-key rule, and the traps list.

**Compressed prompts:**
- The ERP, mail, spec and tender scrapers have shorter hints and job goals.
- ERP search, record, prices and stock goals are shorter, and so are the mail index and topic jobs.
- The coordinator, popup guard, form pilot and extraction system prompts are shorter.
- `brief_intro` is cut from 1500 to 900 characters. It is prepended to every browse job.

I kept all identifiers, topic labels, tool names, step order and trap warnings word for word. Those are the parts that steer the agent, and the topic labels have to match what other code looks for. Only filler, articles and repeated phrasing went.

**Risks to check:**
- The 20k element cap could hide controls on long ERP result lists. If steps start failing to find a row, raise `SWARM_DOM_CHARS` to 30000.
- `brief_intro` at 900 characters could cut off key brief facts. I haven't checked whether the brief's intro section is longer than that.

**Not touched:** the analyst, `compute_bid` and `submit_bid` prompts. The submitter runs in full-reasoning mode and a wrong decision there costs more than tokens.

Next step is a local run with `scripts/local-run.ps1`, comparing prompt tokens and step counts against the last run in `.swarm/runs/`. Want me to do that? It needs `atira models proxy` running in another terminal.

entries.name: Monitor
entries.description:
Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.

Pick by how many notifications you need:
- **One** ("tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q "Ready in" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.
- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** ("tell me every time an ERROR line appears") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).
- **One per occurrence, until a known end** ("emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.

Your script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.

  # Each matching log line is an event
  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered "ERROR"

  # Each file change is an event
  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir

  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment
  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  while true; do
    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
    gh api "repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last" --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login): \(.body)"'
    last=$now; sleep 30
  done

  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)
  node watch-for-events.js

  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes
  prev=""
  while true; do
    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)
    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!="pending") | "\(.name): \(.bucket)"' <<<"$s" | sort)
    comm -13 <(echo "$prev") <(echo "$cur")
    prev=$cur
    jq -e 'all(.bucket!="pending")' <<<"$s" >/dev/null && break
    sleep 30
  done

**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For "tell me when X is ready," use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.

**Script quality:**
- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.
- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.
- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.
- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification ("errors in deploy.log" not "watching logs").
- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)

**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to "still running." Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.

  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit
  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered "elapsed_steps="

  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on
  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM"

For poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.

**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means "the lines you'd act on," not "only good news." Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.

Stdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.

The script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 30 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.
**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.

  Monitor({
    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},
    description: 'deploy events',
  })

Each text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.

Prefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 1800000ms are capped to 1800000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

228	        """Sites whose first pass and analysis are done (gaps can be judged). The mail counts once its index pass
229	        was analysed for MAIL_EARLY_S: key-specific gaps (a packaging tariff, a pool fee) need not wait for the
230	        generic topic searches."""
231	        out = {role for role, keys in READY.items() if all(self.ctx.board.get(k) is not None for k in keys)}
232	        if self.ctx.board.get("done.mail_core") is not None and self.ctx.board.get("mail") is not None:
233	            self.mail_core_at = self.mail_core_at if self.mail_core_at is not None else self.ctx.elapsed()
234	            if self.ctx.elapsed() - self.mail_core_at >= MAIL_EARLY_S:
235	                out.add("mail")
236	        return out
237	
238	    def settled(self) -> set[str]:
239	        """Ready sites, plus sites whose analysis has not finished SETTLE_S after the first pass (it failed)."""
240	        now = self.ctx.elapsed()
241	        for role, (done_key, _) in READY.items():
242	            if self.ctx.board.get(done_key) is not None:
243	                self.first_pass_end.setdefault(role, now)
244	        return self.ready() | {r for r, t in self.first_pass_end.items() if now - t > SETTLE_S}
245	
246	    def saved_topics(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
247	        return {role: sorted({str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in pages(self.ctx, role)} - {""})
248	                for role in READY}
249	
250	    async def plan(self, gaps: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
251	        board = self.ctx.board
252	        summaries = {k: str(v)[:600] for k, v in board.results.items() if k.endswith(".summary")}
253	        prompt = {"tender_reference": (board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference"),
254	                  "scenario_date": (board.get("brief") or {}).get("scenario_date"),
255	                  "gaps": gaps, "sites": {r: SITES[r] for r in {g["role"] for g in gaps}},
256	                  "saved_topics": self.saved_topics(), "first_pass_summaries": summaries,
257	                  "observed_pages": [{"source": e.source or e.data.get("url"), "text": e.data.get("text", "")[:1800]}
258	                                     for role in {g["role"] for g in gaps} for e in pages(self.ctx, role)[-3:]],
259	                  "earlier_followups": self.history[-8:], "site_tips": board.get("tips") or {}}
260	        reply = await self.ctx.llm.ask_json(SYSTEM, json.dumps(prompt, ensure_ascii=False, default=str), think=True)
261	        jobs, per_role = [], {}
262	        known = {g["id"]: g for g in gaps}
263	        for j in (reply or {}).get("jobs") or []:
264	            role = j.get("role")
265	            ids = [i for i in j.get("gaps") or [] if i in known and known[i]["role"] == role]
266	            if role not in READY or not ids or not str(j.get("job") or "").strip():
267	                continue
268	            if per_role.get(role, 0) >= MAX_JOBS_PER_ROLE or len(jobs) >= MAX_JOBS:
269	                continue
270	            per_role[role] = per_role.get(role, 0) + 1
271	            jobs.append({"role": role, "gaps": ids, "job": str(j["job"]).strip()})
272	        skipped = []
273	        for item in (reply or {}).get("skipped") or []:
274	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("id") not in known:
275	                continue
276	            gid = item["id"]
277	            if gid == "tender positions" or gid.startswith("spec requirement "):
278	                continue
279	            quote = " ".join(str(item.get("quote") or "").split())
280	            if len(quote) >= 12 and any(
281	                item.get("source") == (e.source or e.data.get("url"))
282	                and quote in " ".join(str(e.data.get("text") or "").split())
283	                for e in pages(self.ctx, known[gid]["role"])
284	            ):
285	                skipped.append(gid)

287	            self.log.info("gaps skipped by the model: %s", skipped)
288	        self.tried |= set(skipped)

291	    async def work(self, job: dict) -> None:
292	        try:
293	            with timeline.span("followup", f"{job['role']} {','.join(job['gaps'])[:60]}"):
294	                out = await run_job(self.ctx, job["role"], job["job"], max_steps=JOB_STEPS, stop_extra=ANALYSIS_S)
295	            self.history.append({"role": job["role"], "gaps": job["gaps"], "done": out.get("done"),
296	                                 "summary": str(out.get("summary"))[:300]})
297	            self.log.info("follow-up %s %s done=%s: %s", job["role"], job["gaps"], out.get("done"),
298	                          str(out.get("summary"))[:200])
299	        except Exception as error:
300	            self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"follow-up {job['gaps']}: {error}")
301	            self.tried.difference_update(job["gaps"])
302	        if not locals().get("out", {}).get("done"):
303	            self.tried.difference_update(job["gaps"])

307	        try:

309	                ready = self.settled()

311	                    gaps = [g for g in find_gaps(self.ctx.board, ready, self.saved_topics()) if g["id"] not in self.tried and self.attempts.get(g["id"], 0) < 2]
312	                    # a site with follow-ups running still takes new, different gaps while it has a free slot
313	                    busy = {r: list(self.running.values()).count(r) for r in set(self.running.values())}
314	                    gaps = [g for g in gaps if busy.get(g["role"], 0) < MAX_RUNNING_PER_ROLE]
315	                    offer = frozenset(g["id"] for g in gaps)
316	                    if gaps and offer == self.last_offer and self.ctx.elapsed() - self.last_plan_at < REPLAN_S:
317	                        gaps = []                 # the same gaps were just planned (model skipped them): not again yet
318	                    if gaps:
319	                        self.last_offer, self.last_plan_at = offer, self.ctx.elapsed()
320	                        self.log.info("gaps: %s", [g["id"] for g in gaps])
321	                        try:
322	                            jobs = await self.plan(gaps)
323	                        except Exception as error:
324	                            self.log.warning("planning failed: %s", error)
325	                            jobs = []
326	                        for job in jobs:
327	                            if busy.get(job["role"], 0) >= MAX_RUNNING_PER_ROLE:
328	                                continue                  # its gaps stay open for the next round
329	                            busy[job["role"]] = busy.get(job["role"], 0) + 1
330	                            for gid in job["gaps"]:
331	                                self.attempts[gid] = self.attempts.get(gid, 0) + 1
332	                            self.tried.update(job["gaps"])
333	                            task = asyncio.create_task(self.work(job))
334	                            self.running[task] = job["role"]
335	                            task.add_done_callback(lambda t: self.running.pop(t, None))
336	                all_done = self.settled() == set(READY)
337	                if self.running:
338	                    await asyncio.wait(list(self.running), timeout=5)
339	                    continue
340	                pending = [g for g in find_gaps(self.ctx.board, ready, self.saved_topics())
341	                           if g["id"] not in self.tried and self.attempts.get(g["id"], 0) < 2]
342	                if (all_done and not pending) or self.ctx.time_left() <= ROUND_MIN_S:
343	                    gaps = find_gaps(self.ctx.board, set(READY), self.saved_topics())
344	                    await self.ctx.board.set("gaps", gaps)
345	                    self.log.info("collect complete; open gaps: %s", [g["id"] for g in gaps])
346	                    return
347	                await asyncio.sleep(5)
348	        finally:
349	            tasks = list(self.running)
350	            for task in tasks:
351	                task.cancel()
352	            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

"""Quick decisions with the hosted Clef model: cheap, fast, calibrated. Use it for the many small judgements
(what kind of page is this, which of these links, is this the right document) and keep Qwen for reading and
reasoning. Each call still adds its simulated cost, but at a fraction of a chat call.

    kind, p = await decide.choose({"page": text}, "What is this page?", PAGE_KINDS)
    p_yes   = await decide.yes({"mail": subject}, "Is this mail about tender REF exactly?")

The API (POST $CLEF_BASE_URL/v1/decide) takes a `state` (text or JSON), up to 4 images as base64 data URLs and
named questions: "choice" (criteria: {option: description}), "noul" (probability of yes) and "score"
(criteria: a list of 2-10 levels, lowest first). Set "clef" in agent.json "models" so a run waits for it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import base64
import logging
import os

import httpx

from swarm.bidmath import plain

log = logging.getLogger("decide")

MAX_IMAGES = 4
_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(12)        # the team may run 16 Clef calls at once, across all its runs
usage = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0}
_transport = None                   # tests swap in an httpx.MockTransport

# what a page can be, for agents that need to know where they are before acting
PAGE_KINDS = {
    "login": "a sign-in form asking for username and password",
    "consent": "a cookie or consent wall that must be accepted before the content",
    "error": "an error or 'service unavailable' page that offers a retry",
    "locked": "content blocked behind a robot check, slider or other unlock step",
    "list": "a list, table or search results to pick an entry from",
    "document": "a document, record, message or form with the actual content",
    "other": "anything else",
}


class ClefError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def data_url(png: bytes, mime: str = "image/png") -> str:
    return f"data:{mime};base64,{base64.b64encode(png).decode()}"


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[bytes] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict:
    """One Clef call with several named questions; returns the `answers` object."""
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = [data_url(i) if isinstance(i, (bytes, bytearray)) else i for i in images[:MAX_IMAGES]]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"}
    last = None
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        try:
            async with _sem, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=180, transport=_transport) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            if response.status_code == 400:      # our question is malformed: retrying will not help
                raise ClefError(response.text[:300])
            response.raise_for_status()
            reply = response.json()
            usage["calls"] += 1
            usage["input_tokens"] += (reply.get("usage") or {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            return reply["answers"]
        except ClefError:
            raise
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeouts, 5xx, a model waking up
            last = error
            await asyncio.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
    raise ClefError(f"Clef unavailable: {type(last).__name__}: {last}")


async def choose(state, instructions: str, options: dict[str, str],
                 images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """Pick one of `options` ({key: description}); returns (key, confidence)."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "choice", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": options}},
                           images)
    q = answers["q"]
    return q["choice"], float(q.get("confidence", q.get("probabilities", {}).get(q["choice"], 0)))


async def yes(state, question: str, images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
    """Probability (0-1) that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}}, images)
    return float(answers["q"]["noul"])


async def score(state, instructions: str, levels: list[str], images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
    """A rating on `levels` (lowest first), as a float index into them."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "score", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": levels}},
                           images)
    return float(answers["q"]["score"])


async def page_kind(page, with_screenshot: bool = False, chars: int = 2500) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """What kind of page a Playwright page shows (see PAGE_KINDS), from its text and optionally a screenshot."""
    text = plain(await page.evaluate("() => (document.querySelector('main') || document.body).innerText"))[:chars]
    shots = [await page.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=60)] if with_screenshot else None
    state = {"url": page.url, "title": plain(await page.title()), "text": text}
    return await choose(state, "What kind of page is the browser showing?", PAGE_KINDS,
                        [data_url(s, "image/jpeg") for s in shots] if shots else None)

Both sandbox test runs are started and monitored in the background. Neither has finished yet, so I have no results to compare.

| Run | Test run id | Run id | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | `reh_b81fd39601ed7057` | `run_16e9349f1a6d9991` | Compressed prompts and hints, plus the browse step limits (history 8, DOM 20k chars, fewer attributes) |
| B | `reh_1ee732ce7f300a45` | `run_7e6af99aa4b25d5d` | Everything in A, plus more context for the coordinator's planning model |

Run B's extra context is in `agents/coordinate.py`. The planner now also gets:
- **`brief_rules`:** the brief after its intro, capped at 3500 characters.
- **`position_status`:** per position, the requirement, the matched material or the reason there is none, and anything unverified.
- **`running_now`:** the follow-up jobs in progress, so it doesn't repeat them.
- **`time_left_s`:** the seconds left in the run.

Its system prompt now tells it to order jobs by whether they block a position's price. It should also change approach after a follow-up that came back `done=false`.

The log of each run is saved in `.swarm/runs/<id>-log.md`, and both are listed in `.swarm/runs/INDEX.md`. When each run ends I'll compare prompt tokens, steps, time to the first bid and the score.

I only gave the extra context to the coordinator. I left the brief reader, the site-role resolver and the analyst extraction as they were.

Runs A and B were started 1–2 minutes apart, so they share the same sandbox capacity and public dataset. That makes the comparison fair. Any difference between them will still be noisy, because each run's browser timing varies.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Save a run's full log locally as Markdown, so it can be read and searched without waiting for the platform.

  Writes .swarm/runs/<run>-log.md (whole log, replaced on every pull) and adds a line to .swarm/runs/<run>.md (notes:
  status, scores and MCP results go there). .swarm/ is git-ignored and never packaged: run logs hold scenario
  values, which must never get into the package.

.EXAMPLE
  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc            # once (run ended or a snapshot)
  .\scripts\pull-run.ps1 run_415bcaed321664dc -Follow    # keep writing until the run ends

  From Git Bash / a Claude Code Monitor:
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/pull-run.ps1 <run> -Follow
#>
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$RunId,
    [switch]$Follow
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)
$dir = ".swarm/runs"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
$notes = "$dir/$RunId.md"
$logFile = "$dir/$RunId-log.md"
$now = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm 'UTC'")

# cmd merges stderr (atira writes progress there) without PowerShell 5.1 turning each line into an error record
$status = (cmd /c "atira status 2>&1" | Select-String -SimpleMatch $RunId | Select-Object -First 1)
$status = if ($status) { $status.Line.Trim() } else { "(not in atira status)" }

content.text:
Neither run was stuck on the review screen. Both got there too late and ran out of time before the TAN came back. Each also lost 3–4 minutes to a different failure. The logs are saved in `.swarm/runs/reh_b81fd39601ed7057-log.md` and `reh_1ee732ce7f300a45-log.md`. The A log is the full pull, not the truncated stream.

**Timeline (seconds from run start, 1200 s total)**

| Event | A (`b81f…`) | B (`1ee7…`) |
|---|---|---|
| Submit phase start | 611 | 564 |
| Review page ("Pruefen und signieren") checked | 1085 | 920 |
| TAN requested | 1096 (104 s left) | 1159 (40 s left) |
| End | submitter timed out, 0 receipt | submitter timed out, 0 receipt |

The collection phase ended at about 565–610 s, which left roughly 590 s for the wizard and signing. The wizard alone takes about 360 s of steps at about 12 s each, plus the TAN round trip. There was no slack for any failure.

**Run A: the submitter's browser hung, then the TAN mailbox stayed locked**
1. The submitter's first three steps got no reply from 01:23:27 to 01:24:47. The log says "Browser state capture timed out after 30s", and the tab was closed as hung. Browser 0 then stopped answering with `RemoteProtocolError`. About 213 s were lost, and the wizard restarted from login at 01:25:23 on a different browser.
2. The TAN was requested with 104 s left. The `BidSubmitter.tan` agent opened the webmail and found "Keine Nachrichten gefunden" behind a slider gate. Its slider "shows value=50 but status still 'Gesperrt'", so the drag to max didn't unlock it. It never saw the TAN mail. A browser-state timeout then hit the submitter again, and the run ended.

**Run B: the wizard overwrote position 01.01, and fixing it cost about 4 minutes**
1. The wizard's step headers are unreliable. The agent's own notes say "header mislabeled 'Position 01.01'". At Schritt 6 it filled 01.03's data into the step that already held 01.01.
2. The review page (step 27) showed 01.01 as `HZ-2170/16/…`, a duplicate of 01.03. The agent then went back through Schritt 9, 8 and 7 to Schritt 6, one click per step. It refixed 01.01 and re-entered the later steps, which took until 01:31:08. That is about 230 s.
3. The TAN was requested at 01:31:24, 40 s before the end, and the submitter timed out at 01:31:25.

**Common cause:** the 540 s signing reserve is too small for this wizard whenever one thing goes wrong. Run B would have finished at about 800 s without the overwrite. Run A would have finished at about 880 s without the hang.

**Possible link to my changes (unconfirmed):** my `max_history_items=8` setting applies to the submitter too. The submitter runs in full-reasoning mode and relies on its history to know which position went into which wizard step. That may have contributed to B's overwrite. Run A's hang and mailbox gate look unrelated to my changes.

**Fixes I'd make, in order of value:**
1. Set no history limit for the submitter (`flash=False`), keeping 8 only for the scrapers. This is a one-line change.
2. Start the TAN agent's mail unlock earlier, while the wizard is still being filled. Today it only starts at the review page, when the request is already late.
3. Give the wizard a position-to-step check as the agent goes: read the product name and config on each step before filling.
4. Raise the signing reserve above 540 s, or end collection earlier. The runs reached "first usable bid" at about 500–590 s, so there is little to lose.

Want me to apply fix 1, then 2, and start another test run?

1	# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: submitter   NEEDS: results["bid"], results["brief"]   WRITES: enters the bid on the tender portal, signs
2	"""Enters the computed bid in the tender portal's submission wizard and signs it with the TAN from the webmail.
3	
4	The model drives the wizard (browser 0) from the brief's submission instructions and a table of the values to enter;
5	`fill_form` sets many fields per step. When the wizard asks for the signing TAN the model calls `get_signing_tan`,
6	which runs a short browse on the mail browser (3) to read the newest TAN mail. Runs even if earlier phases failed:
7	then every position without data is omitted ("partial submission"), the bid is still signed.
8	
9	Time savers (the submission reserve shrinks with them, see swarm.context.submit_reserve):
10	- WizardPrep: near the end of collection the tender portal's main tab logs in and opens the bid wizard (entering
11	  nothing), so the submitter starts at the wizard's first step.
12	- At submit start the mail browser's main tab logs in and opens the inbox, so the TAN lookup only opens the newest mail.
13	- check_entries compares the summary page with the values to enter in code (one step instead of re-reading pages).
14	"""
15	import os
16	import time
17	from decimal import Decimal
18	from swarm.normalize import de_number, norm_ref
19	import asyncio
20	
21	from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
22	
23	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register, timeline
24	from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
25	from swarm.browser_agent import ActionResult, browse, read_current_page, BrowserSession
26	from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S
27	from swarm.extract import brief_section
28	from swarm.sites import site_for
29	
30	PREP_LEAD_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_PREP_LEAD_S", 150))   # warm the wizard up this long before collection ends
31	
32	
33	class CheckParams(BaseModel):
34	    note: str = Field(default="", description="optional: which page/step this is (e.g. summary)")
35	
36	
37	def expected_values(bid: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
38	    """What the portal's summary should show, per position (material, quantity, unit price) and for the bid."""
39	    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
40	    out: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
41	    lines = {l["position"]: l for l in bid.get("lines") or []}
42	    for e in answer.get("positions") or []:
43	        disp = (lines.get(e["position"]) or {}).get("display") or {}
44	        out[e["position"]] = [str(e["material_number"]), str(e["quantity"]),
45	                              disp.get("unit_price") or de_number(Decimal(str(e["unit_price"])))]
46	    if answer.get("positions"):
47	        out["total"] = [bid.get("total_display") or de_number(Decimal(str(answer.get("total_net") or 0)))]
48	    return out
49	
50	
51	def check_page(text: str, expected: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[str]:
52	    """Expected values not found on the page (numbers compared without spaces; case-insensitive)."""
53	    flat = norm_ref(text)
54	    return [f"{where}: {value}" for where, values in expected.items() for value in values
55	            if value and norm_ref(value) not in flat]
56	
57	
58	class TanParams(BaseModel):
59	    new_request: bool = Field(default=False, description="True only after explicitly requesting a replacement TAN in the portal")
60	    requested_at: str = Field(default="", description="when you requested the TAN (as shown), if known")
61	
62	
63	class ReceiptParams(BaseModel):
64	    quote: str = Field(description="Exact text on the current portal page confirming the bid was submitted, not saved as draft")
65	    reference: str = Field(description="Tender reference for this receipt")
66	
67	
68	def bid_table(bid: dict, tender: dict) -> str:
69	    lines = []
70	    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
71	    by_pos = {e["position"]: e for e in answer.get("positions") or []}
72	    for line in bid.get("lines") or []:
73	        pos = line["position"]
74	        if pos not in by_pos:
75	            lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: OMIT this position (use the omit/skip option for it).")
76	            continue
77	        e, disp = by_pos[pos], line.get("display") or {}
78	        req = {k: v for k, v in (line.get("configuration") or {}).items() if v} or line.get("required") or {}
79	        extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {disp[k]}" for k, label in (("base_unit_price", "base price per piece before discount"),
80	                                                                  ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharges per piece"),
81	                                                                  ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"),
82	                                                                  ("rebate_total", "project bonus for the whole position"))
83	                          if k in disp)
84	        lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: configuration bore {req.get('bore')}, stroke {req.get('stroke')}, mounting "
85	                     f"{req.get('mounting')}, certification {req.get('certification')} -> material {e['material_number']}; "
86	                     f"quantity {e['quantity']} pieces; net unit price {disp.get('unit_price')} EUR; lead time "
87	                     f"{e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks; breakdown (optional fields): {extra or 'leave empty'}")
88	    known = {line["position"] for line in bid.get("lines") or []}
89	    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
90	        if str(p.get("position")) not in known:
91	            lines.append(f"- Position {p.get('position')}: OMIT this position.")
92	    return "\n".join(lines) or "- (no position data: omit every position the form shows)"

94	
95	@register
96	class BidSubmitter(Agent):
97	    phase = Phase.SUBMIT
98	    browser = 0
99	
100	    async def run(self) -> None:
101	        ctx = self.ctx
102	        if ctx.task.get("submission", {}).get("kind") == "api":
103	            return
104	        bid = ctx.board.get("bid") or ctx.board.get("bid_draft") or {"answer": {"decision": "bid", "positions": []},
105	                                                                      "lines": []}
106	        facts = ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
107	        if bid.get("validation_errors"):
108	            self.log.warning("Bid validation issues require repair in the wizard: %s", bid["validation_errors"])
109	        answer = bid["answer"]

111	        mail_site = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get("mail")
112	        site = ctx.site(tender_site)
113	        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
114	        contact = ctx.board.get("mailbox") or ""
115	        started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC", time.gmtime())
116	        decision = answer.get("decision", "bid")
117	        goal = (
118	            f"Site (tender portal): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}\n\n"
119	            f"SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS FROM BRIEF:\n{brief_section(ctx.brief, 'Submission', 'Abgabe') or ctx.brief[-2500:]}\n\n"
120	            f"YOUR JOB: submit exactly ONE signed bid for tender {answer.get('tender_reference') or facts.get('tender_reference')}.\n"
121	            f"Bidder company: {facts.get('bidder_company')}; VAT id (USt-IdNr.): {facts.get('bidder_vat_id')}"
122	            f"{'; contact e-mail: ' + contact if contact else ''}.\n"
123	            f"Decision: {'main offer (bid)' if decision == 'bid' else 'no bid (declaration of non-participation)'}.\n"
124	            f"Discount percent: {de_number(Decimal(str(answer.get('discount_percent') or 0)))}. Net total: {bid.get('total_display', '0,00')} EUR "
125	            f"(enter numbers in German format exactly as given).\n"
126	            f"POSITIONS (form may ask in different order: always read which position it shows):\n"
127	            f"{bid_table(bid, ctx.board.get('tender') or {})}\n\n"
128	            "How to work: log in, accept cookies, open tender, register interest if needed, open bid submission. Close "
129	            "survey popups with their x button. Each step saves only with its continue/next button; going back clears "
130	            "later steps -> get each step right before continuing. fill_form sets many fields of a step in one action: "
131	            "per position ONE fill_form with all configuration fields in order and apply_button = the button applying "
132	            "the selection (it is pressed between dependent selects for you; do not set them one per step), then ONE "
133	            "fill_form for material, quantity, prices, lead time with then_click = the continue button. Never use "
134	            "buttons that add extra positions: every tender position has its own wizard step. Unsure -> check step result with "
135	            "read_page (selects may default to wrong option). Fill actual editable controls only. Read-only outputs and "
136	            "group labels are not checkboxes. If a form reports invalid format, inspect the entered number format first. "

138	            "not ask for (e.g. own terms). Form wants signing TAN -> request it in portal, call get_signing_tan, enter "
139	            "returned TAN right away (TAN valid few minutes; new request invalidates old one). Review summary, confirm "

144	            "On the summary/review page call check_entries once (it compares the page with the values above); fix "
145	            "what it reports missing before confirming; no need to read_page the summary yourself.")
146	        prepared = ctx.shared.get("wizard_ready")
147	        if prepared:
148	            goal += (f"\n\nPREPARED: this tab is already logged in and in the bid wizard for this tender (nothing entered "
149	                     f"yet). What the preparation saw: {str(prepared)[:400]}")

151	        tan_task = None
152	        warm_mail = asyncio.create_task(self.warm_mailbox(mail_site))
153	        expected = expected_values(bid)

155	        def tan_tool(tools):
156	            @tools.action("Check the current page (bid summary) against the values to enter; lists what is missing.",
157	                          param_model=CheckParams)
