-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

tools.name: PowerShell
tools.description:
Executes a given PowerShell command with optional timeout. Working directory persists between commands; shell state (variables, functions) does not.

IMPORTANT: This tool is for terminal operations via PowerShell: git, npm, docker, and PS cmdlets. DO NOT use it for file operations (reading, writing, editing, searching, finding files) - use the specialized tools for this instead.

PowerShell edition: Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe)
   - Pipeline chain operators `&&` and `||` are NOT available — they cause a parser error. To run B only if A succeeds: `A; if ($?) { B }`. To chain unconditionally: `A; B`.
   - Ternary (`?:`), null-coalescing (`??`), and null-conditional (`?.`) operators are NOT available. Use `if/else` and explicit `$null -eq` checks instead.
   - Avoid `2>&1` on native executables. In 5.1, redirecting a native command's stderr inside PowerShell wraps each line in an ErrorRecord (NativeCommandError) and sets `$?` to `$false` even when the exe returned exit code 0. stderr is already captured for you — don't redirect it.
   - `>`, `>>`, and `Out-File` usually default to UTF-8 (with BOM) in this environment, but `Set-Content`/`Add-Content` still default to the system ANSI codepage — when writing a file other tools will read, pass `-Encoding utf8` explicitly to `Out-File`/`Set-Content`.
   - `ConvertFrom-Json` returns a PSCustomObject, not a hashtable. `-AsHashtable` is not available.

Before executing the command, please follow these steps:

1. Directory Verification:
   - If the command will create new directories or files, first use `Get-ChildItem` (or `ls`) to verify the parent directory exists and is the correct location

2. Command Execution:
   - Always quote file paths that contain spaces with double quotes
   - Capture the output of the command.

PowerShell Syntax Notes:
   - Variables use $ prefix: $myVar = "value"
   - Escape character is backtick (`), not backslash
   - Use Verb-Noun cmdlet naming: Get-ChildItem, Set-Location, New-Item, Remove-Item
   - Common aliases: ls (Get-ChildItem), cd (Set-Location), cat (Get-Content), rm (Remove-Item)
   - Pipe operator | works similarly to bash but passes objects, not text
   - Use Select-Object, Where-Object, ForEach-Object for filtering and transformation
   - String interpolation: "Hello $name" or "Hello $($obj.Property)"
   - Registry access uses PSDrive prefixes: `HKLM:\SOFTWARE\...`, `HKCU:\...` — NOT raw `HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\...`
   - Environment variables: read with `$env:NAME`, set with `$env:NAME = "value"` (NOT `Set-Variable` or bash `export`)
   - Call native exe with spaces in path via call operator: `& "C:\Program Files\App\app.exe" arg1 arg2`

Unix commands that DO NOT exist in PowerShell — use the equivalent instead:
   - head / tail → `Get-Content file -TotalCount N` / `-Tail N`; piped: `| Select-Object -First N` / `-Last N`
   - which → `(Get-Command name).Source`
   - touch → `if (-not (Test-Path path)) { New-Item -ItemType File path }` (NEVER use `New-Item -Force` on a file — it truncates existing content)
   - wc -l → `(Get-Content file | Measure-Object -Line).Lines`
   - mkdir -p → `New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force path` (`-p` is not a PowerShell flag)
   - rm -rf → `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force path`
   - ln -s → `New-Item -ItemType SymbolicLink -Path link -Target target`
   - chmod / chown → not applicable on Windows; use `icacls` only if ACL changes are required
   - 2>/dev/null → `2>$null` (but stderr is captured for you — usually unnecessary)
   - VAR=x cmd → `$env:VAR = 'x'; cmd` (PowerShell has no inline env-var prefix)
   - Bash control flow (`if [ -f x ]`, `for x in *`, backtick ``cmd`` substitution) is a parser error — use `if (Test-Path x)`, `foreach ($x in ...)`, `$(cmd)`

Exit-code note: `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue` suppresses error OUTPUT but the cmdlet failure still causes this tool to report exit 1. To make a cmdlet failure truly non-fatal, promote it to terminating and swallow it: `try { Cmdlet ... -ErrorAction Stop } catch {}` (without `-ErrorAction Stop`, non-terminating errors skip the `catch` and still exit 1).

Interactive and blocking commands (this tool runs with -NonInteractive and stdin attached to the null device — console prompts read EOF or error immediately; GUI prompts can still block until timeout):
   - NEVER use `Read-Host`, `Get-Credential`, `Out-GridView`, `$Host.UI.PromptForChoice`, or `pause`
   - Destructive cmdlets (`Remove-Item`, `Stop-Process`, `Clear-Content`, etc.) may prompt for confirmation. Add `-Confirm:$false` when you intend the action to proceed. Use `-Force` for read-only/hidden items.
   - Never use `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`, or other commands that open an interactive editor

Passing multiline strings (commit messages, file content) to native executables:
   - Use a single-quoted here-string so PowerShell does not expand `$` or backticks inside. The closing `'@` MUST be at column 0 (no leading whitespace) on its own line — indenting it is a parse error:
<example>
git commit -m @'
Commit message here.
Second line with $literal dollar signs.
'@
</example>
   - Use `@'...'@` (single-quoted, literal) not `@"..."@` (double-quoted, interpolated) unless you need variable expansion
   - For arguments containing `-`, `@`, or other characters PowerShell parses as operators, use the stop-parsing token: `git log --% --format=%H`

Usage notes:
  - The command argument is required.
  - You can specify an optional timeout in milliseconds (up to 600000ms / 10 minutes for a foreground command). If not specified, commands will timeout after 120000ms (2 minutes).
  - It is very helpful if you write a clear, concise description of what this command does.
  - If the output exceeds 30000 characters, output will be truncated before being returned to you.
  - You can use the `run_in_background` parameter to run the command in the background. Only use this if you don't need the result immediately and are OK being notified when the command completes later. You do not need to check the output right away - you'll be notified when it finishes.
  - Avoid using PowerShell to run commands that have dedicated tools, unless explicitly instructed:
    - File search: Use Glob (NOT Get-ChildItem -Recurse)
    - Content search: Use Grep (NOT Select-String)
    - Read files: Use Read (NOT Get-Content)
    - Edit files: Use Edit
    - Write files: Use Write (NOT Set-Content/Out-File)
    - Communication: Output text directly (NOT Write-Output/Write-Host)
  - When issuing multiple commands:
    - If the commands are independent and can run in parallel, make multiple PowerShell tool calls in a single message.
    - If the commands depend on each other and must run sequentially, chain them in a single PowerShell call (see edition-specific chaining syntax above).
    - Use `;` only when you need to run commands sequentially but don't care if earlier commands fail.
    - DO NOT use newlines to separate commands (newlines are ok in quoted strings and here-strings)
  - Do NOT prefix commands with `cd` or `Set-Location` -- the working directory is already set to the correct project directory automatically.
  - Avoid unnecessary `Start-Sleep` commands:
    - Do not sleep between commands that can run immediately — just run them.
    - If your command is long running and you would like to be notified when it finishes — simply run your command using `run_in_background`. There is no need to sleep in this case.
    - Do not retry failing commands in a sleep loop — diagnose the root cause or consider an alternative approach.
    - If waiting for a background task you started with `run_in_background`, you will be notified when it completes — do not poll.
    - If you must poll an external process, use a check command rather than sleeping first.
    - If you must sleep, keep the duration short to avoid blocking the user.
  - For git commands:
    - Prefer to create a new commit rather than amending an existing commit.
    - Before running destructive operations (e.g., git reset --hard, git push --force, git checkout --), consider whether there is a safer alternative that achieves the same goal. Only use destructive operations when they are truly the best approach.
    - Never skip hooks (--no-verify) or bypass signing (--no-gpg-sign, -c commit.gpgsign=false) unless the user has explicitly asked for it. If a hook fails, investigate and fix the underlying issue.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: SendFeedback
tools.description:
Use this tool to draft feedback about Claude Code when you hit a high-signal moment. That includes both PRODUCT issues and MODEL-BEHAVIOR issues:
- a reproducible tool or product failure was just resolved or abandoned
- the user clearly expressed frustration with Claude Code or with how you handled the task
- you hit a missing capability that blocked a reasonable request
- you notice, or the user points out, that your own behavior in this session went wrong, for example: you gave a confident answer then had to retract it; you stopped short and handed work back when you could have finished; you declined or disputed a reasonable request; you spawned more subagents than the task warranted; your tone was off; you asked more clarifying questions than needed; you expanded scope beyond what was asked

The draft is QUEUED LOCALLY. It is never sent without the user's explicit approval, and calling this tool renders no UI and does not interrupt the conversation, so never announce it or ask the user about it mid-task.

Write `details` as short labeled bullets in this exact order, one to three lines each, no narrative paragraphs:
- **What happened:** the observed behavior vs. what was expected, with exact error text if short. Facts only.
- **What the user said:** the user's own words that prompted this, quoted. If nothing did, write "User didn't comment; observed by the model." Never paraphrase sentiment into a stronger claim.
- **Repro:** the minimal steps or shape that reproduces it.
- **Evidence:** identifiers a reader can chase, such as request IDs, timestamps, file paths, versions. Omit the bullet if there are none.

Constraints:
- Never fabricate or exaggerate user sentiment; report only what actually happened.
- Everything in the draft must be sourced from the user or the session, never inferred: leave unknown fields blank rather than guess, and add a final **Cause:** bullet only for a root cause you verified in-session.
- Use `area` to name the part of Claude Code the feedback is about (a feature, command, or workflow, e.g. "hooks config", "/help", "file editing") when there is a clear one; leave it blank otherwise.
- Use `failure_mode` ONLY when the report is about model behavior (how Claude responded), not a product bug. Pick the single closest value, or `other` when it is a model-behavior issue that fits no listed value; omit the field only when the report is a product/tool bug with no model-behavior component.
- Use `task_category` to name what kind of task the session was doing, or `other` when it is a clear task that fits no listed value. Omit only if genuinely unclear.
- Do not include secrets or credentials. Refer to people by role ("a teammate", "the PR reviewer"), never by name, email address, or chat/user ID. This applies inside quoted user words too: replace a name or handle with a bracketed role (e.g. "[a teammate]") and keep the rest verbatim. Do not include customer-facing channel or DM IDs, or excerpts of customer content. Session, request, and run IDs, timestamps, repo/PR numbers, and file paths (written relative to the working directory, or ~-prefixed, not absolute paths under the user's home) remain the right evidence.
- If the issue looks like a security vulnerability: describe the class of problem, never a working exploit or step-by-step extraction path.
- Draft only at the natural moments listed above, and at most one draft per distinct issue; never re-draft the same issue in a session.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

lastPrompt: We have two models avaliable in the sandbox: Qwen and Clef. Analyze where each model is more suitable in the current agentic setup. Where each model can be used better. Make changes to use according m…

content.content:
1	"""Quick decisions with the hosted Clef model: cheap, fast, calibrated. Use it for the many small judgements
2	(what kind of page is this, which of these links, is this the right document) and keep Qwen for reading and
3	reasoning. Each call still adds its simulated cost, but at a fraction of a chat call.
4	
5	    kind, p = await decide.choose({"page": text}, "What is this page?", PAGE_KINDS)
6	    p_yes   = await decide.yes({"mail": subject}, "Is this mail about tender REF exactly?")
7	
8	The API (POST $CLEF_BASE_URL/v1/decide) takes a `state` (text or JSON), up to 4 images as base64 data URLs and
9	named questions: "choice" (criteria: {option: description}), "noul" (probability of yes) and "score"
10	(criteria: a list of 2-10 levels, lowest first). Set "clef" in agent.json "models" so a run waits for it.
11	"""
12	from __future__ import annotations
13	
14	import asyncio
15	import base64
16	import logging
17	import os
18	
19	import httpx
20	
21	from swarm.bidmath import plain
22	
23	log = logging.getLogger("decide")
24	
25	MAX_IMAGES = 4
26	_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(12)        # the team may run 16 Clef calls at once, across all its runs
27	usage = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0}
28	_transport = None                   # tests swap in an httpx.MockTransport
29	
30	# what a page can be, for agents that need to know where they are before acting
31	PAGE_KINDS = {
32	    "login": "a sign-in form asking for username and password",
33	    "consent": "a cookie or consent wall that must be accepted before the content",
34	    "error": "an error or 'service unavailable' page that offers a retry",
35	    "locked": "content blocked behind a robot check, slider or other unlock step",
36	    "list": "a list, table or search results to pick an entry from",
37	    "document": "a document, record, message or form with the actual content",
38	    "other": "anything else",
39	}
40	
41	
42	class ClefError(RuntimeError):
43	    pass
44	
45	
46	def data_url(png: bytes, mime: str = "image/png") -> str:
47	    return f"data:{mime};base64,{base64.b64encode(png).decode()}"
48	
49	
50	async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[bytes] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict:
51	    """One Clef call with several named questions; returns the `answers` object."""
52	    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
53	    if images:
54	        body["images"] = [data_url(i) if isinstance(i, (bytes, bytearray)) else i for i in images[:MAX_IMAGES]]
55	    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
56	    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"}
57	    last = None
58	    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
59	        try:
60	            async with _sem, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=180, transport=_transport) as client:
61	                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
62	            if response.status_code == 400:      # our question is malformed: retrying will not help
63	                raise ClefError(response.text[:300])
64	            response.raise_for_status()
65	            reply = response.json()
66	            usage["calls"] += 1
67	            usage["input_tokens"] += (reply.get("usage") or {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
68	            return reply["answers"]
69	        except ClefError:
70	            raise
71	        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeouts, 5xx, a model waking up
72	            last = error
73	            await asyncio.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
74	    raise ClefError(f"Clef unavailable: {type(last).__name__}: {last}")
75	
76	
77	async def choose(state, instructions: str, options: dict[str, str],
78	                 images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float]:
79	    """Pick one of `options` ({key: description}); returns (key, confidence)."""
80	    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "choice", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": options}},
81	                           images)
82	    q = answers["q"]
83	    return q["choice"], float(q.get("confidence", q.get("probabilities", {}).get(q["choice"], 0)))
84	
85	
86	async def yes(state, question: str, images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
87	    """Probability (0-1) that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
88	    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}}, images)
89	    return float(answers["q"]["noul"])
90	
91	
92	async def score(state, instructions: str, levels: list[str], images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
93	    """A rating on `levels` (lowest first), as a float index into them."""
94	    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "score", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": levels}},
95	                           images)
96	    return float(answers["q"]["score"])
97	
98	
99	async def page_kind(page, with_screenshot: bool = False, chars: int = 2500) -> tuple[str, float]:
100	    """What kind of page a Playwright page shows (see PAGE_KINDS), from its text and optionally a screenshot."""

"""Quick decisions with the hosted Clef model: cheap, fast, calibrated. Use it for the many small judgements
(what kind of page is this, which of these links, is this the right document) and keep Qwen for reading and
reasoning. Each call still adds its simulated cost, but at a fraction of a chat call.

    kind, p = await decide.choose({"page": text}, "What is this page?", PAGE_KINDS)
    p_yes   = await decide.yes({"mail": subject}, "Is this mail about tender REF exactly?")

The API (POST $CLEF_BASE_URL/v1/decide) takes a `state` (text or JSON), up to 4 images as base64 data URLs and
named questions: "choice" (criteria: {option: description}), "noul" (probability of yes) and "score"
(criteria: a list of 2-10 levels, lowest first). Set "clef" in agent.json "models" so a run waits for it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import base64
import logging
import os

import httpx

from swarm.bidmath import plain

log = logging.getLogger("decide")

MAX_IMAGES = 4
_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(12)        # the team may run 16 Clef calls at once, across all its runs
usage = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0}
_transport = None                   # tests swap in an httpx.MockTransport

# what a page can be, for agents that need to know where they are before acting
PAGE_KINDS = {
    "login": "a sign-in form asking for username and password",
    "consent": "a cookie or consent wall that must be accepted before the content",
    "error": "an error or 'service unavailable' page that offers a retry",
    "locked": "content blocked behind a robot check, slider or other unlock step",
    "list": "a list, table or search results to pick an entry from",
    "document": "a document, record, message or form with the actual content",
    "other": "anything else",
}


class ClefError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def data_url(png: bytes, mime: str = "image/png") -> str:
    return f"data:{mime};base64,{base64.b64encode(png).decode()}"


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[bytes] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict:
    """One Clef call with several named questions; returns the `answers` object."""
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = [data_url(i) if isinstance(i, (bytes, bytearray)) else i for i in images[:MAX_IMAGES]]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"}
    last = None
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        try:
            async with _sem, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=180, transport=_transport) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            if response.status_code == 400:      # our question is malformed: retrying will not help
                raise ClefError(response.text[:300])
            response.raise_for_status()
            reply = response.json()
            usage["calls"] += 1
            usage["input_tokens"] += (reply.get("usage") or {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            return reply["answers"]
        except ClefError:
            raise
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeouts, 5xx, a model waking up
            last = error
            await asyncio.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
    raise ClefError(f"Clef unavailable: {type(last).__name__}: {last}")


async def choose(state, instructions: str, options: dict[str, str],
                 images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """Pick one of `options` ({key: description}); returns (key, confidence)."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "choice", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": options}},
                           images)
    q = answers["q"]
    return q["choice"], float(q.get("confidence", q.get("probabilities", {}).get(q["choice"], 0)))


async def yes(state, question: str, images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
    """Probability (0-1) that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}}, images)
    return float(answers["q"]["noul"])


async def score(state, instructions: str, levels: list[str], images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
    """A rating on `levels` (lowest first), as a float index into them."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "score", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": levels}},
                           images)
    return float(answers["q"]["score"])


async def page_kind(page, with_screenshot: bool = False, chars: int = 2500) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """What kind of page a Playwright page shows (see PAGE_KINDS), from its text and optionally a screenshot."""
    text = plain(await page.evaluate("() => (document.querySelector('main') || document.body).innerText"))[:chars]
    shots = [await page.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=60)] if with_screenshot else None
    state = {"url": page.url, "title": plain(await page.title()), "text": text}
    return await choose(state, "What kind of page is the browser showing?", PAGE_KINDS,
                        [data_url(s, "image/jpeg") for s in shots] if shots else None)

"""Which website plays which role. Site ids and names differ between datasets, so the model maps them from the brief
once per run; the result is cached on the board as results["sites"] = {role: siteId}."""
import logging

log = logging.getLogger("sites")

ROLES = {
    "tender": "public procurement / tender portal: the tender, its bill of quantities, bidder Q&A, bid submission",
    "spec": "the buyer's supplier/customer portal holding the technical specification (Lastenheft) and its revisions",
    "erp": "our own ERP: materials, stock, lead times, price conditions",
    "mail": "our webmail / sales inbox: approvals, internal release mails, signing TANs",
}


async def resolve_roles(ctx) -> dict:
    """Map capabilities at runtime; incomplete mappings are retried, observed contradictions can be corrected."""
    async with ctx.lock("sites"):
        invalid = ctx.shared.setdefault("site_invalidations", {})
        known = {r: v for r, v in (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).items() if v not in invalid.get(r, set())}
        if all(role in known for role in ROLES):
            return known
        sites = [{"siteId": s.get("siteId"), "url": s.get("url")} for s in ctx.task.get("access", [])]
        mapping = dict(known)
        observations = ctx.shared.setdefault("site_observations", {})
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                out = await ctx.llm.ask_json(
                    "Map roles to siteId using the brief and observations. Reply {tender: siteId, spec: siteId, "
                    "erp: siteId, mail: siteId, inspect: [siteId]}. Omit uncertain mappings and select up to two "
                    "sites to inspect when names are opaque. Multiple capabilities may share a site.",
                    f"Roles: {ROLES}\nSites: {sites}\nCurrent mapping: {mapping}\nObservations: {observations}\nRejected role/site pairs: {invalid}\nBrief:\n{ctx.brief}")
                mapping.update({r: v for r, v in (out or {}).items() if r in ROLES and v in ctx.site_ids and v not in invalid.get(r, set())})
                await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
                if all(role in mapping for role in ROLES):
                    break
                inspect = [v for v in (out or {}).get("inspect", []) if v in ctx.site_ids and v not in observations][:2]
                if inspect and getattr(ctx, "pool", None):
                    from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
                    for site_id in inspect:
                        site = ctx.site(site_id)
                        tab = Tab(ctx.site_ids.index(site_id) % 4)
                        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
                        try:
                            result = await browse(ctx, f"Inspect this workspace to identify its business capabilities: {site['url']}. "
                                                  f"Login if necessary using {creds}. Read its headings and menus. "
                                                  "Report what information it holds; do not submit anything.",
                                                  tab=tab, site_id=site_id, max_steps=5, author="SiteOrientation")
                            observations[site_id] = result["summary"][:2500]
                        finally:
                            await tab.close()
            except Exception as error:
                log.warning("role mapping attempt failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
        await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
        log.info("site roles: %s", mapping)
        return mapping


async def site_for(ctx, role: str) -> str:
    known = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get(role)
    if known in ctx.site_ids and known not in ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(role, set()):
        return known
    mapping = await resolve_roles(ctx)
    if role not in mapping:
        raise KeyError(f"no website found for role {role!r}: {mapping}")
    return mapping[role]

"""Model access for agents: concurrency-limited, usage-counted, JSON-friendly. Qwen by default (hosted, free)."""
import asyncio
import json
import re
import os
import httpx

CALL_TIMEOUT_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S", "55"))
HTTP_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, connect=8, write=15, pool=8)

import models
from openai import APIConnectionError, APIStatusError
from swarm import timeline

# Model slots (team limit: 32 concurrent Qwen calls). Browsing steps take a slot of the total; analysis, planning and
# guard calls also take one of the analysis slots, so extraction can never starve the browsing agents.
MAX_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_LLM_CONCURRENCY", "16"))
ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_ANALYSIS_CONCURRENCY", "0")) or max(1, MAX_CONCURRENT // 2)


def parse_json(text: str):
    """The first JSON object/array in a model reply (tolerates ``` fences and chatter)."""
    text = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?|```$", "", text.strip(), flags=re.M).strip()
    for opener, closer in (("{", "}"), ("[", "]")):
        start, end = text.find(opener), text.rfind(closer)
        if start != -1 and end > start:
            try:
                return json.loads(text[start:end + 1])
            except ValueError:
                continue
    raise ValueError(f"no JSON in model reply: {text[:200]}")


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, max_concurrent: int = MAX_CONCURRENT, analysis_concurrent: int | None = None):
        self._sem = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)   # team limit is 32 concurrent Qwen calls
        self._analysis_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(analysis_concurrent or
                                               (ANALYSIS_CONCURRENT if max_concurrent == MAX_CONCURRENT
                                                else max(1, max_concurrent // 2)))
        self._client = None
        self.calls = 0
        self.tokens = {"prompt": 0, "completion": 0}

    @property
    def client(self):
        self._client = self._client or models.qwen().with_options(timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT, max_retries=0)
        return self._client

    async def chat(self, messages: list[dict], *, tools: list[dict] | None = None, model: str = models.QWEN_MODEL,
                   think: bool = False, **kwargs):
        """One chat completion; returns the message (`.content`, `.tool_calls`). `think=True` lets Qwen run its
        separate reasoning pass (slower, more tokens): use it for judgement calls, not for plain extraction."""
        args = dict(model=model, messages=messages, **kwargs)
        args.setdefault("temperature", 0)
        if not think and model == models.QWEN_MODEL:
            args["extra_body"] = {**(args.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
        if tools:
            args["tools"] = tools
        queued = timeline.now()
        async with self._analysis_sem, self._sem:
            timeline.add("model.queue", "analysis", queued)
            # Bound each attempt, including providers that leave a connection open without replying.
            for attempt in range(2):
                started = timeline.now()
                try:
                    async with asyncio.timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT_S):
                        reply = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**args)
                    timeline.add("model.call", "think" if think else "chat", started)
                    break
                except (TimeoutError, models.httpx.TransportError, APIConnectionError) as error:
                    timeline.add("recovery", f"model {type(error).__name__}", started)
                    timeline.count("model.failed")
                    if attempt:
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                except APIStatusError as error:
                    timeline.add("recovery", f"model HTTP {error.status_code}", started)
                    timeline.count("model.failed")
                    if attempt or (error.status_code < 500 and error.status_code != 429):
                        raise
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        self.calls += 1
        if reply.usage:
            self.tokens["prompt"] += reply.usage.prompt_tokens or 0
            self.tokens["completion"] += reply.usage.completion_tokens or 0
        return reply.choices[0].message

    async def ask(self, system: str, user: str, **kwargs) -> str:
        message = await self.chat([{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}], **kwargs)
        return message.content or ""

    async def ask_json(self, system: str, user: str, retries: int = 1, **kwargs):
        """Ask for JSON; re-ask once with the parse error if the reply is not valid."""
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]
        kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})    # Qwen then always answers with JSON
        for _ in range(retries + 1):
            reply = (await self.chat(messages, **kwargs)).content or ""
            try:
                return parse_json(reply)
            except ValueError as error:
                messages += [{"role": "assistant", "content": reply},
                             {"role": "user", "content": f"Invalid: {error}. Reply with valid JSON only."}]
        raise ValueError("model did not return valid JSON")

"""The free hosted models in short: one call each. Docs: $API/start#models and $API/docs/run-contract.md#llm-calls

Qwen (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next): an OpenAI-compatible chat model with tool calls, images and a 256k context. Every run gets
QWEN_BASE_URL and QWEN_API_KEY; on your machine `atira scout --env` points them at `atira models proxy`, which you
keep running in another terminal.

Clef (Cloudflare Clef): a decision model. POST $CLEF_BASE_URL/v1/decide with a `state`, up to 4 `images` and your
`questions`: "choice" picks one of your options, "noul" gives the probability of yes, "score" rates on your scale.
CLEF_BASE_URL and CLEF_API_KEY are set only where the platform hosts Clef. A run waits only for the models listed in
agent.json "models" to warm up: list ["qwen", "clef"] if your agent relies on Clef.

Any other provider works with your own key, through the run's metering proxy: see the docs above.
"""
import base64
import os

import httpx  # comes with the OpenAI SDK
from openai import AsyncOpenAI

QWEN_MODEL = "qwen3.8-flash-next"
NO_THINKING = {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}   # extra_body: skip Qwen's separate reasoning pass


def qwen() -> AsyncOpenAI:
    """A client for the hosted Qwen; a cold model takes a while to answer its first call, hence the long timeout."""
    return AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"], timeout=360)


async def ask_qwen(prompt: str) -> str:
    """One chat call: the reply's text."""
    reply = await qwen().chat.completions.create(model=QWEN_MODEL, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}])
    return reply.choices[0].message.content or ""


async def read_image(prompt: str, png: bytes) -> str:
    """Ask Qwen about an image: the reply's text.

    The sites paint some values into a <canvas> instead of the DOM - the ERP's Empfangsnummer, for one - so they
    cannot be read as text. The number differs on the private dataset, so it has to be read at run time.
    """
    data_url = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png).decode()
    reply = await qwen().chat.completions.create(model=QWEN_MODEL, messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": [{"type": "text", "text": prompt},
                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": data_url}}],
    }])
    return reply.choices[0].message.content or ""


async def ask_clef(state, question: str) -> float:
    """One decision: how likely Clef finds the answer to a yes/no question about `state` (text or JSON) is yes."""
    body = {"state": state, "questions": {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}}}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=120) as client:
        response = await client.post(os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide", json=body,
                                     headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"})
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["answers"]["q"]["noul"]

TAN_WORD = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])TAN(?![A-Za-z])")


def requests_tan(item: dict | None) -> bool:
    """Is this control a TAN-request button? A model sometimes presses it as a plain "click"; the TAN must
    still be fetched. "TAN" as a whole word is the convention for signing codes on German business portals."""
    if not item or item.get("tag") not in ("button", "a", "input"):
        return False
    if item.get("type") in ("text", "password", "email", "number", "tel"):
        return False                       # the TAN input field itself is not a request
    return bool(TAN_WORD.search(" ".join(str(item.get(k) or "") for k in ("text", "label", "value"))))


async def confirmed(page_text: str) -> bool:
    """Does the page confirm a binding submission (a receipt / confirmation)? Clef, with a cautious fallback."""
    try:
        from swarm import decide
        return await decide.yes({"page": page_text[:2000]},
                                "Does this page confirm that the bid/offer was submitted bindingly "
                                "(a receipt or confirmation, not a form, error or review page)?") >= 0.6
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - Clef down: trust the click, the run is nearly over anyway
        log.warning("could not check the confirmation: %s", error)
        return True


def _compact(snap: dict) -> str:
    """The page as the model reads it: short, without empty keys."""
    items = [{k: v for k, v in it.items() if v not in (None, "", False, [])} for it in snap["items"]]
    return json.dumps({"url": snap["url"], "title": snap["title"], "text": snap["text"], "controls": items},
                      ensure_ascii=False)


async def _do(page, action: dict) -> str:
    """Carry out one action; return a short report for the model."""
    sel = f'[data-pilot="{int(action["id"])}"]'
    loc = page.locator(sel)
    kind = action.get("do")
    if kind == "fill":
        await loc.fill(str(action.get("value", "")), timeout=5000)
        return f"filled #{action['id']}"

28	from swarm.sites import site_for
29	
30	PREP_LEAD_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_PREP_LEAD_S", 150))   # warm the wizard up this long before collection ends
31	
32	
33	class CheckParams(BaseModel):
34	    note: str = Field(default="", description="optional: which page/step this is (e.g. summary)")
35	
36	
37	def expected_values(bid: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
38	    """What the portal's summary should show, per position (material, quantity, unit price) and for the bid."""
39	    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
40	    out: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
41	    lines = {l["position"]: l for l in bid.get("lines") or []}
42	    for e in answer.get("positions") or []:
43	        disp = (lines.get(e["position"]) or {}).get("display") or {}
44	        out[e["position"]] = [str(e["material_number"]), str(e["quantity"]),
45	                              disp.get("unit_price") or de_number(Decimal(str(e["unit_price"])))]
46	    if answer.get("positions"):
47	        out["total"] = [bid.get("total_display") or de_number(Decimal(str(answer.get("total_net") or 0)))]
48	    return out
49	
50	
51	def check_page(text: str, expected: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[str]:
52	    """Expected values not found on the page (numbers compared without spaces; case-insensitive)."""
53	    flat = norm_ref(text)
54	    return [f"{where}: {value}" for where, values in expected.items() for value in values
55	            if value and norm_ref(value) not in flat]
56	
57	
58	class TanParams(BaseModel):
59	    new_request: bool = Field(default=False, description="True only after explicitly requesting a replacement TAN in the portal")
60	    requested_at: str = Field(default="", description="when you requested the TAN (as shown), if known")
61	
62	
63	class ReceiptParams(BaseModel):
64	    quote: str = Field(description="Exact text on the current portal page confirming the bid was submitted, not saved as draft")
65	    reference: str = Field(description="Tender reference for this receipt")
66	
67	
68	def bid_table(bid: dict, tender: dict) -> str:
69	    lines = []
70	    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
71	    short_texts = {str(p.get("position")): str(p.get("short_text") or "").strip()
72	                   for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []}
73	    by_pos = {e["position"]: e for e in answer.get("positions") or []}
74	    for line in bid.get("lines") or []:
75	        pos = line["position"]
76	        if pos not in by_pos:
77	            lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: OMIT this position (use the omit/skip option for it).")
78	            continue
79	        e, disp = by_pos[pos], line.get("display") or {}
80	        req = {k: v for k, v in (line.get("configuration") or {}).items() if v} or line.get("required") or {}
81	        extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {disp[k]}" for k, label in (("base_unit_price", "base price per piece before discount"),
82	                                                                  ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharges per piece"),
83	                                                                  ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"),
84	                                                                  ("rebate_total", "project bonus for the whole position"))
85	                          if k in disp)
86	        text = short_texts.get(pos)
87	        lines.append(f"- Position {pos}{f' ({text})' if text else ''}: configuration bore {req.get('bore')}, stroke {req.get('stroke')}, mounting "
88	                     f"{req.get('mounting')}, certification {req.get('certification')} -> material {e['material_number']}; "
89	                     f"quantity {e['quantity']} pieces; net unit price {disp.get('unit_price')} EUR; lead time "
90	                     f"{e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks; breakdown (optional fields): {extra or 'leave empty'}")
91	    known = {line["position"] for line in bid.get("lines") or []}
92	    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
93	        if str(p.get("position")) not in known:
94	            lines.append(f"- Position {p.get('position')}: OMIT this position.")
95	    return "\n".join(lines) or "- (no position data: omit every position the form shows)"
96

99	class BidSubmitter(Agent):
100	    phase = Phase.SUBMIT
101	    browser = 0
102	
103	    async def run(self) -> None:
104	        ctx = self.ctx
105	        if ctx.task.get("submission", {}).get("kind") == "api":
106	            return
107	        bid = ctx.board.get("bid") or ctx.board.get("bid_draft") or {"answer": {"decision": "bid", "positions": []},
108	                                                                      "lines": []}
109	        facts = ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
110	        if bid.get("validation_errors"):
111	            self.log.warning("Bid validation issues require repair in the wizard: %s", bid["validation_errors"])
112	        answer = bid["answer"]
113	        tender_site = await site_for(ctx, "tender")
114	        mail_site = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get("mail")
115	        site = ctx.site(tender_site)
116	        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
117	        contact = ctx.board.get("mailbox") or ""
118	        started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC", time.gmtime())
119	        decision = answer.get("decision", "bid")
120	        goal = (
121	            f"Site (tender portal): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}\n\n"
122	            f"SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS FROM BRIEF:\n{brief_section(ctx.brief, 'Submission', 'Abgabe') or ctx.brief[-2500:]}\n\n"
123	            f"YOUR JOB: submit exactly ONE signed bid for tender {answer.get('tender_reference') or facts.get('tender_reference')}.\n"
124	            f"Bidder company: {facts.get('bidder_company')}; VAT id (USt-IdNr.): {facts.get('bidder_vat_id')}"
125	            f"{'; contact e-mail: ' + contact if contact else ''}.\n"
126	            f"Decision: {'main offer (bid)' if decision == 'bid' else 'no bid (declaration of non-participation)'}.\n"
127	            f"Discount percent: {de_number(Decimal(str(answer.get('discount_percent') or 0)))}. Net total: {bid.get('total_display', '0,00')} EUR "
128	            f"(enter numbers in German format exactly as given).\n"
129	            f"POSITIONS (form may ask in different order; step headers may name the wrong position: identify each "
130	            f"position step by its product text and position number together, and keep a list 'wizard step -> "
131	            f"position' in memory. A step already holding another position's values is that position: never "
132	            f"overwrite it with different data):\n"
133	            f"{bid_table(bid, ctx.board.get('tender') or {})}\n\n"
134	            "How to work: log in, accept cookies, open tender, register interest if needed, open bid submission. Close "
135	            "survey popups with their x button. Each step saves only with its continue/next button; going back clears "
136	            "later steps -> get each step right before continuing. fill_form sets many fields of a step in one action: "
137	            "per position ONE fill_form with all configuration fields in order and apply_button = the button applying "
138	            "the selection (it is pressed between dependent selects for you; do not set them one per step), then ONE "
139	            "fill_form for material, quantity, prices, lead time with then_click = the continue button. Never use "
140	            "buttons that add extra positions: every tender position has its own wizard step. Unsure -> check step result with "
141	            "read_page (selects may default to wrong option). Fill actual editable controls only. Read-only outputs and "

from swarm.browser_agent import ActionResult, browse, read_current_page, BrowserSession
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S
from swarm.extract import brief_section
from swarm.sites import site_for

PREP_LEAD_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_PREP_LEAD_S", 150))   # warm the wizard up this long before collection ends


class CheckParams(BaseModel):
    note: str = Field(default="", description="optional: which page/step this is (e.g. summary)")


def expected_values(bid: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """What the portal's summary should show, per position (material, quantity, unit price) and for the bid."""
    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
    out: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    lines = {l["position"]: l for l in bid.get("lines") or []}
    for e in answer.get("positions") or []:
        disp = (lines.get(e["position"]) or {}).get("display") or {}
        out[e["position"]] = [str(e["material_number"]), str(e["quantity"]),
                              disp.get("unit_price") or de_number(Decimal(str(e["unit_price"])))]
    if answer.get("positions"):
        out["total"] = [bid.get("total_display") or de_number(Decimal(str(answer.get("total_net") or 0)))]
    return out


def check_page(text: str, expected: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[str]:
    """Expected values not found on the page (numbers compared without spaces; case-insensitive)."""
    flat = norm_ref(text)
    return [f"{where}: {value}" for where, values in expected.items() for value in values
            if value and norm_ref(value) not in flat]


class TanParams(BaseModel):
    new_request: bool = Field(default=False, description="True only after explicitly requesting a replacement TAN in the portal")
    requested_at: str = Field(default="", description="when you requested the TAN (as shown), if known")


class ReceiptParams(BaseModel):
    quote: str = Field(description="Exact text on the current portal page confirming the bid was submitted, not saved as draft")
    reference: str = Field(description="Tender reference for this receipt")


def bid_table(bid: dict, tender: dict) -> str:
    lines = []
    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
    short_texts = {str(p.get("position")): str(p.get("short_text") or "").strip()
                   for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []}
    by_pos = {e["position"]: e for e in answer.get("positions") or []}
    for line in bid.get("lines") or []:
        pos = line["position"]
        if pos not in by_pos:
            lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: OMIT this position (use the omit/skip option for it).")
            continue
        e, disp = by_pos[pos], line.get("display") or {}
        req = {k: v for k, v in (line.get("configuration") or {}).items() if v} or line.get("required") or {}
        extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {disp[k]}" for k, label in (("base_unit_price", "base price per piece before discount"),
                                                                  ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharges per piece"),
                                                                  ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"),
                                                                  ("rebate_total", "project bonus for the whole position"))
                          if k in disp)
        text = short_texts.get(pos)
        lines.append(f"- Position {pos}{f' ({text})' if text else ''}: configuration bore {req.get('bore')}, stroke {req.get('stroke')}, mounting "
                     f"{req.get('mounting')}, certification {req.get('certification')} -> material {e['material_number']}; "
                     f"quantity {e['quantity']} pieces; net unit price {disp.get('unit_price')} EUR; lead time "
                     f"{e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks; breakdown (optional fields): {extra or 'leave empty'}")
    known = {line["position"] for line in bid.get("lines") or []}
    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
        if str(p.get("position")) not in known:
            lines.append(f"- Position {p.get('position')}: OMIT this position.")
    return "\n".join(lines) or "- (no position data: omit every position the form shows)"


@register
class BidSubmitter(Agent):
    phase = Phase.SUBMIT
    browser = 0

    async def run(self) -> None:
        ctx = self.ctx
        if ctx.task.get("submission", {}).get("kind") == "api":
            return
        bid = ctx.board.get("bid") or ctx.board.get("bid_draft") or {"answer": {"decision": "bid", "positions": []},
                                                                      "lines": []}
        facts = ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        if bid.get("validation_errors"):
            self.log.warning("Bid validation issues require repair in the wizard: %s", bid["validation_errors"])
        answer = bid["answer"]
        tender_site = await site_for(ctx, "tender")
        mail_site = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get("mail")
        site = ctx.site(tender_site)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        contact = ctx.board.get("mailbox") or ""
        started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC", time.gmtime())
        decision = answer.get("decision", "bid")
        goal = (
            f"Site (tender portal): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}\n\n"
            f"SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS FROM BRIEF:\n{brief_section(ctx.brief, 'Submission', 'Abgabe') or ctx.brief[-2500:]}\n\n"
            f"YOUR JOB: submit exactly ONE signed bid for tender {answer.get('tender_reference') or facts.get('tender_reference')}.\n"
            f"Bidder company: {facts.get('bidder_company')}; VAT id (USt-IdNr.): {facts.get('bidder_vat_id')}"
            f"{'; contact e-mail: ' + contact if contact else ''}.\n"
            f"Decision: {'main offer (bid)' if decision == 'bid' else 'no bid (declaration of non-participation)'}.\n"
            f"Discount percent: {de_number(Decimal(str(answer.get('discount_percent') or 0)))}. Net total: {bid.get('total_display', '0,00')} EUR "
            f"(enter numbers in German format exactly as given).\n"
            f"POSITIONS (form may ask in different order; step headers may name the wrong position: identify each "
            f"position step by its product text and position number together, and keep a list 'wizard step -> "
            f"position' in memory. A step already holding another position's values is that position: never "
            f"overwrite it with different data):\n"
            f"{bid_table(bid, ctx.board.get('tender') or {})}\n\n"
            "How to work: log in, accept cookies, open tender, register interest if needed, open bid submission. Close "
            "survey popups with their x button. Each step saves only with its continue/next button; going back clears "
            "later steps -> get each step right before continuing. fill_form sets many fields of a step in one action: "
            "per position ONE fill_form with all configuration fields in order and apply_button = the button applying "
            "the selection (it is pressed between dependent selects for you; do not set them one per step), then ONE "
            "fill_form for material, quantity, prices, lead time with then_click = the continue button. Never use "
            "buttons that add extra positions: every tender position has its own wizard step. Unsure -> check step result with "
            "read_page (selects may default to wrong option). Fill actual editable controls only. Read-only outputs and "
            "group labels are not checkboxes. If a form reports invalid format, inspect the entered number format first. "
            "Do not repeatedly search for a nonexistent control. Acknowledge tender documents, tick nothing the brief does "
            "not ask for (e.g. own terms). Form wants signing TAN -> request it in portal, call get_signing_tan, enter "
            "returned TAN right away (TAN valid few minutes; new request invalidates old one). Review summary, confirm "
            "binding submission (accept browser dialog). done once portal confirms submission; report "
            "confirmation/receipt text. Call confirm_submission with an exact quote from the portal receipt before done. "
            "If get_signing_tan reports pending, keep this wizard open and poll that tool; do not request another TAN. "
            "A failed attempt may already have submitted: inspect current portal status before any new binding action. "
            "On the summary/review page call check_entries once (it compares the page with the values above); fix "
            "what it reports missing before confirming; no need to read_page the summary yourself.")
        prepared = ctx.shared.get("wizard_ready")
        if prepared:
            goal += (f"\n\nPREPARED: this tab is already logged in and in the bid wizard for this tender (nothing entered "
                     f"yet). What the preparation saw: {str(prepared)[:400]}")

        tan_task = None
        warm_mail = asyncio.create_task(self.warm_mailbox(mail_site))
        expected = expected_values(bid)

        def tan_tool(tools):
            @tools.action("Check the current page (bid summary) against the values to enter; lists what is missing.",
                          param_model=CheckParams)
            async def check_entries(params: CheckParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
                text = await read_current_page(browser_session)
                missing = check_page(text, expected)
                await ctx.board.set("submission_check", {"missing": missing, "checked": sum(map(len, expected.values())),
                                                         "note": params.note})
                timeline.mark("entries checked", missing=len(missing))
                if missing:
                    return ActionResult(extracted_content="NOT on this page (fix before confirming): " + "; ".join(missing),
                                        long_term_memory="check_entries: missing " + "; ".join(missing)[:300])
                return ActionResult(extracted_content=f"All {sum(map(len, expected.values()))} expected values are on "
                                                      "this page.", long_term_memory="check_entries: all values present")

            @tools.action("Confirm acceptance using an exact receipt quote on the current portal page.", param_model=ReceiptParams)
            async def confirm_submission(params: ReceiptParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
                from swarm.normalize import norm_ref
                from urllib.parse import urlsplit
                current_url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
                if urlsplit(current_url).netloc != urlsplit(site["url"]).netloc:
                    return ActionResult(error="Acceptance must be confirmed on the tender portal")
                observed = await read_current_page(browser_session)
                quote = " ".join(params.quote.split())
                expected = answer.get("tender_reference") or facts.get("tender_reference")
                if not expected or norm_ref(params.reference) != norm_ref(expected):
                    return ActionResult(error="Receipt reference does not match this tender")
                if len(quote) < 12 or quote not in " ".join(observed.split()):
                    return ActionResult(error="Receipt quote is not on the current page; read the portal confirmation")
                receipt = {"accepted": True, "reference": expected, "quote": quote,
                           "url": await browser_session.get_current_page_url()}
                await ctx.board.set("submission", receipt)
                await ctx.board.post(Evidence("submission.receipt", tender_site, receipt, source=receipt["url"], author=self.name))
                timeline.mark("accepted submission", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()))
                timeline.current().log_report()        # the run (and this process) ends within seconds
                return ActionResult(extracted_content="Receipt recorded; finish now", is_done=True, success=True)

            @tools.action("Read newest signing TAN from our webmail (call right after requesting TAN).",
                          param_model=TanParams)
            async def get_signing_tan(params: TanParams):
                nonlocal tan_task, mail_site
                if not mail_site:
                    try:
                        mail_site = await site_for(ctx, "mail")
                    except Exception as error:
                        return ActionResult(error=f"mail website discovery failed ({type(error).__name__}); retry after inspecting site capabilities")
                async def retrieve():
                    mail = ctx.site(mail_site)
                    mc = mail.get("credentials") or {}
                    found: list[dict] = []

                    async def keep(rec):
                        found.append(rec)
                        await ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind="mail.tan" if rec["kind"] == "mail.tan" else "mail.page",
                                                      site=mail_site, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                                      author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
                    job = (f"Site (webmail): {mail['url']}\nLogin: username {mc.get('username')!r}, password "
                           f"{mc.get('password')!r}\n\nYOUR JOB: signing TAN for tender "
                           f"{answer.get('tender_reference')} just requested (at {params.requested_at or 'just now'}; "
                           f"session started {started}). Open inbox without any search filter (clear the search box if "
                           "the list looks empty; new TAN mails appear without searching; still empty after passing "
                           "an access gate -> reload the list once), open NEWEST "
                           "signing-TAN message for this tender, read_page it, record kind 'mail.tan' with data "
                           "{\"tan\": \"...\", \"received\": \"...\", \"request\": \"...\"} copied exactly, then done "
                           "stating the TAN. Recording mail.tan completes this lookup immediately; record it once.")
                    async with ctx.lock("main_tab.3"):      # after the inbox warm-up, in the same (logged-in) tab
                        out = await browse(ctx, job, browser=3, site_id=mail_site, on_record=keep, max_steps=12,
                                           author=f"{self.name}.tan", stop_reserve=FINAL_MARGIN_S,
                                           dedupe_reads=False, stop_on_record="mail.tan")
                    tans = [r["data"].get("tan") for r in found if r["kind"] != "page" and r["data"].get("tan")]
                    text = f"TAN: {tans[-1]}" if tans else f"No TAN recorded. Mail agent said: {out['summary'][:300]}"
                    if tans:
                        timeline.mark("TAN received")
                    return text

                if timeline.mark("TAN requested", left=round(ctx.seconds_left())):
                    timeline.current().log_report()   # the run ends soon after the TAN is entered: report it now

                if params.new_request and tan_task is not None:
                    tan_task.cancel()
                    await asyncio.gather(tan_task, return_exceptions=True)
                    tan_task = None
                if tan_task is None:
                    tan_task = asyncio.create_task(retrieve())
                try:
                    text = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(tan_task), timeout=3)
                except TimeoutError:
                    return ActionResult(extracted_content="TAN lookup pending. Keep the portal open. Poll get_signing_tan; do not request a new TAN.")
                except Exception as error:
                    tan_task = None
                    return ActionResult(error=f"TAN lookup failed ({type(error).__name__}); retry the lookup")
                if text.startswith("No TAN"):
                    tan_task = None
                return ActionResult(extracted_content=text, long_term_memory=text)

        try:
            note = ""
            for attempt in range(5):           # an agent that stopped early (errors) gets another go while time allows
                try:
                    out = await browse(ctx, goal + note, browser=self.browser, site_id=tender_site, max_steps=60,
                                       author=self.name, stop_reserve=FINAL_MARGIN_S, extra_tools=tan_tool,
                                       max_actions_per_step=5, flash=False,   # binding, signed: keep full reasoning
                                       careful=True)          # the popup guard never touches the wizard's own forms
                except Exception as error:
                    ctx.board.error(self.name, f"submission attempt {attempt + 1}: {type(error).__name__}")
                    out = {"summary": f"browser interrupted: {type(error).__name__}", "done": False, "steps": 0}
                await ctx.board.set("submission_attempt", {"summary": out["summary"], "done": out["done"], "steps": out["steps"],
                                                   "attempt": attempt + 1})
                self.log.info("submission attempt %d finished (done=%s): %s", attempt + 1, out["done"], out["summary"][:500])
                closed = ctx.shared.get("run_closed")
                if closed and not (ctx.board.get("submission") or {}).get("accepted"):
                    # the platform ended the run: the binding submission went through if the wizard reached signing
                    signed = "TAN requested" in timeline.current().milestones
                    receipt = {"accepted": signed, "reference": answer.get("tender_reference") or facts.get("tender_reference"),
                               "evidence": f"platform closed the run with {closed['left']}s left"
                                           + (" after the TAN was requested" if signed else " before any TAN request")}
                    await ctx.board.set("submission", receipt)
                    if signed:
                        timeline.mark("accepted submission", left=closed["left"], via="platform closed the run")
                    self.log.warning("run closed by the platform: %s", receipt["evidence"])
                    break
                if (ctx.board.get("submission") or {}).get("accepted") or ctx.seconds_left() < FINAL_MARGIN_S + 45:
                    break
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Browser may be mid-wizard: "
                        "check current page first, continue from there.")
        finally:
            for task in (tan_task, warm_mail):
                if task is not None:
                    task.cancel()
                    await asyncio.gather(task, return_exceptions=True)

    async def warm_mailbox(self, mail_site: str | None) -> None:
        """Log the mail browser's main tab in and open the inbox while the wizard is filled, so the TAN lookup later
        only opens the newest message (the submitter waits for the TAN otherwise)."""
        ctx = self.ctx
        try:
            mail_site = mail_site or await site_for(ctx, "mail")
            mail = ctx.site(mail_site)
            mc = mail.get("credentials") or {}
            async with ctx.lock("main_tab.3"):
                with timeline.span("submit.prep", "mailbox"):
                    out = await browse(ctx, f"Site (webmail): {mail['url']}\nLogin: username {mc.get('username')!r}, "
                                            f"password {mc.get('password')!r}\n\nYOUR JOB: log in if needed, accept the "
                                            "cookie wall, close popups, pass any access gate, open the inbox with NO "
                                            "search filter (clear a search left in the search box, so new mails "
                                            "show). Open no message. Then done.",
                                       browser=3, site_id=mail_site, max_steps=6, author=f"{self.name}.mailbox",
                                       stop_reserve=FINAL_MARGIN_S, dedupe_reads=False)
            if out.get("done"):
                timeline.mark("mailbox ready")
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - only a time saver: the TAN lookup logs in itself if needed
            self.log.info("mailbox warm-up failed: %s", error)

class FakeLLM:
    def __init__(self, reply):
        self.reply, self.calls = reply, 0

    async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        return self.reply


class Guard(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        from swarm import guard
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        guard._PENDING.clear()

    def test_signature_ignores_numbers(self):
        from swarm.guard import signature
        a = {"kind": "overlay", "text": "Wartung am 12.03. Code 4711", "buttons": [{"label": "OK"}], "fields": []}
        b = dict(a, text="Wartung am 14.05. Code 0815")
        self.assertEqual(signature(a), signature(b))

    def test_careful_mode_only_clicks_noise_without_inputs(self):
        from swarm.guard import allowed
        item = {"buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "x", "away": False}, {"i": 1, "label": "go", "away": True}], "fields": []}
        self.assertTrue(allowed({"action": "click", "button": 0, "kind": "survey"}, item, careful=True))
        from swarm.guard import pick_button
        # the model picked the link away ("accept and continue" decoy): the item's one staying button (x) instead
        self.assertEqual(pick_button({"action": "click", "button": 1, "kind": "notice"}, item), 0)
        two = dict(item, buttons=item["buttons"] + [{"i": 2, "label": "ok", "away": False}])
        self.assertIsNone(pick_button({"action": "click", "button": 1, "kind": "notice"}, two))
        self.assertFalse(allowed({"action": "click", "button": 1, "kind": "notice"}, two, careful=False))
        self.assertEqual(pick_button({"action": "click", "button": 1, "kind": "error"}, two), 1)   # retry link
        self.assertFalse(allowed({"action": "click", "button": 0, "kind": "content"}, item, careful=True))
        self.assertFalse(allowed({"action": "fill", "fields": [{"field": "a", "value": "1"}]}, item, careful=True))
        self.assertFalse(allowed({"action": "click", "button": 0, "kind": "notice"},
                                 dict(item, fields=[{"type": "text"}]), careful=True))

    async def test_one_model_call_per_new_item_across_agents_then_cached_clicks(self):
        from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
        from swarm.guard import PopupGuard
        llm = FakeLLM({"items": [{"id": 0, "action": "click", "button": 0, "kind": "notice"}]})
        ctx = NS(llm=llm)
        scan = {"url": "https://erp.example/x", "items": [
            {"id": 0, "kind": "overlay", "text": "Wartungshinweis", "buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "OK", "away": False}],
             "fields": []}]}
        clicks = []

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            if args:
                clicks.append(args[0])
                return "clicked"
            return scan
        from swarm import guard
        a, b = PopupGuard(ctx, "a"), PopupGuard(ctx, "b")
        await asyncio.gather(a.sweep(evaluate), b.sweep(evaluate))   # never waits for the model
        self.assertEqual(clicks, [])
        await asyncio.gather(*guard._TASKS)
        await asyncio.gather(a.sweep(evaluate), b.sweep(evaluate), PopupGuard(ctx, "c").sweep(evaluate))
        self.assertEqual(llm.calls, 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(clicks), 3)

"""Quick decisions with the hosted Clef model: cheap, fast, calibrated. Use it for the many small judgements
(what kind of page is this, which of these links, is this the right document) and keep Qwen for reading and
reasoning. Each call still adds its simulated cost, but at a fraction of a chat call.

    kind, p = await decide.choose({"page": text}, "What is this page?", PAGE_KINDS)
    p_yes   = await decide.yes({"mail": subject}, "Is this mail about tender REF exactly?")

The API (POST $CLEF_BASE_URL/v1/decide) takes a `state` (text or JSON), up to 4 images as base64 data URLs and
named questions: "choice" (criteria: {option: description}), "noul" (probability of yes) and "score"
(criteria: a list of 2-10 levels, lowest first). Set "clef" in agent.json "models" so a run waits for it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import base64
import logging
import os

import httpx

from swarm.bidmath import plain

log = logging.getLogger("decide")

MAX_IMAGES = 4
_sem = asyncio.Semaphore(12)        # the team may run 16 Clef calls at once, across all its runs
usage = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0}
_transport = None                   # tests swap in an httpx.MockTransport

# what a page can be, for agents that need to know where they are before acting
PAGE_KINDS = {
    "login": "a sign-in form asking for username and password",
    "consent": "a cookie or consent wall that must be accepted before the content",
    "error": "an error or 'service unavailable' page that offers a retry",
    "locked": "content blocked behind a robot check, slider or other unlock step",
    "list": "a list, table or search results to pick an entry from",
    "document": "a document, record, message or form with the actual content",
    "other": "anything else",
}


class ClefError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def data_url(png: bytes, mime: str = "image/png") -> str:
    return f"data:{mime};base64,{base64.b64encode(png).decode()}"


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[bytes] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict:
    """One Clef call with several named questions; returns the `answers` object."""
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = [data_url(i) if isinstance(i, (bytes, bytearray)) else i for i in images[:MAX_IMAGES]]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['CLEF_API_KEY']}"}
    last = None
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        try:
            async with _sem, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=180, transport=_transport) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            if response.status_code == 400:      # our question is malformed: retrying will not help
                raise ClefError(response.text[:300])
            response.raise_for_status()
            reply = response.json()
            usage["calls"] += 1
            usage["input_tokens"] += (reply.get("usage") or {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            return reply["answers"]
        except ClefError:
            raise
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeouts, 5xx, a model waking up
            last = error
            await asyncio.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
    raise ClefError(f"Clef unavailable: {type(last).__name__}: {last}")


async def choose(state, instructions: str, options: dict[str, str],
                 images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """Pick one of `options` ({key: description}); returns (key, confidence)."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "choice", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": options}},
                           images)
    q = answers["q"]
    return q["choice"], float(q.get("confidence", q.get("probabilities", {}).get(q["choice"], 0)))


async def yes(state, question: str, images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
    """Probability (0-1) that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}}, images)
    return float(answers["q"]["noul"])


async def score(state, instructions: str, levels: list[str], images: list[bytes] | None = None) -> float:
    """A rating on `levels` (lowest first), as a float index into them."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "score", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": levels}},
                           images)
    return float(answers["q"]["score"])


async def page_kind(page, with_screenshot: bool = False, chars: int = 2500) -> tuple[str, float]:
    """What kind of page a Playwright page shows (see PAGE_KINDS), from its text and optionally a screenshot."""
    text = plain(await page.evaluate("() => (document.querySelector('main') || document.body).innerText"))[:chars]
    shots = [await page.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=60)] if with_screenshot else None
    state = {"url": page.url, "title": plain(await page.title()), "text": text}
    return await choose(state, "What kind of page is the browser showing?", PAGE_KINDS,
                        [data_url(s, "image/jpeg") for s in shots] if shots else None)
