"""Which website plays which role. Site ids and names differ between datasets, so the model maps them from the brief
once per run; the result is cached on the board as results["sites"] = {role: siteId}."""
import logging

log = logging.getLogger("sites")

ROLES = {
    "tender": "public procurement / tender portal: the tender, its bill of quantities, bidder Q&A, bid submission",
    "spec": "the buyer's supplier/customer portal holding the technical specification (Lastenheft) and its revisions",
    "erp": "our own ERP: materials, stock, lead times, price conditions",
    "mail": "our webmail / sales inbox: approvals, internal release mails, signing TANs",
}


async def resolve_roles(ctx) -> dict:
    """Map capabilities at runtime; incomplete mappings are retried, observed contradictions can be corrected."""
    async with ctx.lock("sites"):
        invalid = ctx.shared.setdefault("site_invalidations", {})
        known = {r: v for r, v in (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).items() if v not in invalid.get(r, set())}
        if all(role in known for role in ROLES):
            return known
        sites = [{"siteId": s.get("siteId"), "url": s.get("url")} for s in ctx.task.get("access", [])]
        mapping = dict(known)
        observations = ctx.shared.setdefault("site_observations", {})
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                out = await ctx.llm.ask_json(
                    "Map roles to siteId using the brief and observations. Reply {tender: siteId, spec: siteId, "
                    "erp: siteId, mail: siteId, inspect: [siteId]}. Omit uncertain mappings and select up to two "
                    "sites to inspect when names are opaque. Multiple capabilities may share a site.",
                    f"Roles: {ROLES}\nSites: {sites}\nCurrent mapping: {mapping}\nObservations: {observations}\nRejected role/site pairs: {invalid}\nBrief:\n{ctx.brief}")
                mapping.update({r: v for r, v in (out or {}).items() if r in ROLES and v in ctx.site_ids and v not in invalid.get(r, set())})
                await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
                if all(role in mapping for role in ROLES):
                    break
                inspect = [v for v in (out or {}).get("inspect", []) if v in ctx.site_ids and v not in observations][:2]
                if inspect and getattr(ctx, "pool", None):
                    from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
                    for site_id in inspect:
                        site = ctx.site(site_id)
                        tab = Tab(ctx.site_ids.index(site_id) % 4)
                        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
                        try:
                            result = await browse(ctx, f"Inspect this workspace to identify its business capabilities: {site['url']}. "
                                                  f"Login if necessary using {creds}. Read its headings and menus. "
                                                  "Report what information it holds; do not submit anything.",
                                                  tab=tab, site_id=site_id, max_steps=5, author="SiteOrientation")
                            observations[site_id] = result["summary"][:2500]
                        finally:
                            await tab.close()
            except Exception as error:
                log.warning("role mapping attempt failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
        await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
        log.info("site roles: %s", mapping)
        return mapping


async def site_for(ctx, role: str) -> str:
    known = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get(role)
    if known in ctx.site_ids and known not in ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(role, set()):
        return known
    mapping = await resolve_roles(ctx)
    if role not in mapping:
        raise KeyError(f"no website found for role {role!r}: {mapping}")
    return mapping[role]

class ClefFirst(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    """Closed decisions go to Clef; Qwen only gets what Clef cannot settle."""

    def setUp(self):
        os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"] = "http://clef.invalid/clef"
        os.environ["CLEF_API_KEY"] = "test-key"

    def tearDown(self):
        decide._transport = None
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_BASE_URL", None)
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_API_KEY", None)
        from swarm import guard
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        guard._PENDING.clear()

    async def test_guard_clicks_noise_on_clef_and_sends_gates_to_qwen(self):
        from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
        from swarm import guard

        def handler(request):
            body = json.loads(request.content)
            kind = "gate" if "robot" in body["state"]["text"] else "notice"
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"kind": {"choice": kind, "confidence": 0.95},
                                                         "button": {"choice": "b0", "confidence": 0.9}}})
        fake(handler)
        asked = []

        class LLM:
            async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
                asked.append(json.loads(user))
                return {"items": [{"id": 1, "action": "fill", "kind": "gate",
                                   "fields": [{"field": "robot", "value": "true"}], "then_click": "Weiter"}]}
        notice = {"id": 0, "kind": "overlay", "text": "Wartungshinweis", "fields": [],
                  "buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "OK", "away": False}]}
        gate = {"id": 1, "kind": "gate", "text": "Ich bin kein robot", "fields": [{"type": "checkbox"}],
                "buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "Weiter", "away": False}]}
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=LLM()), "a")
        await g._classify("erp.example", [(("erp.example", guard.signature(notice)), notice),

68	  agents on that site get the tips in their hints, so one agent's discovery saves every other agent the search.
69	
70	`read_page` reads live content by default and preserves URL fragments. Explicit `refresh=false` permits cached
71	immutable evidence. Failed extractions are retried rather than cached as empty results. The popup guard (`swarm/guard.py`) sweeps the agent's page before every step and every 2 s:
72	each new kind of dialog / overlay / banner / short error page goes to the model once ("click" noise, "fill" an access
73	gate, "leave" anything an agent works with), and the decision is cached per site for all agents, so a notice that comes
74	back on every page costs one model call per run. The submitter's guard is careful: clicks on noise without inputs only.
75	Links that open another page ("accept and continue" in notices, "Öffnen" in download bars) are never clicked: when the
76	model picks one, the item's single staying button (its x) is used instead; only an error page's retry link may lead
77	away. Inline gates (a slider to drag to the end, a robot checkbox) are found by their slider and unlocked on every
78	page; fills that only tick boxes and move sliders are cached like clicks. `read_page` prints list links as `<url>`, so
79	agents open records and messages by URL instead of clicking through locked or paged lists.
80	
81	Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
82	rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).

`read_page` reads live content by default and preserves URL fragments. Explicit `refresh=false` permits cached
immutable evidence. Failed extractions are retried rather than cached as empty results. The popup guard (`swarm/guard.py`) sweeps the agent's page before every step and every 2 s:
each new kind of dialog / overlay / banner / short error page goes to the model once ("click" noise, "fill" an access
gate, "leave" anything an agent works with), and the decision is cached per site for all agents, so a notice that comes
back on every page costs one model call per run. The submitter's guard is careful: clicks on noise without inputs only.
Links that open another page ("accept and continue" in notices, "Öffnen" in download bars) are never clicked: when the
model picks one, the item's single staying button (its x) is used instead; only an error page's retry link may lead
away. Inline gates (a slider to drag to the end, a robot checkbox) are found by their slider and unlocked on every
page; fills that only tick boxes and move sliders are cached like clicks. `read_page` prints list links as `<url>`, so
agents open records and messages by URL instead of clicking through locked or paged lists.

Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).

# Integration record

The baseline (`main`) is the one project everyone builds on. This file says what came from which branch, what was
superseded by what, and which questions are still open. Update it when you integrate something (`scripts/team.py`).

## Baseline 2026-10-10: `integration/next` (main + tender_portal + site-recon + ports)

| Branch (author) | What it brought | Status in the baseline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main` (ksiox1337, base) | `swarm/bidmath.py` (bid rules as tested functions), `swarm/formpilot.py` + formpilot submitter, `swarm/decide.py` (Clef), `SITE-NOTES.md` | Merged. The formpilot **submitter** was replaced (conflict, see below); `bidmath`, `formpilot`, `decide` are kept and tested but **no runtime agent calls them**. |
| `site-recon` (kurk-s) | `sites.py` site plumbing (login, cookie wall, ERP error page, canvas reading, unlock slot), `tender_model.py`, site notes, nominal stroke for "nutzbarer Weg" in `bidmath` | Merged fully, no conflicts. `sites.py` and `tender_model.py` are **not called by the runtime**. |
| `tender_portal` (CRUBSTERINO) | The runtime: dataflow COLLECT with analysts, collection coordinator (gaps -> follow-up jobs), popup/access guard, `read_page`, tabs, flash mode, receipt-confirmed signing with built-in TAN lookup, `docs/REVIEW.md` (20 known problems), signing/navigation evaluation scripts | Merged fully. **The runtime of the baseline.** |
| `test_brief_reader` (Maksym Shvydenko) | Brief reader with value validation and login masking, rules engine on `bidmath` with follow-up rounds, answer validator, robot-check module, `read_page_text`, TAN fetcher | Not merged (a parallel rewrite of the same 18 files). **Ported:** login masking and "value must be in the brief" checks into `agents/read_brief.py`. **Superseded:** engine -> `agents/compute_bid.py` (rules agree, see contracts); validator -> `swarm/validation.py`; robot/gate -> `swarm/guard.py`; `read_page_text` -> `swarm/page_text.py`; follow-ups -> `agents/coordinate.py`; TAN fetcher -> submitter's TAN lookup. |
| `tanreader-debug` (ksiox1337 + a Claude session, local commit `1fb11af`) | TanReader agent, formpilot fixes (loop guard, no invented TAN, binding confirmation), browser-use in one process per agent (bubus global lock), frozen-tab replacement, page capture, RUNSTATS (tokens/cost per browse) | Not merged (a parallel rewrite of 15 of the same files). **Superseded:** analyzers/calculator, access check, page capture, Qwen settings (all exist in tender_portal's runtime). **Open:** process isolation and RUNSTATS (below). |

Conflict resolved by intent: `agents/submit_bid.py` (main's formpilot submitter vs tender_portal's browser-use
submitter) -> tender_portal's: newer, receipt-confirmed, with a signing regression script. main's submitter tests were
rewritten for it (`tests/test_submit_bid.py`, same intents).

## Contracts (checked by tests, not by Git)

- **Price rules**: `tests/test_contracts.py` feeds `agents/compute_bid.compute` and `swarm/bidmath` the same
  hand-worked case (FX, metal index, clauses, cartons, setup pool, bonus bands, commitment, shared stock, conditional
  discount). Both agree on every field. Change either and this test tells you whether they still agree.
- **Sandbox network**: model HTTP clients must keep httpx's default transport (HTTPS_PROXY); a custom transport
  bypassed the sandbox proxy and every call failed (found on `tanreader-debug`).

## Open questions (decide as a team, then change one place)

| Question | Today | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Number format in the bid form above 999 EUR | **Settled**: the form accepted `2.008,33` / `139.604,98` (run_7732ba545b50b3a5, quality 59.2). | `swarm/normalize.de_number` |
| Condition without a price unit | runtime prices nothing (tender_portal: "does not get guessed"); bidmath assumes 1 | `agents/compute_bid.scale_price` |
| "Ordinary setup fee" source | runtime: from the Q&A answer; tanreader-debug's calculator: from the ERP condition | `agents/compute_bid.position_keys` |
| A browser that stops answering | **Fixed after the first sandbox run of this baseline** (run_2fc8121504807328: browser 0 never reconnected, 0 tender pages, 5 failed signing attempts): `browse()` checks the browser and moves the work to a new tab of a responsive one (`responsive_tab`). | `swarm/browser_agent.py` |
| A hung tab blocks connecting to its browser | **Fixed** (run_f93abf054739c02c: the browser still answered, but browser-use's connect attaches to every tab and timed out on the hung one; the submitter failed 5x): `responsive_tab` also closes tabs that cannot evaluate `1` within 8 s (`close_hung_tabs`, tested against real Chromium). | `swarm/browser_agent.py` |
| Sandbox CPU load (4 vCPU) | ERP tabs now 6 (see below); mail topic tabs 2, guard sweep 4 s. Evidence: two sandbox runs stalled every browser at once; the same main locally ran 85 s without a single stall. Tunable per run: `SWARM_ERP_TABS`, `SWARM_MAIL_TABS`, `SWARM_GUARD_INTERVAL_S`. | `agents/scrape_erp.py`, `agents/scrape_mail.py`, `swarm/guard.py` |
| One frozen tab stalls every browser | browser-use routes all browser events of a process through one global lock (bubus); tanreader-debug isolated each browse in its own process, tender_portal ends a stalled connection after two timeouts and reattaches. Not reconciled: the isolation does not fit tender_portal's in-process tabs. | `swarm/browser_agent.py` |
| Tokens/cost per agent in every run log (RUNSTATS) | only on tanreader-debug | `swarm/orchestrator.py` |
| Unused modules (`bidmath`, `formpilot`, `decide`, `sites.py`, `tender_model.py`) | kept and tested; runtime does not call them | delete or adopt |

| Sandbox CPU vs ERP tabs | 6 tabs beat 4 in an A/B (17 vs 12 ERP jobs, 4 vs 1 positions priced, fewer failed browses); one run per arm. | `agents/scrape_erp.py` |
| Condition fragments of different records merged | **Fixed**: `reconcile_conditions` (record ids, linked pages, conflicts kept apart). | `agents/analyze_materials.py` |
| Tokens/time per agent in every run log (RUNSTATS) | Partly covered by `swarm/timeline.py` (time per agent and category, milestones, counters). | `swarm/timeline.py` |
| team.py checks red without pytest | **Fixed**: falls back to `scripts/run_tests.py` (unittest + plain test functions). | `scripts/team.py` |

content.text:
I moved three kinds of small decision from Qwen to Clef. Unit tests pass (173), but none of this has run in the sandbox yet; run C started before these edits, so it uses the old package.

**How the work was split before:** Qwen did everything. Clef had one helper (a check that the bid was confirmed), and nothing called it.

**Where each model fits:**
- **Qwen** is needed wherever the answer is text or values: every browsing step, page extraction, reading the brief, coordinator planning, image transcription, and the values for access gates. These stay on Qwen.
- **Clef** only answers closed questions (pick one of N, or yes/no). It is cheaper and faster, so it suits the small judgement calls.

**What moved to Clef:**
1. **Popup guard** (`swarm/guard.py`): Clef now classifies each new popup and picks the button that closes it, with a "leave it" option for real content. Access gates still go to Qwen, because they need values typed in. Anything Clef isn't confident about also goes to Qwen. Decisions are cached as before, and Clef calls run in parallel.
2. **Site-role mapping** (`swarm/sites.py`): one Clef call asks which site is the tender portal, spec portal, ERP and mailbox. A role is kept only at confidence ≥ 0.85; the rest go to the existing Qwen loop, which can inspect sites. When all four map confidently, the Qwen call and any 5-step inspection browses are skipped.
3. **Receipt check** (`agents/submit_bid.py`, `confirm_submission`): before the receipt is recorded, Clef gives a second opinion on whether the page really is a binding receipt (not a draft or review page). It blocks only a clear "no" (p < 0.3). If Clef is down or slow, the submit goes ahead as before.

If Clef is missing or slow, everything falls back to the old behaviour, so local runs without Clef work unchanged. Clef calls now show up as `model.call clef` in the run timeline.

**Other changes:**
- `tests/test_decide.py` left the Clef settings in place after it ran, which would have sent other tests to a non-existent Clef server; fixed. Four new tests cover the guard split, the role mapping, the low-confidence fallback and the receipt check.
- `docs/SWARM.md` has a new "Which model does what" table, and `docs/INTEGRATION.md` no longer says nothing calls Clef.

Nothing is committed yet. Run C (`reh_5652c5c480fb852b`) is still running; I'll report its result when it finishes. I'd then do a test run with these changes, checking the guard log lines (they now say `(clef)` or `(qwen)`) and the `site roles (clef)` line.

lastPrompt: What are the possible ways to speed up the TAN? Do think outside of the box and find a perfect solution. Shortly describe to me eligible options before writing code.

content.text:
The TAN lookup in run C took **139 s**, measured from the TAN request (01:53:40) to the submitter entering the TAN (01:55:59). Here is where the time went:

| Segment | Time | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| Lookup start | 14 s | The mail lookup's first browsing step |
| Inbox gate | ~55 s | The agent and the popup guard both worked the slider gate. The guard reported "unlocked" four times while the agent kept dragging and pressing keys on the slider, so the gate kept resetting. |
| Message reader gate | ~25 s | A second slider inside the message reader, with the same fight |
| Polling lag | ~30 s | The TAN was found at 01:55:22, but the submitter only polls `get_signing_tan` once per model step (8–30 s each, plus `wait` actions) |
| Entering it | ~8 s | Normal |

Possible fixes, all within the fair-play rules (the model still decides which mail and which field):

1. **Wait inside `get_signing_tan` instead of polling.** The tool waits up to about 60 s (under the 75 s submitter step limit) and returns the moment the TAN is recorded. This saves about 25–30 s and 5–8 submitter model calls. It's simple and low risk.
2. **Stop the gate fight.** Tell the mail agent in the TAN job: "the page guard clears slider and robot gates by itself; never drag sliders or press keys on them; if a gate shows, wait 2 s and read again." Optionally, the guard could also run one sweep right before every step of the TAN lookup, not only on its 4 s timer. This saves about 40–60 s and is the biggest single gain. It's low risk.
3. **Pre-arm the mailbox at the summary page.** When `check_entries` reports all values present (18 s before the TAN request in run C), start a step that reloads the inbox and passes its gate. When the TAN is then requested, the lookup only reloads and opens the newest message. This saves about 15–20 s and adds a little complexity: one more trigger, and the 'main_tab.3' tab lock that the inbox warm-up and the TAN lookup already share.
4. **Fast path after opening the message.** When the lookup reads the opened TAN message, one quick Qwen call extracts the TAN, the request number and the tender reference, and records the TAN automatically when the reference matches. This skips the agent's separate record step and the "done" round trip, saving about 5–10 s at medium risk. A wrong auto-record is possible if two TAN mails exist, so it must match the request number.
5. **Run two lookups in parallel tabs, first result wins.** I don't recommend this: it doubles the gate trouble and the browser load on browser 3.
6. **Request the TAN earlier, before entering the positions.** Not viable: the TAN is valid for 5 min, a new request invalidates the old one, and the request button is on the summary step.

**Recommendation: 1 + 2 + 3.** Together they should bring the lookup from about 139 s to roughly 40–60 s, with no changes to the wizard and no risk of entering the wrong TAN. Option 4 can come later if needed.

Which of these should I build?

State: [index]<tag>text</tag>; only [indexed] clickable; indent = child; *[ = new.
Max {max_actions} actions/step. Check last action worked. Never chain consequential action (submit/confirm/continue) after unverified one.
Reply JSON only:
{{"memory": "1-4 short sentences: last step ok/failed, facts to keep, next goal", "action": [{{"click": {{"index": 12}}}}, {{"read_page": {{"topic": "label"}}}}]}}
Each action = own object, ONE action key.
Before done success=true: re-check request, all items met, nothing invented. Unmet/unsure -> success=false.
done ALONE in its own step, after evidence saved; never re-record saved facts."""

SYSTEM_EXTRA = """
Rules:
- Cookie walls/surveys/popups: dismiss irrelevant; follow link only if its purpose helps task. Login form again -> log in again (credentials in task). Temp error page -> retry few times.
- read_page saves DOM text (shadow roots, readable frames). Check text has requested facts. Image/canvas -> read_visual; PDF/ZIP link -> read_document; inaccessible frame -> navigate its URL. evidence_role routes facts found on other site to tender/spec/erp/mail. `url`: open+read one step. `urls`: read several pages one step (tabs of record, messages). `next_page_link`: exact paging-link text -> all pages read. `topic` (short label) when analysts need page -> saved as evidence.
- fill_form fills whole form one step (slider -> 'max', checkbox -> 'true'); toggles may be in shadow DOM. Read-only outputs/group labels/status text are no checkboxes.
- Guard auto-closes cookie/survey/notice/error pages and slider gates: popup gone -> continue. Notice dialogs: close with x; "accept and continue" links lose work. Download/log bars ("Öffnen") = decoys.

async def _browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
                  max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False,
                  stop_reserve: float | None = None, stop_extra: float = 0.0, extra_tools=None,
                  max_actions_per_step: int = 4, flash: bool = True, careful: bool = False,
                  dedupe_reads: bool = True, stop_on_record: str = "", idle_steps: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.

    `tab`: the tab to work in (default: the main tab of `browser`). Screenshots are off by default
    (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page` already reads canvas labels and
    hidden text. `flash`: short replies + compact prompt (see module doc). `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this
    many seconds left (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)` may register more actions. Pages read with a
    `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
    A PopupGuard (swarm/guard.py) clears popups, notices and error pages next to the agent; `careful=True` limits it to
    noise without inputs (the bid submitter). `dedupe_reads`: read_page of a URL another agent already saved returns
    the saved text instead of opening it again (off for mails that change, such as TANs). `idle_steps`: after the
    first saved page/fact, stop once this many steps in a row saved nothing new (the caller resumes).
    """
    records: list[dict] = []
    progress = {"saved_at": None, "idle_stop": False}     # step of the last saved page/fact

    def reserve() -> float:
        """Seconds-left mark at which this browse stops: fixed, or the live submission reserve plus `stop_extra`."""
        if stop_reserve is not None:
            return stop_reserve
        return ctx.stop_at(stop_extra) if ctx is not None and hasattr(ctx, "stop_at") else stop_extra

    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
        records.append(rec)
        progress["saved_at"] = len(step_started)
        if on_record:
            await on_record(rec)

    step_started: list[float] = []
    tools = build_tools(ctx, site_id, author, emit, dedupe_reads=dedupe_reads, stop_on_record=stop_on_record)
    if extra_tools:
        extra_tools(tools)

    tab = await responsive_tab(tab or main_tab(browser))
    await tab.open()
    session = make_session(ctx, tab, vision=bool(use_vision))
    prompt = dict(flash_mode=True, override_system_message=FLASH_SYSTEM.format(max_actions=max_actions_per_step)) \
        if flash else {}
    tips = site_tips(ctx, site_id)
    hints = hints + ("\nTips from other agents on this site:\n- " + "\n- ".join(tips) if tips else "")
    # A tab an agent already worked in is on the site (logged in, past gates): start from its current page instead of
    # browser-use opening the site's start URL from the goal again.
    reused = tab.used and bool(browsers.cdp_urls())
    tab.used = True
    browsing_llm = make_llm(flash)
    browsing_llm._usage_ctx = ctx
    agent = Agent(task=goal + ("\n\nThis tab is already on the site: start from the current page." if reused else ""),
                  llm=browsing_llm, browser_session=session, tools=tools, use_vision=use_vision,
                  use_judge=False, generate_gif=False, max_failures=6, max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step,
                  llm_timeout=min(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, BROWSE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S if flash else SUBMIT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S) + 2,
                  step_timeout=120 if flash else SUBMIT_STEP_TIMEOUT_S, directly_open_url=not reused,
                  max_history_items=HISTORY_ITEMS if flash else None, max_clickable_elements_length=DOM_CHARS,
                  REDACTED,
                  extend_system_message=SYSTEM_EXTRA + (f"\n{hints}" if hints else ""), **prompt)
    guard = PopupGuard(ctx, author, careful=careful,
                       fill=lambda pairs, then_click, item_id: fill_page(session, pairs, "", then_click, item_id))
    evaluate = lambda js, *a: _evaluate(session, js, *a)  # noqa: E731
    guard_task: asyncio.Task | None = None

    async def before_step(_agent) -> None:
        nonlocal guard_task
        if ctx.seconds_left() <= reserve():
            agent.stop()
            return
        with timeline.span("guard", "sweep"):
            try:                    # the page the model is about to see: cleared first
                await asyncio.wait_for(guard.sweep(evaluate), 25)
            except Exception as error:
                log.debug("guard before step failed: %s", error)
        if guard_task is None:  # from now on also between steps (popups that appear while the model thinks)
            guard_task = asyncio.create_task(guard.loop(evaluate))
        step_started.append(timeline.now())

    secrets = [str((s.get("credentials") or {}).get("password") or "") for s in (ctx.task.get("access") or [])] \

@tools.action("Save one fact found (kept even if time runs out).", param_model=RecordParams)
    async def record(params: RecordParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
        data = dict(params.data)
        data["_observed_text"] = await read_current_page(browser_session)
        await emit({"kind": params.kind, "data": data, "source": params.source or url, "note": params.note,
                    "site": site_id, "author": author})
        finished = bool(stop_on_record and params.kind == stop_on_record)
        return ActionResult(extracted_content=f"recorded {params.kind}", is_done=finished,
                            success=True if finished else None)

    async def read_one(target: str | None, params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession) -> tuple[str, str, int]:
        if target:
            await browser_session.navigate_to(target)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.8)
        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
        title = await browser_session.get_current_page_title()
        pages = []
        page_limit = max(1, min(params.max_pages, 20))

        async def keep(text):
            pages.append(text)
            if params.topic:
                # Publish before moving on: cancellation or a stalled next page must not lose earlier evidence.
                await emit({"kind": f"{params.evidence_role}.page" if params.evidence_role in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail") else "page",
                            "data": {"topic": params.topic, "url": url, "title": title, "pages": 1,
                                     "page_in_read": len(pages), "text": text},
                            "source": url, "note": "", "site": site_id, "author": author})
                reads[url] = {"text": "\n\n----- next page -----\n\n".join(pages),
                              "author": author, "topic": params.topic, "pages": len(pages), "complete": False}

        await keep(await read_current_page(browser_session))
        complete = not params.next_page_link
        if params.next_page_link:
            for _ in range(page_limit - 1):
                if await _evaluate(browser_session, NEXT_JS, params.next_page_link) != "clicked":
                    complete = True
                    break
                text = pages[-1]

async def access_trouble(role: str, observation: str, page_text: str) -> bool:
    """Is a 'role absent' report really an access failure (login, gate, error page, expired form, timeout)? Those must
    not unassign the site: in reh_cabb68e26f532fb8 one ERP agent stuck at the gate reported the ERP absent, the role
    was dropped and no ERP follow-up ran for the last 2 minutes of collection. Clef decides; without Clef the report
    stands (old behaviour)."""
    from swarm import decide
    from swarm.sites import ROLES
    if not decide.available():
        return False
    try:
        p = await asyncio.wait_for(decide.yes(
            {"role_expected": ROLES.get(role, role), "agent_observation": observation[:1500],
             "current_page": page_text[:2000]},
            "Does this show that the website holds a different kind of business data than the expected role (not "
            "merely that access failed: login, access gate, error page, expired form, timeout, empty search)?"), 20)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False
    return p < 0.5

        tan_task = None
        warm_mail = asyncio.create_task(self.warm_mailbox(mail_site))
        expected = expected_values(bid)

        def tan_tool(tools):
            @tools.action("Check the current page (bid summary) against the values to enter; lists what is missing.",
                          param_model=CheckParams)
            async def check_entries(params: CheckParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
                text = await read_current_page(browser_session)
                missing = check_page(text, expected)
                await ctx.board.set("submission_check", {"missing": missing, "checked": sum(map(len, expected.values())),
                                                         "note": params.note})
                timeline.mark("entries checked", missing=len(missing))
                if missing:
                    return ActionResult(extracted_content="NOT on this page (fix before confirming): " + "; ".join(missing),
                                        long_term_memory="check_entries: missing " + "; ".join(missing)[:300])
                return ActionResult(extracted_content=f"All {sum(map(len, expected.values()))} expected values are on "
                                                      "this page.", long_term_memory="check_entries: all values present")

            @tools.action("Confirm acceptance using an exact receipt quote on the current portal page.", param_model=ReceiptParams)
            async def confirm_submission(params: ReceiptParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
                from swarm.normalize import norm_ref
                from urllib.parse import urlsplit
                current_url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
                if urlsplit(current_url).netloc != urlsplit(site["url"]).netloc:
                    return ActionResult(error="Acceptance must be confirmed on the tender portal")
                observed = await read_current_page(browser_session)
                quote = " ".join(params.quote.split())
                expected = answer.get("tender_reference") or facts.get("tender_reference")
                if not expected or norm_ref(params.reference) != norm_ref(expected):
                    return ActionResult(error="Receipt reference does not match this tender")
                if len(quote) < 12 or quote not in " ".join(observed.split()):
                    return ActionResult(error="Receipt quote is not on the current page; read the portal confirmation")
                if await looks_unsubmitted(observed, quote):
                    return ActionResult(error="This page does not look like a binding submission receipt (draft, "
                                              "review or form?). Finish the submission, then confirm on the receipt.")
                receipt = {"accepted": True, "reference": expected, "quote": quote,
                           "url": await browser_session.get_current_page_url()}
                await ctx.board.set("submission", receipt)
                await ctx.board.post(Evidence("submission.receipt", tender_site, receipt, source=receipt["url"], author=self.name))
                timeline.mark("accepted submission", left=round(ctx.seconds_left()))
                timeline.current().log_report()        # the run (and this process) ends within seconds
                return ActionResult(extracted_content="Receipt recorded; finish now", is_done=True, success=True)

            @tools.action("Read newest signing TAN from our webmail (call right after requesting TAN).",
                          param_model=TanParams)
            async def get_signing_tan(params: TanParams):
                nonlocal tan_task, mail_site
                if not mail_site:
                    try:
                        mail_site = await site_for(ctx, "mail")
                    except Exception as error:
                        return ActionResult(error=f"mail website discovery failed ({type(error).__name__}); retry after inspecting site capabilities")
                async def retrieve():
                    mail = ctx.site(mail_site)

The model drives the wizard (browser 0) from the brief's submission instructions and a table of the values to enter;
`fill_form` sets many fields per step. When the wizard asks for the signing TAN the model calls `get_signing_tan`,
which runs a short browse on the mail browser (3) to read the newest TAN mail. Runs even if earlier phases failed:
then every position without data is omitted ("partial submission"), the bid is still signed.

- At submit start the mail browser's main tab logs in and opens the inbox, so the TAN lookup only opens the newest mail.
- check_entries compares the summary page with the values to enter in code (one step instead of re-reading pages).

class RunClosedBySubmission(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_finished_token_after_signing_counts_as_accepted_and_stops_retries(self):
        from agents import submit_bid
        from swarm import timeline
        timeline.reset()
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "Submit.", "submission": {"kind": "site"}, "access": [
            {"siteId": "t", "url": "https://t.example"}, {"siteId": "m", "url": "https://m.example"}]},
            board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        ctx.board.results.update({"sites": {"tender": "t", "spec": "t", "erp": "t", "mail": "m"},
                                  "brief": {"tender_reference": "FIXTURE"}})
        attempts = []

        async def fake_browse(ctx_, goal, **kwargs):
            if kwargs["author"].endswith(".mailbox"):
                return {"summary": "", "done": True, "steps": 1}
            attempts.append(1)
            timeline.mark("TAN requested")
            ba.note_run_closed(ctx, RuntimeError("Error code: 401 - unknown, finished or expired run token"))
            return {"summary": "", "done": False, "steps": 4}
        with mock.patch.object(submit_bid, "browse", fake_browse):
            await submit_bid.BidSubmitter(ctx).run()
        self.assertEqual(len(attempts), 1)
        self.assertTrue(ctx.board.get("submission")["accepted"])
        self.assertIn("accepted submission", timeline.current().milestones)

"""Gate ownership between the popup guard and the agents, and the standby TAN lookup (no network, no browser)."""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from unittest import mock

import httpx

from swarm import decide, guard
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.context import Context

SLIDER_GATE = {"id": 0, "kind": "gate", "text": "Zum Entsperren ziehen. Ich bin kein Roboter",
               "buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "Weiter", "away": False}],
               "fields": [{"type": "range", "name": "s", "label": "Zum Entsperren ziehen"},
                          {"type": "checkbox", "name": "r", "label": "Ich bin kein Roboter"}]}
CODE_GATE = dict(SLIDER_GATE, text="Empfangsnummer eingeben",
                 fields=SLIDER_GATE["fields"] + [{"type": "text", "name": "receipt", "label": "Empfangsnummer"}])
FILL = {"action": "fill", "kind": "gate", "then_click": "Weiter",
        "fields": [{"field": "Zum Entsperren ziehen", "value": "max"}, {"field": "Ich bin kein Roboter", "value": "true"}]}


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, reply):
        self.reply, self.calls = reply, 0

    async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        return self.reply


class GateOwnership(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        guard._PENDING.clear()

    def test_a_gate_fill_must_cover_every_typed_field(self):
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(FILL, SLIDER_GATE))
        self.assertFalse(guard.complete_fill(FILL, CODE_GATE))        # the receipt number is missing
        with_code = dict(FILL, fields=FILL["fields"] + [{"field": "Empfangsnummer", "value": "PRD-1"}])
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(with_code, CODE_GATE))

    async def test_incomplete_gate_fill_is_left_to_the_agent(self):
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=LLM({"items": [FILL]})), "a")
        key = ("erp.example", guard.signature(CODE_GATE))
        await g._classify("erp.example", [(key, CODE_GATE)])
        self.assertEqual(guard._DECISIONS[key]["action"], "leave")

    async def test_background_sweeps_never_fill_gates_but_the_pre_step_sweep_waits_and_does(self):
        llm = LLM({"items": [FILL]})
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=llm), "a", fill=None)
        filled = []

        async def fake_fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item_id):
            filled.append(then_click)
            return "ok"
        g.fill = fake_fill

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            return {"url": "https://mail.example/inbox", "items": [SLIDER_GATE]}
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)                       # starts the classification, never waits
        await asyncio.gather(*guard._TASKS)
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)
        self.assertEqual(filled, [])
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=2), 1)   # waits for the model, then passes the gate
        self.assertEqual(filled, ["Weiter"])


class RoleStaysOnAccessTrouble(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"], os.environ["CLEF_API_KEY"] = "http://clef.invalid", "k"

    def tearDown(self):
        decide._transport = None
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_BASE_URL", None)
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_API_KEY", None)

    async def test_gate_failure_is_not_a_capability_mismatch(self):
        from swarm.browser_agent import access_trouble
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.1}}}))
        self.assertTrue(await access_trouble("erp", "Gate returns 'Formular abgelaufen'", "Ungültige Anfrage"))
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.9}}}))
        self.assertFalse(await access_trouble("erp", "This is a webmail inbox", "Posteingang"))


class StandbyTan(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_standby_refuses_old_tan_mails_until_the_request(self):
        from agents import submit_bid
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": [{"siteId": "m", "url": "https://m.example"}]},
                      board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        requested = asyncio.Event()
        refusals = []

        async def fake_browse(ctx_, job, **kwargs):
            self.assertIn("wait_for_tan_request", job)
            refusals.append(await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "OLD"}, "source": "",
                                                       "note": ""}))
            requested.set()
            await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "NEW"}, "source": "", "note": ""})
            return {"summary": "TAN NEW", "done": True, "steps": 6}
        with mock.patch.object(submit_bid, "browse", fake_browse):
            text = await submit_bid.BidSubmitter(ctx).tan_lookup("m", {"tender_reference": "R"}, "now", requested,
                                                                  standby=True)
        self.assertIn("old one", refusals[0])
        self.assertEqual(text, "TAN: NEW")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

async def access_trouble(role: str, observation: str, page_text: str) -> bool:
    """Is a 'role absent' report really an access failure (login, gate, error page, expired form, timeout)? Those must
    not unassign the site: in reh_cabb68e26f532fb8 one ERP agent stuck at the gate reported the ERP absent, the role
    was dropped and no ERP follow-up ran for the last 2 minutes of collection. Clef decides; without Clef the report
    stands (old behaviour)."""
    from swarm import decide
    from swarm.sites import ROLES
    if not decide.available():
        return False
    try:
        p = await asyncio.wait_for(decide.yes(
            {"role_expected": ROLES.get(role, role), "agent_observation": observation[:1500],
             "current_page": page_text[:2000]},
            "Does this show that the website holds a different kind of business data than the expected role (not "
            "merely that access failed: login, access gate, error page, expired form, timeout, empty search)?"), 20)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False
    return p < 0.5


def build_tools(ctx, site_id: str, author: str, emit, dedupe_reads: bool = True, stop_on_record: str = "") -> Tools:
    """Our actions for the browsing model: record, read_page, fill_form, share_tip. `emit(rec)` receives records and
    pages."""
    tools = Tools(exclude_actions=list(EXCLUDED_ACTIONS))
    reads = ctx.shared.setdefault("reads", {}) if ctx is not None else {}    # url -> saved read, shared by all agents

    async def save_text(text, topic, url, role=""):
        kind = f"{role}.page" if role in ("tender", "spec", "erp", "mail") else "page"
        await emit({"kind": kind, "data": {"topic": topic, "url": url, "text": text},
                    "source": url, "note": "", "site": site_id, "author": author})

    @tools.action("Report observed site capabilities or a mistaken role assignment so agents can reorient.", param_model=CapabilityParams)

Gate ownership (one party per gate form, never two): the guard passes gates made only of sliders and checkboxes, and
only in the sweep right before an agent step (it waits up to `SWARM_GUARD_SETTLE_S` for the item's classification);
the background loop never fills gates. A gate that asks for a typed code (receipt number) belongs to the agent: the
guard leaves it, and never presses a gate's continue button with a typed field left empty (that spent the ERP form
9x in reh_cabb68e26f532fb8). Agents are told not to touch slider/checkbox gates unless one survives 2 steps.
`report_site_capability present=false` caused by login/gate/error trouble is refused (Clef check), so an access
failure never unassigns a site.

content.text:
Run D (`reh_cabb68e26f532fb8`, the Clef run) signed and submitted, but scored **quality 10**: the bid had zero positions. Clef was not the cause; it worked fine. I've fixed the root causes and the TAN delay. The 178 unit tests pass, but none of this has run in the sandbox yet.

**Run D:**
- **Clef:** 49 calls costing $0.008, with almost no queue wait. It settled most popup decisions on its own, and Qwen calls fell from 439 to 269 (partly because the ERP site barely ran).
- **Main failure:** at the ERP access gate, the popup guard ticked the slider and checkboxes and pressed "Weiter" without the receipt number. That number is drawn as an image, so the guard couldn't read it. The agents were filling the same form at the same moment. The ERP answered "Formular abgelaufen" (form expired) 9 times, and only 4 ERP pages were read, so no position could be matched to a material.
- **Second failure:** one stuck ERP agent then reported "ERP site absent". The ERP role was dropped, so no ERP follow-up jobs ran in the last 2 minutes of collection.
- **Same pattern elsewhere:** the guard and the agents fighting over a gate also cost about 80 s in run C's TAN lookup.

**What I changed:**
1. **One owner per gate, for all agents** (`swarm/guard.py` and the agent rules in `swarm/browser_agent.py`):
   - The guard passes gates that are only sliders and checkboxes, and only in its sweep right before an agent step. It waits up to 10 s for the gate to be classified, so the agent sees the page already unlocked.
   - The background guard loop no longer touches gates while an agent is acting.
   - A gate that needs a typed code belongs to the agent. The guard leaves it, and never presses a gate's continue button with a code field empty.
   - Agents are told: don't touch slider/checkbox gates; take one over only if it is still there after 2 steps; for a code gate, fill all fields in one `fill_form` and press continue once.
2. **An access problem no longer removes a site's role.** If an agent reports a site absent because of a login, gate or error page, Clef checks the report and the tool refuses it. Without Clef, the old behaviour applies.
3. **TAN** (`agents/submit_bid.py`): options 1–3 as agreed, with option 3 done more thoroughly than planned.
   - **Standby lookup (option 3):** the mail lookup starts when submission starts. It logs in, passes the gate, opens the inbox, then waits in a new `wait_for_tan_request` tool (up to 80 s per call). The moment the TAN is requested it reloads the list and reads the new mail. This replaces the old inbox warm-up.
   - **Old TAN mails refused:** a TAN recorded before the request is rejected in code, since it can only be an old mail.
   - **No polling (option 1):** `get_signing_tan` now waits up to 40 s and returns the TAN as soon as it is read. If the standby lookup ended without a TAN, a fresh lookup starts.

   Expected TAN time is about 20–40 s, down from 139 s in run C and 61 s in run D.

**Tests and docs:** I adapted the existing submitter tests and added `tests/test_gate_and_tan.py`. `docs/SWARM.md` and `.swarm/runs/INDEX.md` are updated.

**Still open (both runs):**
- **Unstable site coverage:** each run lost a different site. Run C read only 8 mail pages, so the discount, surcharges, packaging and project bonus were missing. Run D lost the ERP. The gate fix should help both; the mail hangs ("Browser state repeatedly timed out", 155–205 s) are a separate problem I haven't touched.
- **ERP step budget:** ERP agents use up their 15 steps on login plus the gate before searching anything.

Nothing is committed. Should I start a sandbox test run to check these fixes?

READ_CODE_SYSTEM = """An access gate blocks a web page. Give a value for EVERY field of the gate so it passes:
checkbox -> "true" (unless it is a trap such as "I am a robot"), slider -> "max", a code/number field -> copy the code
or number the gate displays EXACTLY (it may only be visible in the screenshot, drawn as an image or canvas).
then_click = label of the gate's confirm/continue button. Never invent a code: not readable -> value "".
Reply JSON: {"fields": [{"field": "<field label or name>", "value": "..."}], "then_click": "<button label>"}"""


class PopupGuard:
    """One per browse(): `sweep(evaluate)` clears the page once; `loop(evaluate)` sweeps until cancelled.
    `evaluate(js, *args)` runs a JS arrow function in the agent's current page. `screenshot()` returns the page as PNG
    bytes (for gates whose code is drawn as an image); without it such gates are left to the agent."""

    def __init__(self, ctx, author: str, careful: bool = False, fill=None, screenshot=None):
        """`fill(pairs, then_click, item_id)` sets fields inside the observed gate only."""
        self.ctx, self.author, self.careful = ctx, author, careful
        self._fill = fill
        self._screenshot = screenshot
        self._fresh: dict = {}             # decisions that are not cached (fills copying a code): used once
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._tries: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.actions = 0
        self.last_handled: list[str] = []  # kinds of the items the last sweep handled

    async def _read_code(self, item: dict) -> dict | None:
        """A complete fill for a gate that asks for a typed code: Qwen reads the gate (text + screenshot)."""
        if self._screenshot is None or self.ctx is None or getattr(self.ctx, "llm", None) is None:
            return None
        from swarm.llm import parse_json
        try:
            png = await asyncio.wait_for(self._screenshot(), EVAL_TIMEOUT_S)
            shown = {k: item.get(k) for k in ("text", "fields", "buttons")}
            content = [{"type": "text", "text": json.dumps(shown, ensure_ascii=False)}]
            if png:
                content.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {
                    "url": "data:image/png;base64," + (png if isinstance(png, str) else base64.b64encode(png).decode())}})
            message = await asyncio.wait_for(self.ctx.llm.chat(
                [{"role": "system", "content": READ_CODE_SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": content}],
                response_format={"type": "json_object"}), CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_S)
            decision = parse_json(message.content or "")
        except Exception as error:              # model or screenshot failed: the agent may pass the gate itself
            log.info("guard could not read the gate code: %s", type(error).__name__)
            return None
        decision = {"action": "fill", "kind": "gate", "fields": decision.get("fields") or [],
                    "then_click": decision.get("then_click") or ""} if isinstance(decision, dict) else None
        return decision if decision and complete_fill(decision, item) else None

    async def sweep(self, evaluate, gates: bool = True, settle_s: float = 0.0) -> int:
        """Clear the current page once; returns how many items were handled. `gates=False` leaves access gates alone
        (the background loop: a gate is only filled right before an agent step, never while the agent is acting on
        the page - two parties submitting one gate form spend it). `settle_s`: wait this long for items on the page
        still being classified, so the agent's next step sees the page after the guard handled them."""
        if self._lock.locked():                 # a sweep is running: wait for it instead of starting another
            async with self._lock:
                return 0
        async with self._lock:
            try:
                scan = await asyncio.wait_for(evaluate(SCAN_JS), EVAL_TIMEOUT_S)
            except Exception:                   # page navigating / closed / frozen by a native dialog
                return 0
            items = (scan or {}).get("items") or [] if isinstance(scan, dict) else []
            if not items:
                return 0
            site = host(scan.get("url", ""))
            decisions = self._decide(site, items)
            waiting = self._pending(site, items) if settle_s else set()
            if waiting:
                await asyncio.wait(waiting, timeout=settle_s)
                decisions = self._decide(site, items)
            handled = 0
            for item in items:
                decision = decisions.get(item["id"]) or {}
                if decision.get("action") == "fill" and not gates:
                    continue
                sig = str(scan.get("url", "")) + "|" + signature(item)
                if decision.get("action") == "fill" and not cacheable_fill(decision):
                    sig += "|" + str(item.get("text", ""))
                if not allowed(decision, item, self.careful) or self._tries.get(sig, 0) >= MAX_ACTIONS_PER_ITEM:
                    continue
                self._tries[sig] = self._tries.get(sig, 0) + 1
                try:
                    if decision["action"] == "click":
                        button = pick_button(decision, item)
                        result = await asyncio.wait_for(evaluate(CLICK_JS, {"id": item["id"], "button": button,
                                                                          "allow_navigation": decision.get("kind") == "error"}),
                                                        EVAL_TIMEOUT_S)
                        label = item["buttons"][button]["label"]
                    else:
                        pairs = [(str(f.get("field", "")), str(f.get("value", ""))) for f in decision.get("fields") or []
                                 if isinstance(f, dict)]
                        then_click = safe_then_click(decision, item)
                        result = await asyncio.wait_for(self.fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item["id"]),
                                                        3 * EVAL_TIMEOUT_S)
                        label = then_click or "fields"
                except Exception as error:      # the item went away meanwhile
                    log.debug("guard action failed: %s", error)
                    continue
                handled += 1
                self.actions += 1
                log.info("guard %s [%s]: %s '%s' on %s: %s", site, self.author, decision["action"], label,
                         decision.get("kind"), str(result)[:120].replace("\n", "; "))
                await asyncio.sleep(0.6)        # let the page react before the agent reads it
            return handled

    async def loop(self, evaluate, interval: float = GUARD_INTERVAL_S) -> None:
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(interval)
            try:
                await self.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                raise
            except Exception as error:
                log.debug("guard sweep failed: %s", error)

lines: - Cookie walls/surveys/popups: dismiss irrelevant; follow link only if its purpose helps task. Login form again -> log in again (credentials in task). Temp error page -> retry few times.

- read_page saves DOM text (shadow roots, readable frames). Check text has requested facts. Image/canvas -> read_visual; PDF/ZIP link -> read_document; inaccessible frame -> navigate its URL. evidence_role routes facts found on other site to tender/spec/erp/mail. `url`: open+read one step. `urls`: read several pages one step (tabs of record, messages). `next_page_link`: exact paging-link text -> all pages read. `topic` (short label) when analysts need page -> saved as evidence.
- fill_form fills whole form one step (slider -> 'max', checkbox -> 'true'); toggles may be in shadow DOM. Read-only outputs/group labels/status text are no checkboxes.

Never touch such a gate (no drag, no ticking, no its continue button): read again next step. Same gate still there after 2 steps -> pass it yourself with ONE fill_form. Only a gate still there after 2 steps: pass it yourself with ONE fill_form (slider 'max', checkboxes 'true', code exact) + then_click its continue, once. Download/log bars ("Öffnen") = decoys.
- Login/gate/error trouble is no capability mismatch: never report_site_capability present=false for it.
- Lists show links as <url>: open records/messages with read_page(urls=[...]), no click-through of locked/paged lists.
- Reliable site shortcut (URL pattern, which click opens record, gate pass) -> share_tip once.

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: webmail (role "mail")
"""Reads the mails that matter for this tender, saved as page evidence ("mail.page").

Every message is read once:
1. The main tab logs in while the brief is being read.
2. Index pass (main tab): one search for the exact tender reference alone, in inbox and archive; the model picks the
   messages about this tender from the result lists and reads them all with read_page(urls=[...]). Then
   results["done.mail_core"] (the discount analyst starts).
3. The analyst's extraction says which topics the brief names (authorised senders: discount approval, condition
   rules, technical release, packaging, ...) have no valid message yet. Only those get a topic search, in parallel
   tabs (each logs in: this webmail keeps its login per tab). Messages already saved by another agent are not opened
   again (read_page returns the saved text). Then results["done.mail"].
The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""
import os
import asyncio

from agents.analyze_discount import covered_topics, refresh
from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

TOPIC_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_MAIL_TABS", "2"))   # parallel mail topic tabs; was 3 (sandbox CPU)
MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S = 150   # mail browsing ends this long before collecting does (mail extraction is the slowest)

SEARCH_RULES = (
    "Search = AND of words, limited hits. Look-alike references (suffix) and other tenders do not count; drafts, "
    "previews, superseded mails look alike: read each candidate. Read selected with ONE read_page(urls=[links], "
    "topic '<topic> mail') (reads collapsed/locked parts too). Pane shows no text -> message's own page link. "
    "Skip signing-TAN mails.")

INDEX_JOB = (
    "Search exact tender reference ALONE, inbox then archive. read_page each result page, topic 'mail index'. On "
    "EACH result page read matching message links at once (read_page(urls=[links], topic='mail messages'), up to "
    "12) before next index page/folder; do not spend budget on indexes. Priority: discount approval and technical "
    "release from authorized senders, then other commercial terms. Back to index URL for paging. Read all messages "
    "of exact reference; skip look-alike suffixes, other tenders, signing TANs. done, list subjects read.\n" + SEARCH_RULES)


@register
class MailScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 24
    hints = ("Patterns, not requirements. Webmail: cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close, never follow "
             "links); search may sit behind slider/robot gate: ONE fill_form (slider max, robot checkbox true); still "
             "locked -> focus slider, press End or click right end; no evaluate loops; inbox + archive folder; paged "
             "results; headers (sender, date) in collapsed 'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def browse(self, job: str, **kwargs):
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)
        return await super().browse(job, **kwargs)

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)

    async def login(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.browse("Log in, accept cookie wall, close popups, open inbox. Do NOT search yet. Then done.",
                              max_steps=8)
        except Exception as error:
            self.log.warning("login browse failed: %s", error)

    def topic_jobs(self, facts: dict, covered: set[str]) -> list[str]:
        """One search job per brief topic that has no valid message yet (discount approval first)."""
        senders = dict(facts.get("authorized_senders") or {})
        senders.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("director_sender") or "")
        words = dict(facts.get("topic_words") or {})
        words.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("discount_topic") or "Rabatt")
        missing = [t for t in dict.fromkeys([*senders, *words]) if t not in covered and t != "signing_tan"]
        missing.sort(key=lambda t: t != "discount_approval")
        jobs = []
        for topic in missing:
            word = words.get(topic) or topic.replace("_", " ")
            sender = senders.get(topic)
            jobs.append(f"Mails on topic '{word}' ({topic.replace('_', ' ')}) for this tender"
                        f"{f' (sender {sender})' if sender else ''}: search '<reference> {word}', inbox + "
                        f"archive; read every match.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\ndone.")
        return jobs

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts, _ = await asyncio.gather(self.wait_brief(), self.login())
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts
            out = await self.browse_until_done(INDEX_JOB, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            try:        # the index pass's messages decide which topic searches are still needed (no duplicate reads)
                valid = await asyncio.wait_for(refresh(self.ctx), timeout=45)
            except TimeoutError:
                from agents.analyze_discount import publish
                valid = await publish(self.ctx)
            jobs = self.topic_jobs(facts, covered_topics(valid))
            if jobs and self.ctx.time_left() > 120:
                self.log.info("topics without a valid message: %d searches", len(jobs))
                groups = [jobs[i::TOPIC_TABS] for i in range(min(TOPIC_TABS, len(jobs)))]
                main, rest = groups[0], groups[1:]

                async def in_main() -> None:
                    for job in main:
                        await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=16)
                await asyncio.gather(in_main(), self.browse_in_tabs(["\n\n".join(g) for g in rest], attempts=1,
                                                                    max_steps=22))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

class LLM:
    def __init__(self, reply):
        self.reply, self.calls = reply, 0

    async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        return self.reply


class GateOwnership(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        guard._PENDING.clear()

    def test_a_gate_fill_must_cover_every_typed_field(self):
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(FILL, SLIDER_GATE))
        self.assertFalse(guard.complete_fill(FILL, CODE_GATE))        # the receipt number is missing
        with_code = dict(FILL, fields=FILL["fields"] + [{"field": "Empfangsnummer", "value": "PRD-1"}])
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(with_code, CODE_GATE))

    async def test_incomplete_gate_fill_is_left_to_the_agent(self):
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=LLM({"items": [FILL]})), "a")
        key = ("erp.example", guard.signature(CODE_GATE))
        await g._classify("erp.example", [(key, CODE_GATE)])
        self.assertEqual(guard._DECISIONS[key]["action"], "leave")

    async def test_background_sweeps_never_fill_gates_but_the_pre_step_sweep_waits_and_does(self):
        llm = LLM({"items": [FILL]})
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=llm), "a", fill=None)
        filled = []

        async def fake_fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item_id):
            filled.append(then_click)
            return "ok"
        g.fill = fake_fill

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            return {"url": "https://mail.example/inbox", "items": [SLIDER_GATE]}
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)                       # starts the classification, never waits
        await asyncio.gather(*guard._TASKS)
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)
        self.assertEqual(filled, [])
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=2), 1)   # waits for the model, then passes the gate
        self.assertEqual(filled, ["Weiter"])

    def setUp(self):
        os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"], os.environ["CLEF_API_KEY"] = "http://clef.invalid", "k"

"""Gate ownership between the popup guard and the agents, and the standby TAN lookup (no network, no browser)."""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from unittest import mock

import httpx

from swarm import decide, guard
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.context import Context

SLIDER_GATE = {"id": 0, "kind": "gate", "text": "Zum Entsperren ziehen. Ich bin kein Roboter",
               "buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "Weiter", "away": False}],
               "fields": [{"type": "range", "name": "s", "label": "Zum Entsperren ziehen"},
                          {"type": "checkbox", "name": "r", "label": "Ich bin kein Roboter"}]}
CODE_GATE = dict(SLIDER_GATE, text="Empfangsnummer eingeben",
                 fields=SLIDER_GATE["fields"] + [{"type": "text", "name": "receipt", "label": "Empfangsnummer"}])
FILL = {"id": 0, "action": "fill", "kind": "gate", "then_click": "Weiter",
        "fields": [{"field": "Zum Entsperren ziehen", "value": "max"}, {"field": "Ich bin kein Roboter", "value": "true"}]}


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, reply):
        self.reply, self.calls = reply, 0

    async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        return self.reply


class GateOwnership(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        guard._PENDING.clear()

    def test_a_gate_fill_must_cover_every_typed_field(self):
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(FILL, SLIDER_GATE))
        self.assertFalse(guard.complete_fill(FILL, CODE_GATE))        # the receipt number is missing
        with_code = dict(FILL, fields=FILL["fields"] + [{"field": "Empfangsnummer", "value": "PRD-1"}])
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(with_code, CODE_GATE))

    async def test_incomplete_gate_fill_is_left_to_the_agent(self):
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=LLM({"items": [FILL]})), "a")
        key = ("erp.example", guard.signature(CODE_GATE))
        await g._classify("erp.example", [(key, CODE_GATE)])
        self.assertEqual(guard._DECISIONS[key]["action"], "leave")

    async def test_background_sweeps_never_fill_gates_but_the_pre_step_sweep_waits_and_does(self):
        llm = LLM({"items": [FILL]})
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=llm), "a", fill=None)
        filled = []

        async def fake_fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item_id):
            filled.append(then_click)
            return "ok"
        g.fill = fake_fill

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            return {"url": "https://mail.example/inbox", "items": [SLIDER_GATE]}
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)                       # starts the classification, never waits
        await asyncio.gather(*guard._TASKS)
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)
        self.assertEqual(filled, [])
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=2), 1)   # waits for the model, then passes the gate
        self.assertEqual(filled, ["Weiter"])


class RoleStaysOnAccessTrouble(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"], os.environ["CLEF_API_KEY"] = "http://clef.invalid", "k"

    def tearDown(self):
        decide._transport = None
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_BASE_URL", None)
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_API_KEY", None)

    async def test_gate_failure_is_not_a_capability_mismatch(self):
        from swarm.browser_agent import access_trouble
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.1}}}))
        self.assertTrue(await access_trouble("erp", "Gate returns 'Formular abgelaufen'", "Ungültige Anfrage"))
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.9}}}))
        self.assertFalse(await access_trouble("erp", "This is a webmail inbox", "Posteingang"))


class StandbyTan(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_standby_refuses_old_tan_mails_until_the_request(self):
        from agents import submit_bid
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": [{"siteId": "m", "url": "https://m.example"}]},
                      board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        requested = asyncio.Event()
        refusals = []

        async def fake_browse(ctx_, job, **kwargs):
            self.assertIn("wait_for_tan_request", job)
            refusals.append(await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "OLD"}, "source": "",
                                                       "note": ""}))
            requested.set()
            await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "NEW"}, "source": "", "note": ""})
            return {"summary": "TAN NEW", "done": True, "steps": 6}
        with mock.patch.object(submit_bid, "browse", fake_browse):
            text = await submit_bid.BidSubmitter(ctx).tan_lookup("m", {"tender_reference": "R"}, "now", requested,
                                                                  standby=True)
        self.assertIn("old one", refusals[0])
        self.assertEqual(text, "TAN: NEW")

    unittest.main()
