1	# OWNER: (shared)   ROLE: coordinator (model with reasoning; no browser of its own)
2	# NEEDS: every analyst's results   WRITES: results["gaps"], follow-up evidence through the scrapers' sites
3	"""Decides what the scrapers collect next, so the run ends COLLECT with the data the bid needs instead of with what
4	the first pass happened to save.
5	
6	While the first pass runs, the coordinator watches the board. As soon as a site's first pass and its analysis are done,
7	code lists the GAPS on that site: concrete facts the bid needs that no saved page holds (a position without a
8	matching material, a material without status / price scales / stock, a commercial key from the Q&A without its mail,
9	a usable-travel requirement without its technical release, no discount approval, ...). The model (with reasoning) turns
10	the gaps into a few focused jobs, one browser agent each, grouping what one agent can do in one go and skipping gaps the
11	saved pages show do not exist. Jobs run at once, in the site's browser (main tab when free, new tabs otherwise). After
12	each job the affected analyses run again on the new pages, which may reveal the next gaps.
13	
14	No gap is worked on twice, every job states exactly what to read (so no two agents collect the same thing), and a page
15	another agent already saved is not opened again (read_page returns the saved text). Follow-ups stop when nothing is
16	missing, nothing new can be tried, or the collect time is used up.
17	"""
18	import asyncio
19	import json
20	
21	from agents import analyze_discount, analyze_materials, analyze_quantities, analyze_requirements
22	from agents.compute_bid import INPUTS, compute, position_keys, valid_condition
23	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register, timeline
24	from swarm.extract import brief_intro, pages
25	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime
26	from swarm.scraper import run_job
27	
28	ROUND_MIN_S = 100        # a follow-up job needs at least this much collect time
29	JOB_STEPS = 16
30	MAX_JOBS = 6             # per planning call
31	MAX_JOBS_PER_ROLE = 3
32	MAX_RUNNING_PER_ROLE = 2  # follow-up browses at once on one site (each is a tab of that site's browser)
33	ANALYSIS_S = 60          # jobs stop this long before collect ends, so the analyses can still run on their pages
34	SETTLE_S = 45           # a site whose analysis has not finished this long after its first pass is treated as done
35	MAIL_EARLY_S = 30        # mail gaps may start this long after the mail index pass was analysed (topic searches go on)
36	REPLAN_S = 45            # an unchanged set of open gaps is offered to the planner again only after this long
37	
38	READY = {"tender": ("done.tender", "tender_final"), "spec": ("done.spec", "requirements_final"),
39	         "erp": ("done.erp", "materials"), "mail": ("done.mail", "mail_final")}
40	
41	KEY_SECTIONS = {"konditionsgruppe": ("condition_rules", "condition rules (Konditionsregeln)"),
42	                "packaging_tariff": ("packaging_tariffs", "packaging tariff"),
43	                "delivery_key": ("delivery_commitments", "delivery commitment"),
44	                "setup_pool": ("setup_pools", "setup pool fee"),
45	                "bonus_plan": ("project_bonus", "project bonus bands")}
46	
47	SYSTEM = """You coordinate browser agents collecting data for a priced bid. Each site's scraper did a first pass. Input:
48	GAPS (facts bid still needs), what each site holds, topics already saved.
49	Write follow-up jobs: one job = one browser agent, one site, few sentences: what to open/search, which topic label to
50	read_page (e.g. 'erp prices <material>'). Gaps one agent can do together -> one job (max 3 gaps); jobs run in parallel.
51	Name exact identifiers (material numbers, keys, references).
52	Skip optional gap only with direct quote from observed page evidence showing data does not exist (e.g. no Q&A at
53	all). Topic label or scraper summary is no absence evidence. Never skip missing tender positions or spec requirements.
54	Never ask for already-saved page unless it lacked the needed part (name the part, e.g. quantity-scale register).
55	Also given: brief_rules (what the bid must contain: use to judge which gap matters most), position_status (per
56	position: requirement, material or reason none, what is missing), running_now (jobs in progress: do not repeat them),
57	time_left_s (little time -> only gaps that unblock a price; skip nice-to-have), earlier_followups (done=false: change
58	approach, e.g. other tab/register/search term).
59	Order jobs by value: gaps that block a position's price first.
60	Reply JSON: {"jobs": [{"role": "tender|spec|erp|mail", "gaps": ["gap id", ...], "job": "..."}],
61	"skipped": [{"id": "gap id", "source": "observed page URL", "quote": "exact absence evidence"}]}"""
62	
63	SITES = {"tender": "tender portal: tender overview, documents (bill of quantities), bidder Q&A",
64	         "spec": "buyer's portal: technical specification revisions and requirement tables",
65	         "erp": "our ERP: material search help, material records (technical data, status, lead times), price "
66	                "conditions with quantity scales, stock per storage location",
67	         "mail": "our webmail: approvals and release mails (discount, condition rules, technical release, packaging, "
68	                 "delivery, setup pools, project bonus, FX, price indices)"}
69	
70	
71	def _attrs(req: dict) -> str:
72	    return ", ".join(f"{k} {req.get(k)}" for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
73	                                                     "certification") if req.get(k))
74	
75	
76	def find_gaps(board, ready: set[str], saved_topics: dict[str, list[str]]) -> list[dict]:
77	    """The facts the bid still needs, per site, from the results of the analyses that are ready. Plain code."""
78	    gaps: dict[str, dict] = {}
79	
80	    def gap(role: str, gid: str, need: str) -> None:
81	        if role in ready:
82	            gaps.setdefault(gid, {"id": gid, "role": role, "need": need})
83	
84	    brief = board.get("brief") or {}
85	    tender = board.get("tender") or {}
86	    positions = tender.get("positions") or []
87	    requirements = board.get("requirements") or {}
88	    materials = board.get("materials") or {}
89	    erp = board.get("erp") or {}
90	    mail = board.get("mail") or {}
91	    erp_materials = {norm_ref(k): v for k, v in (erp.get("materials") or {}).items()}
92	    scenario = to_datetime(brief.get("scenario_date"))
93	    if "tender" in ready and not positions:
94	        gap("tender", "tender positions", "bill of quantities / position overview: positions, quantities, units, "
95	                                          "requirement references")
96	    if positions and not tender.get("clarifications"):
97	        gap("tender", "tender q&a", "bidder Q&A of the tender, all pages (if the tender has any)")
98	    if (board.get("discount") or {}).get("source") in ("no valid approval found", "latest approval invalid"):
99	        gap("mail", "mail discount", f"sales director's discount approval for {brief.get('tender_reference')} "
100	                                     "(inbox and archive)")
101	    clarifications = tender.get("clarifications") or []
102	    for p in positions:
103	        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
104	        ref = p.get("requirement_ref")
105	        req = next((v for k, v in requirements.items() if norm_ref(k) == norm_ref(ref)), None)
106	        if req is None:
107	            gap("spec", f"spec requirement {ref}", f"requirement {ref} of the CURRENT specification revision (bore, "
108	                                                   "stroke, pressure, mounting, certification, catalogue group)")
109	            continue
110	        group = req.get("kataloggruppe") or ""
111	        if req.get("stroke_kind") == "usable":
112	            releases = mail.get("technical_release") or {}
113	            if not releases:
114	                gap("mail", "mail technical release",
115	                    f"technical release mail with end reserves per stroke end (revision {req.get('revision')}"
116	                    f"{', key ' + str(req.get('reserve_key')) if req.get('reserve_key') else ''})")
117	        for key, value in position_keys(clarifications, pos)["keys"].items():
118	            section, label = KEY_SECTIONS.get(key, (None, None))
119	            if section and norm_ref(value) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (mail.get(section) or {})}:
120	                gap("mail", f"mail {section} {norm_ref(value)}", f"{label} mail for key {value}")
121	        m = materials.get(pos) or {}
122	        if not m:
123	            gap("erp", f"erp search {group or ref}", f"Find materials for requirement {ref}: {_attrs(req)}")
124	            continue
125	        mat = m.get("material")
126	        if not mat:
127	            searched = any(norm_ref(group) and norm_ref(group) in norm_ref(t) for t in saved_topics.get("erp", []))
128	            in_group = [v["material"] for v in erp_materials.values()
129	                        if norm_ref(v.get("kataloggruppe")) == norm_ref(group)] if group else []
130	            if not searched and not in_group:
131	                gap("erp", f"erp search {group or ref}", f"search result list of catalogue group {group} "
132	                                                         f"(requirement {ref}: {_attrs(req)})")
133	            elif m.get("reason") == "only blocked matches":
134	                gap("erp", f"erp status {group or ref}", f"status (active/blocked, from record and status legend) of "
135	                                                         f"{[c['material'] for c in m.get('candidates') or []]}: all "
136	                                                         f"read as blocked for requirement {ref}")
137	            else:
138	                gap("erp", f"erp records {group or ref}", f"record pages (technical data incl. stroke and "
139	                                                          f"certification, status) of materials {in_group or 'of group ' + group}: "
140	                                                          f"none matched requirement {ref} ({_attrs(req)}) on the pages "
141	                                                          "read")
142	            continue
143	        info = erp_materials.get(norm_ref(mat)) or {}
144	        missing = [a for a in m.get("unverified") or []]
145	        if info.get("lead_time_production_weeks") in (None, ""):
146	            missing.append("lead times")
147	        if position_keys(clarifications, pos)["keys"].get("packaging_tariff") and not info.get("pieces_per_carton"):
148	            missing.append("pieces per carton")
149	        if missing:
150	            gap("erp", f"erp record {norm_ref(mat)}", f"record of material {mat} (all tabs, status legend): "
151	                                                      f"{', '.join(dict.fromkeys(missing))} not read")
152	        conds = [c for c in erp.get("conditions") or [] if norm_ref(c.get("material")) == norm_ref(mat)]
153	        cond = valid_condition(conds, mat, scenario)
154	        if not conds:
155	            gap("erp", f"erp prices {norm_ref(mat)}", f"price condition records of material {mat} with quantity scales")
156	        elif cond is None:
157	            gap("erp", f"erp prices {norm_ref(mat)}", f"price condition of material {mat} valid on "
158	                                                      f"{brief.get('scenario_date')} (read: "
159	                                                      f"{[(c.get('valid_from'), c.get('valid_to')) for c in conds]}; "
160	                                                      "other condition records/periods)")
161	        elif not cond.get("scales"):
162	            gap("erp", f"erp prices {norm_ref(mat)}", f"quantity scales of the valid price condition of {mat} (open "
163	                                                      "the quantity-scale register)")
164	        elif norm_ref(cond.get("currency") or "EUR") != "EUR" and \
165	                norm_ref(cond.get("currency")) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (mail.get("fx_fixing") or {})}:
166	            gap("mail", f"mail fx {norm_ref(cond.get('currency'))}", f"FX fixing mail for {cond.get('currency')} "
167	                                                                     f"(key {cond.get('fx_key')})")
168	        if norm_ref(mat) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (erp.get("stock") or {})}:
169	            gap("erp", f"erp stock {norm_ref(mat)}", f"stock of material {mat} at storage-location level")
170	        index = info.get("metal_index")
171	        if index and norm_ref(index) not in {norm_ref(k) for k in (mail.get("price_indices") or {})}:
172	            gap("mail", f"mail price index {norm_ref(index)}", f"metal price index mail for {index} valid on "
173	                                                               f"{brief.get('scenario_date')}")
174	    # What the calculation itself still misses (a condition without price unit, a pool fee, a carton size, ...):
175	    # checks above establish that a topic exists; these establish that the value the bid needs is usable.
176	    for dep in dependency_gaps(board):
177	        if dep["role"] not in ready:
178	            continue
179	        have = gaps.get(dep["id"])
180	        if have is None:
181	            gaps[dep["id"]] = {"id": dep["id"], "role": dep["role"], "need": dep["need"]}
182	        elif dep["need"] not in have["need"]:
183	            have["need"] += f"; calculation needs: {dep['need']}"
184	    return list(gaps.values())
185	
186	
187	def dependency_gaps(board) -> list[dict]:
188	    """The bid calculation's open dependencies on the sites (not the ones on other positions), with the positions
189	    each one blocks. Material matching is left to find_gaps' search/record gaps (more specific)."""
190	    try:
191	        bid = compute({n: board.get(n) for n in INPUTS})
192	    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a half-collected board: the gaps above still apply
193	        return []
194	    return [{"id": d["id"], "role": d["role"], "need": f"{d['need']} (positions {', '.join(d['positions'])})"}
195	            for d in (bid.get("dependencies") or {}).values()
196	            if d["role"] in READY and d.get("kind") != "material"]
197	
198	
199	async def refresh(ctx, roles: set[str]) -> None:
200	    """Run the analyses that depend on new pages of `roles` again (each failure is only logged)."""
201	    steps = []
202	    if "tender" in roles:
203	        steps += [analyze_quantities.refresh]
204	    if roles & {"tender", "spec"} and pages(ctx, "spec"):
205	        steps += [analyze_requirements.refresh]
206	    if "mail" in roles:
207	        steps += [analyze_discount.refresh]
208	    if pages(ctx, "erp"):
209	        steps += [analyze_materials.refresh]
210	    for step in steps:
211	        try:
212	            await step(ctx)
213	        except Exception as error:
214	            ctx.board.error("CollectionCoordinator", f"refresh {step.__module__}: {error}")
215	
216	
217	@register
218	class CollectionCoordinator(Agent):
219	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
220

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: webmail (role "mail")
"""Reads the mails that matter for this tender, saved as page evidence ("mail.page").

Every message is read once:
1. The main tab logs in while the brief is being read.
2. Index pass (main tab): one search for the exact tender reference alone, in inbox and archive; the model picks the
   messages about this tender from the result lists and reads them all with read_page(urls=[...]). Then
   results["done.mail_core"] (the discount analyst starts).
3. The analyst's extraction says which topics the brief names (authorised senders: discount approval, condition
   rules, technical release, packaging, ...) have no valid message yet. Only those get a topic search, in parallel
   tabs (each logs in: this webmail keeps its login per tab). Messages already saved by another agent are not opened
   again (read_page returns the saved text). Then results["done.mail"].
The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""
import os
import asyncio

from agents.analyze_discount import covered_topics, refresh
from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

TOPIC_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_MAIL_TABS", "2"))   # parallel mail topic tabs; was 3 (sandbox CPU)
MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S = 150   # mail browsing ends this long before collecting does (mail extraction is the slowest)

SEARCH_RULES = (
    "Search = AND of words, limited hits. Look-alike references (suffix) and other tenders do not count; drafts, "
    "previews, superseded mails look alike: read each candidate. Read selected with ONE read_page(urls=[links], "
    "topic '<topic> mail') (reads collapsed/locked parts too). Pane shows no text -> message's own page link. "
    "Skip signing-TAN mails.")

INDEX_JOB = (
    "Search exact tender reference ALONE, inbox then archive. read_page each result page, topic 'mail index'. On "
    "EACH result page read matching message links at once (read_page(urls=[links], topic='mail messages'), up to "
    "12) before next index page/folder; do not spend budget on indexes. Priority: discount approval and technical "
    "release from authorized senders, then other commercial terms. Back to index URL for paging. Read all messages "
    "of exact reference; skip look-alike suffixes, other tenders, signing TANs. done, list subjects read.\n" + SEARCH_RULES)


@register
class MailScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 24
    hints = ("Patterns, not requirements. Webmail: cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close, never follow "
             "links); list and reader may sit behind slider/robot gate (guard passes it: never touch it, read again); "
             "inbox + archive folder; paged "
             "results; headers (sender, date) in collapsed 'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def browse(self, job: str, **kwargs):
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)
        return await super().browse(job, **kwargs)

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)

    async def login(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.browse("Log in, accept cookie wall, close popups, open inbox. Do NOT search yet. Then done.",
                              max_steps=8)
        except Exception as error:
            self.log.warning("login browse failed: %s", error)

    def topic_jobs(self, facts: dict, covered: set[str]) -> list[str]:
        """One search job per brief topic that has no valid message yet (discount approval first)."""
        senders = dict(facts.get("authorized_senders") or {})
        senders.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("director_sender") or "")
        words = dict(facts.get("topic_words") or {})
        words.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("discount_topic") or "Rabatt")
        missing = [t for t in dict.fromkeys([*senders, *words]) if t not in covered and t != "signing_tan"]
        missing.sort(key=lambda t: t != "discount_approval")
        jobs = []
        for topic in missing:
            word = words.get(topic) or topic.replace("_", " ")
            sender = senders.get(topic)
            jobs.append(f"Mails on topic '{word}' ({topic.replace('_', ' ')}) for this tender"
                        f"{f' (sender {sender})' if sender else ''}: search '<reference> {word}', inbox + "
                        f"archive; read every match.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\ndone.")
        return jobs

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts, _ = await asyncio.gather(self.wait_brief(), self.login())
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts
            out = await self.browse_until_done(INDEX_JOB, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            try:        # the index pass's messages decide which topic searches are still needed (no duplicate reads)
                valid = await asyncio.wait_for(refresh(self.ctx), timeout=45)
            except TimeoutError:
                from agents.analyze_discount import publish
                valid = await publish(self.ctx)
            jobs = self.topic_jobs(facts, covered_topics(valid))
            if jobs and self.ctx.time_left() > 120:
                self.log.info("topics without a valid message: %d searches", len(jobs))
                groups = [jobs[i::TOPIC_TABS] for i in range(min(TOPIC_TABS, len(jobs)))]
                main, rest = groups[0], groups[1:]

                async def in_main() -> None:
                    for job in main:
                        await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=16)
                await asyncio.gather(in_main(), self.browse_in_tabs(["\n\n".join(g) for g in rest], attempts=1,
                                                                    max_steps=22))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

"""Reads the mails that matter for this tender, saved as page evidence ("mail.page").

Every message is read once:
1. The main tab logs in while the brief is being read.
2. Index pass (main tab): one search for the exact tender reference alone, in inbox and archive; the model picks the
   messages about this tender from the result lists and reads them all with read_page(urls=[...]). Then
   results["done.mail_core"] (the discount analyst starts).
3. The analyst's extraction says which topics the brief names (authorised senders: discount approval, condition
   rules, technical release, packaging, ...) have no valid message yet. Only those get a topic search, in parallel
   tabs (each logs in: this webmail keeps its login per tab). Messages already saved by another agent are not opened
   again (read_page returns the saved text). Then results["done.mail"].
The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""
import os
import asyncio

from agents.analyze_discount import covered_topics, refresh
from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

TOPIC_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_MAIL_TABS", "2"))   # parallel mail topic tabs; was 3 (sandbox CPU)
MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S = 150   # mail browsing ends this long before collecting does (mail extraction is the slowest)

SEARCH_RULES = (
    "Search = AND of words, limited hits. Look-alike references (suffix) and other tenders do not count; drafts, "
    "previews, superseded mails look alike: read each candidate. Read selected with ONE read_page(urls=[links], "
    "topic '<topic> mail') (reads collapsed/locked parts too). Pane shows no text -> message's own page link. "
    "Skip signing-TAN mails.")

INDEX_JOB = (
    "Search exact tender reference ALONE, inbox then archive. read_page each result page, topic 'mail index'. On "
    "EACH result page read matching message links at once (read_page(urls=[links], topic='mail messages'), up to "
    "12) before next index page/folder; do not spend budget on indexes. Priority: discount approval and technical "
    "release from authorized senders, then other commercial terms. Back to index URL for paging. Read all messages "
    "of exact reference; skip look-alike suffixes, other tenders, signing TANs. done, list subjects read.\n" + SEARCH_RULES)


@register
class MailScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "mail"
    browser = 3
    max_steps = 24
    hints = ("Patterns, not requirements. Webmail: cookie wall after login; maintenance popups (close, never follow "
             "links); list and reader may sit behind slider/robot gate (guard passes it: never touch it, read again); "
             "inbox + archive folder; paged "
             "results; headers (sender, date) in collapsed 'envelope/headers' section, which read_page includes.")

    async def browse(self, job: str, **kwargs):
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)
        return await super().browse(job, **kwargs)

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", MAIL_STOP_EXTRA_S)

    async def login(self) -> None:
        try:
            await self.browse("Log in, accept cookie wall, close popups, open inbox. Do NOT search yet. Then done.",
                              max_steps=8)
        except Exception as error:
            self.log.warning("login browse failed: %s", error)

    def topic_jobs(self, facts: dict, covered: set[str]) -> list[str]:
        """One search job per brief topic that has no valid message yet (discount approval first)."""
        senders = dict(facts.get("authorized_senders") or {})
        senders.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("director_sender") or "")
        words = dict(facts.get("topic_words") or {})
        words.setdefault("discount_approval", facts.get("discount_topic") or "Rabatt")
        missing = [t for t in dict.fromkeys([*senders, *words]) if t not in covered and t != "signing_tan"]
        missing.sort(key=lambda t: t != "discount_approval")
        jobs = []
        for topic in missing:
            word = words.get(topic) or topic.replace("_", " ")
            sender = senders.get(topic)
            jobs.append(f"Mails on topic '{word}' ({topic.replace('_', ' ')}) for this tender"
                        f"{f' (sender {sender})' if sender else ''}: search '<reference> {word}', inbox + "
                        f"archive; read every match.\n{SEARCH_RULES}\ndone.")
        return jobs

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            facts, _ = await asyncio.gather(self.wait_brief(), self.login())
            facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or facts
            out = await self.browse_until_done(INDEX_JOB, attempts=2)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            try:        # the index pass's messages decide which topic searches are still needed (no duplicate reads)
                valid = await asyncio.wait_for(refresh(self.ctx), timeout=45)
            except TimeoutError:
                from agents.analyze_discount import publish
                valid = await publish(self.ctx)
            jobs = self.topic_jobs(facts, covered_topics(valid))
            if jobs and self.ctx.time_left() > 120:
                self.log.info("topics without a valid message: %d searches", len(jobs))
                groups = [jobs[i::TOPIC_TABS] for i in range(min(TOPIC_TABS, len(jobs)))]
                main, rest = groups[0], groups[1:]

                async def in_main() -> None:
                    for job in main:
                        await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=16)
                await asyncio.gather(in_main(), self.browse_in_tabs(["\n\n".join(g) for g in rest], attempts=1,
                                                                    max_steps=22))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail_core", True)
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.mail", True)

each page action (`GuardedTools.act`): when it had to clear something that appeared after the model looked, the
action is not executed and the model gets a short note ("not executed: a gate covered the page; look again"), with
its memory intact. Gates: sliders/checkboxes are filled from the cached decision; a gate asking for a typed code
(receipt number drawn in a canvas) is read by Qwen from a screenshot (`read_code`) and filled completely, or not at
all - a continue button is never pressed with a typed field empty (that spent the ERP form 9x in
reh_cabb68e26f532fb8). One gate submission per site at a time (`gate:<host>` lock, tabs share the session). The
background loop clicks noise only, and never while an agent action runs. The sweep before a step waits up to
`SWARM_GUARD_SETTLE_S` for items still being classified. An agent passes a gate itself only if it survives 2 steps.

content.text:
Done. Run E is still running; it uses the earlier package, so none of the changes below are in it, and none have been tested in the sandbox yet. The 179 unit tests pass.

**Yes, the guard now owns every block, and agents never touch one:**
- **Check before every action:** the guard checks the page before each step and before every page action (click, type, read). If a popup, notice, error page or gate appeared after the model looked, the guard clears it and that action is not run. The model gets a note ("not executed: a gate covered the page, look again") and keeps its memory, so no information is lost. Actions that don't touch the page (record, done, navigate) skip the check.
- **Code gates** (like the ERP receipt number drawn as an image) are now handled by the guard too. It takes a screenshot, Qwen reads the code, and the guard fills every field and presses continue once. If it can't read every field, it presses nothing.
- **One gate submission per site at a time**, since tabs share the login; a second submit spoils the first.
- **No overlap with agents:** the background sweep only clears noise, and never while an agent action is running.
- **Prompts:** the agent rules and the ERP and mail hints no longer tell agents to work gates. An agent passes a gate itself only if one survives 2 steps.

**Missing information** (what went wrong in run C):
1. **Coordinator:** at 7:40 it found 14 mail gaps (discount, packaging, conditions, bonus...). Its planning call ran with thinking on and timed out twice (110 s), so no mail follow-up ran. Fixed:
   - thinking is off;
   - there is a 40 s budget, after which every gap gets a direct job ("find and read X") and the browsing agent still decides where to look;
   - gaps the model neither plans nor proves absent also get direct jobs;
   - up to 3 follow-ups run at once per site (was 2).
2. **Mail ran one stage after another:** log in, index pass, extraction, then topic searches. The first mail page arrived at 6:00, and only 8 pages were read. Now the topic searches (discount, condition rules, packaging, delivery, bonus, price index, FX...) run in 2 tabs alongside the index pass from the start. Messages both find are opened only once.

**Speed over tokens:** the extra parallel mail searches and direct follow-up jobs spend more model calls in exchange for earlier data.

**Risk:** more tabs at once means more CPU load in the sandbox (up to 3 mail tabs, 6 ERP tabs).

Nothing is committed. When run E finishes I'll report whether the first gate fix worked. Then I'd start run F with everything above.

def make_session(ctx, tab: Tab, vision: bool = False) -> BrowserSession:
    """Attach to `tab` of the run's CDP browser (locally browser-use starts its own Chromium; HEADLESS=1 hides it)."""
    urls = browsers.cdp_urls()
    cls = RobustSession if vision else TextSession
    profile = dict(allowed_domains=allowed_domains(ctx.task), enable_default_extensions=False, keep_alive=True)
    if urls:
        session = cls(cdp_url=urls[tab.browser % len(urls)], **profile)
        session._tab = tab
        return session
    return cls(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1", window_size={"width": 1280, "height": 800}, **profile)


async def _evaluate(browser_session: BrowserSession, js: str, *args):
    page = await browser_session.must_get_current_page()
    raw = await page.evaluate(js, *args)
    try:
        return json.loads(raw) if isinstance(raw, str) and raw[:1] in ("[", "{") else raw
    except ValueError:
        return raw


async def _drag(browser_session: BrowserSession, x0: float, x1: float, y: float) -> None:
    """A real (trusted) mouse drag from x0 to x1: some sliders ignore values set by script."""
    cdp = await browser_session.get_or_create_cdp_session()
    send = cdp.cdp_client.send.Input.dispatchMouseEvent

"""Gate ownership between the popup guard and the agents, and the standby TAN lookup (no network, no browser)."""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from unittest import mock

import httpx

from swarm import decide, guard
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.context import Context

SLIDER_GATE = {"id": 0, "kind": "gate", "text": "Zum Entsperren ziehen. Ich bin kein Roboter",
               "buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "Weiter", "away": False}],
               "fields": [{"type": "range", "name": "s", "label": "Zum Entsperren ziehen"},
                          {"type": "checkbox", "name": "r", "label": "Ich bin kein Roboter"}]}
CODE_GATE = dict(SLIDER_GATE, text="Empfangsnummer eingeben",
                 fields=SLIDER_GATE["fields"] + [{"type": "text", "name": "receipt", "label": "Empfangsnummer"}])
FILL = {"id": 0, "action": "fill", "kind": "gate", "then_click": "Weiter",
        "fields": [{"field": "Zum Entsperren ziehen", "value": "max"}, {"field": "Ich bin kein Roboter", "value": "true"}]}


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, reply):
        self.reply, self.calls = reply, 0

    async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        return self.reply


class GateOwnership(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        guard._PENDING.clear()

    def test_a_gate_fill_must_cover_every_typed_field(self):
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(FILL, SLIDER_GATE))
        self.assertFalse(guard.complete_fill(FILL, CODE_GATE))        # the receipt number is missing
        with_code = dict(FILL, fields=FILL["fields"] + [{"field": "Empfangsnummer", "value": "PRD-1"}])
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(with_code, CODE_GATE))

    async def test_code_gate_is_read_from_a_screenshot_and_passed_by_the_guard(self):
        class VisionLLM(LLM):
            async def chat(self, messages, **kwargs):
                self.calls += 1
                self.image = messages[1]["content"][1]["image_url"]["url"]
                return NS(content=json.dumps({"then_click": "Weiter", "fields": FILL["fields"] + [
                    {"field": "Empfangsnummer", "value": "PRD-7"}]}))
        llm = VisionLLM({"items": [FILL]})                         # the classifier forgot the code field
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=llm), "a", screenshot=lambda: asyncio.sleep(0, "iVBOR"))
        filled = []

        async def fake_fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item_id):
            filled.append(dict(pairs))
            return "ok"
        g.fill = fake_fill

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            return {"url": "https://erp.example/notice", "items": [CODE_GATE]}
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=2), 1)
        key = ("erp.example", guard.signature(CODE_GATE))
        self.assertEqual(guard._DECISIONS[key]["action"], "read_code")
        self.assertEqual(filled[0]["Empfangsnummer"], "PRD-7")
        self.assertTrue(llm.image.startswith("data:image/png;base64,"))
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False), 0)  # never between steps

    async def test_an_action_planned_before_a_block_appeared_is_not_executed(self):
        from swarm.browser_agent import GuardedTools
        tools = GuardedTools()
        ran = []

        async def blocked(name):
            ran.append(name)
            return "not executed: a gate covered the page"
        tools.before_action = blocked
        action = NS(model_dump=lambda exclude_unset: {"click": {"index": 3}})
        result = await tools.act(action, browser_session=None)
        self.assertIn("not executed", result.extracted_content)
        self.assertEqual(ran, ["click"])
        from swarm.browser_agent import PAGE_FREE_ACTIONS
        self.assertTrue({"done", "record", "navigate"} <= PAGE_FREE_ACTIONS)   # no guard wait before these

    async def test_background_sweeps_never_fill_gates_but_the_pre_step_sweep_waits_and_does(self):
        llm = LLM({"items": [FILL]})
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=llm), "a", fill=None)
        filled = []

        async def fake_fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item_id):
            filled.append(then_click)
            return "ok"
        g.fill = fake_fill

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            return {"url": "https://mail.example/inbox", "items": [SLIDER_GATE]}
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)                       # starts the classification, never waits
        await asyncio.gather(*guard._TASKS)
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)
        self.assertEqual(filled, [])
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=2), 1)   # waits for the model, then passes the gate
        self.assertEqual(filled, ["Weiter"])


class RoleStaysOnAccessTrouble(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"], os.environ["CLEF_API_KEY"] = "http://clef.invalid", "k"

    def tearDown(self):
        decide._transport = None
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_BASE_URL", None)
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_API_KEY", None)

    async def test_gate_failure_is_not_a_capability_mismatch(self):
        from swarm.browser_agent import access_trouble
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.1}}}))
        self.assertTrue(await access_trouble("erp", "Gate returns 'Formular abgelaufen'", "Ungültige Anfrage"))
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.9}}}))
        self.assertFalse(await access_trouble("erp", "This is a webmail inbox", "Posteingang"))


class StandbyTan(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_standby_refuses_old_tan_mails_until_the_request(self):
        from agents import submit_bid
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": [{"siteId": "m", "url": "https://m.example"}]},
                      board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        requested = asyncio.Event()
        refusals = []

        async def fake_browse(ctx_, job, **kwargs):
            self.assertIn("wait_for_tan_request", job)
            refusals.append(await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "OLD"}, "source": "",
                                                       "note": ""}))
            requested.set()
            await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "NEW"}, "source": "", "note": ""})
            return {"summary": "TAN NEW", "done": True, "steps": 6}
        with mock.patch.object(submit_bid, "browse", fake_browse):
            text = await submit_bid.BidSubmitter(ctx).tan_lookup("m", {"tender_reference": "R"}, "now", requested,
                                                                  standby=True)
        self.assertIn("old one", refusals[0])
        self.assertEqual(text, "TAN: NEW")


if __name__ == "__main__":

content.text:
Run F (`reh_3d86cd104c8eb1b5`, `run_21a14cabac180468`) has started with everything below. Run E is still running on the earlier package. A background check reports when each run finishes. The 180 unit tests pass and the in-page JS parses, but none of this has run in a real browser yet.

**Real-time guard:**
- **Change counter:** a `MutationObserver` inside each page counts every change that could be a block: a dialog, modal, slider or checkbox appearing, or a fixed overlay covering part of the screen. It is detected from the page code, not from screenshots.
- **Fast polling:** the guard reads that counter every 0.5 s (it used to scan every 4 s) and runs the full scan only when the counter moved or a new page loaded.
- **Before each action:** a quick counter read; the full check runs only on a change or when a gate is still waiting to be handled. Screenshots are used only to read codes drawn as images.
- **Agents never touch a block:** the guard clears it, the action that was planned on the old page is skipped, and the agent keeps its memory.

**Speed (CPU no longer limited):**

| Setting | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen calls at once | 16 | 30 (team limit 32) |
| ERP tabs | 6 | 8 |
| Mail topic tabs next to the index pass | 2, after the index | 3, at the same time |
| Coordinator follow-ups | 2 per site, 6 jobs | 4 per site, 8 jobs |
| Actions per browsing step | 4 | 6 (fewer model calls) |

**Missing information:** the coordinator no longer uses thinking and has a 40 s budget. If planning fails, or a gap is neither planned nor proven absent, it still gets a direct "find and read this" job. In run C that failure left the discount, surcharges, packaging and bonus empty.

**Risk:** 8 ERP tabs is the setting that stalled every browser once in the past. If run F shows browser-state timeouts, I'll lower it.

Nothing is committed. I'll report E and F when they finish: score, positions entered, ERP and mail page counts, guard skips and gate passes, and TAN time.

lines: - Cookie walls/surveys/popups: dismiss irrelevant; follow link only if its purpose helps task. Login form again -> log in again (credentials in task). Temp error page -> retry few times.

- read_page saves DOM text (shadow roots, readable frames). Check text has requested facts. Image/canvas -> read_visual; PDF/ZIP link -> read_document; inaccessible frame -> navigate its URL. evidence_role routes facts found on other site to tender/spec/erp/mail. `url`: open+read one step. `urls`: read several pages one step (tabs of record, messages). `next_page_link`: exact paging-link text -> all pages read. `topic` (short label) when analysts need page -> saved as evidence.
- fill_form fills whole form one step (slider -> 'max', checkbox -> 'true'); toggles may be in shadow DOM. Read-only outputs/group labels/status text are no checkboxes.

-- A guard owns every block: cookie walls, surveys, notices, error pages and access gates (slider, checkboxes, codes to copy). It clears them before your step and before each action. Never interact with a block (no clicking, dragging, ticking or typing in it): an action answered "not executed: ... covered the page" -> just look again and go on. Only a gate still there after 2 steps: pass it yourself with ONE fill_form (slider 'max', checkboxes 'true', code exact) + then_click its continue, once. Download/log bars ("Öffnen") = decoys.

l["rebate_report"] = None if l.get("bonus_unknown") else round_cents(l.get("bonus", D0))

    # 5. lead times: delivery commitment, else shared stock all-or-nothing per material
    demand: dict[str, int] = {}
    for l in lines.values():
        if not l.get("material") or not l.get("pieces"):
            continue
        demand[norm_ref(l["material"])] = demand.get(norm_ref(l["material"]), 0) + l["pieces"]
    stock = {norm_ref(k): v for k, v in (erp.get("stock") or {}).items()}
    for pos, l in priced.items():
        m, fields = norm_ref(l["material"]), l["fields"]
        delivery_key = l["keys"].get("delivery_key")
        commit = (mail.get("delivery_commitments") or {}).get(norm_ref(delivery_key)) if delivery_key else None
        if commit and norm_ref(commit.get("material")) == m and to_decimal(commit.get("max_total_pieces")) is not None \
                and demand[m] <= to_decimal(commit["max_total_pieces"]) and to_decimal(commit.get("weeks")) is not None:
            l["lead"] = int(to_decimal(commit["weeks"]))
            fields["lead"] = "verified: delivery commitment"
            continue
        why = ""
        if delivery_key and not commit:
            why = "delivery commitment missing"
            deps.need(pos, f"mail delivery_commitments {norm_ref(delivery_key)}", "mail",
                      f"delivery commitment mail for key {delivery_key}")
        elif commit:
            why = ("commitment is for another material" if norm_ref(commit.get("material")) != m else
                   "commitment does not cover the demand" if to_decimal(commit.get("max_total_pieces")) is not None
                   else "commitment unreadable")
        free = to_decimal((stock.get(m) or {}).get("free"))
        stock_weeks = to_decimal(l["erp"].get("lead_time_stock_weeks"))
        prod_weeks = to_decimal(l["erp"].get("lead_time_production_weeks"))
        if free is None:
            deps.need(pos, f"erp stock {m}", "erp", f"stock of material {l['material']} at storage-location level")
        chosen = stock_weeks if (free is not None and free >= demand[m]) else prod_weeks
        l["lead"] = int(chosen) if chosen is not None else None
        if l["lead"] is None:
            issues.append(f"{pos}: lead time unknown")
            fields["lead"] = "missing"
            deps.need(pos, f"erp record {norm_ref(l['material'])}", "erp", f"lead times (stock / production) of material {l['material']}")
        else:
            source = "stock" if (free is not None and free >= demand[m]) else "production"
            open_why = [why] if why in ("delivery commitment missing", "commitment unreadable") else []
            if free is None:
                open_why.append("stock not read")
            fields["lead"] = (f"estimated: {source} lead time, {', '.join(open_why)}" if open_why
                              else f"verified: {source}" + (f" ({why})" if why else ""))
        if why == "commitment unreadable":
            deps.need(pos, f"mail delivery_commitments {norm_ref(delivery_key)}", "mail",
                      f"material, weeks and maximum pieces of the delivery commitment {delivery_key}")

    # 6. answer

content.content:
- Login: required; each run brings its own username and password in `access`
- Holds: Your company's materials, stock, lead times and price conditions with validity periods and quantity scales.
- What makes it hard: SAP-style transaction codes, an F4 search popup, status codes, a short session timeout.

### 4. Webmail (Werkpost, `mail`)
--
5. **Discount:** The most recent approval from the sales director for this exact tender; otherwise 0 %.
6. **Lead time:** The from-stock lead time when stock covers the quantity, otherwise the production lead time.
7. **Total:** The sum of quantity times unit price, rounded half-up to the cent.
8. **Decision:** Bid, with one entry per tender position; no bid with no positions and a total of 0 when a material is missing.
9. **Partial submission:** Full credit requires every position, but the bid form lets you explicitly omit unfinished positions (Position auslassen / Teilpunkte). They receive no position points; completed positions retain their independent credit. Review lists the omitted position numbers. You must still sign and submit a bid; saving alone is not scored. A missing active material still calls for no_bid for full correctness; omission is a way to submit incomplete work, not a replacement decision rule.
--
23. **Packaging:** Q&A assigns the tariff key; ERP gives pieces per carton. Charge ceil(final pieces / carton size) cartons independently per position. Do not increase the bid quantity. Report packaging_per_unit in EUR, rounded HALF_UP; do not discount packaging.
24. **Delivery:** Q&A assigns a commitment key. Apply it only if its material matches and pooled final demand for that material is within its inclusive ceiling. Otherwise use shared-stock delivery. A commitment may differ by position even for the same material.
25. **Shared setup:** Q&A identifies pool members; ERP gives allocation mass (distinct from surcharge mass); the Rüstpools mail gives the one pool fee. Allocate by quantity × allocation mass using the cent-allocation rule in that mail. Add each allocation to that position's ordinary setup fee. Report surcharge_per_unit BEFORE discount, excluding packaging and bonus.
26. **Project bonus:** The finance mail gives marginal percentage bands. Compute the eligible undiscounted EUR goods total, apply each band only to its portion, round the aggregate credit HALF_UP to cents, then allocate proportionally to eligible line goods values using largest remainders in cents (ties: ascending position identifier). Report rebate_total as the allocated EUR CREDIT FOR THE ENTIRE POSITION, not per piece; enter zero for nonmembers. This bonus is independent of discount clauses.
27. **Final price:** Clause-discounted EUR base + clause-discounted mass surcharge + (ordinary setup + allocated shared setup + carton cost − allocated project bonus) / final piece quantity. Use unrounded per-piece components and round HALF_UP once at the end. Sum quantity × rounded final unit price for total_net. Rounded breakdown fields are reports, not inputs to that final formula.
--

- **Quality:** 0 to 100. Every field of the bid is compared with the one correct answer: tender reference, positions, materials, quantities, unit prices, lead times, discount and total, each position's base price and surcharge per piece, packaging, allocated project bonus, and whether the total adds up.
- **Eligibility:** The right tender reference; a wrong decision loses quality points but other correct fields keep their credit. A bid that is not eligible ranks after every eligible one.
- **Cost:** Every model call goes through the proxy and is priced per model. There is no budget: at equal quality, cost × time decides.
- **Time:** Wall-clock time from the start of the run until the answer is accepted. It weighs as much as cost: halving either halves cost × time.

8. **Decision:** Bid, with one entry per tender position; no bid with no positions and a total of 0 when a material is missing.
9. **Partial submission:** Full credit requires every position, but the bid form lets you explicitly omit unfinished positions (Position auslassen / Teilpunkte). They receive no position points; completed positions retain their independent credit. Review lists the omitted position numbers. You must still sign and submit a bid; saving alone is not scored. A missing active material still calls for no_bid for full correctness; omission is a way to submit incomplete work, not a replacement decision rule.
--
23. **Packaging:** Q&A assigns the tariff key; ERP gives pieces per carton. Charge ceil(final pieces / carton size) cartons independently per position. Do not increase the bid quantity. Report packaging_per_unit in EUR, rounded HALF_UP; do not discount packaging.
24. **Delivery:** Q&A assigns a commitment key. Apply it only if its material matches and pooled final demand for that material is within its inclusive ceiling. Otherwise use shared-stock delivery. A commitment may differ by position even for the same material.
25. **Shared setup:** Q&A identifies pool members; ERP gives allocation mass (distinct from surcharge mass); the Rüstpools mail gives the one pool fee. Allocate by quantity × allocation mass using the cent-allocation rule in that mail. Add each allocation to that position's ordinary setup fee. Report surcharge_per_unit BEFORE discount, excluding packaging and bonus.
26. **Project bonus:** The finance mail gives marginal percentage bands. Compute the eligible undiscounted EUR goods total, apply each band only to its portion, round the aggregate credit HALF_UP to cents, then allocate proportionally to eligible line goods values using largest remainders in cents (ties: ascending position identifier). Report rebate_total as the allocated EUR CREDIT FOR THE ENTIRE POSITION, not per piece; enter zero for nonmembers. This bonus is independent of discount clauses.
27. **Final price:** Clause-discounted EUR base + clause-discounted mass surcharge + (ordinary setup + allocated shared setup + carton cost − allocated project bonus) / final piece quantity. Use unrounded per-piece components and round HALF_UP once at the end. Sum quantity × rounded final unit price for total_net. Rounded breakdown fields are reports, not inputs to that final formula.
--

- **Quality:** 0 to 100. Every field of the bid is compared with the one correct answer: tender reference, positions, materials, quantities, unit prices, lead times, discount and total, each position's base price and surcharge per piece, packaging, allocated project bonus, and whether the total adds up.
- **Eligibility:** The right tender reference; a wrong decision loses quality points but other correct fields keep their credit. A bid that is not eligible ranks after every eligible one.
- **Cost:** Every model call goes through the proxy and is priced per model. There is no budget: at equal quality, cost × time decides.
- **Time:** Wall-clock time from the start of the run until the answer is accepted. It weighs as much as cost: halving either halves cost × time.

Run E finished with **quality 96.1**, the best so far. All 5 positions were entered and signed; the only lost points were 3 lead times. Time was 18:42, almost the full 20 minutes.

| | Time |
|---|---|
| Collection (all 5 positions complete) | 9:11 |
| Wizard, 5 positions | 320 s |
| TAN, request to entry | 238 s |

Clef handled 61 decisions for about $0.01, and the ERP gate passed with no "form expired" errors. Most of the remaining time goes into submission.

**Why the TAN was still slow:**
- **Locked inbox:** in the waiting mail lookup, the inbox stayed empty behind a gate that showed "Entsperrt" (unlocked). The list only appears after a page reload. The guard had also stopped retrying, because its 4-try limit was per lookup and that lookup stays open for minutes.
- **Restart:** both browsers had 30 s page-state timeouts at the same moment. The submitter restarted and the TAN lookup logged in again, which cost about 70 s.

**Fixed since E (in run G):**
- The guard may try the same block again after 30 s.
- Agents and the TAN jobs now reload the page when a gate shows unlocked but the content stays empty.
- **Submitter in flash mode:** short replies (no separate reasoning pass), but it keeps its full history and a running log of which wizard step holds which position. It should take about half the time per step. `check_entries` still compares every entered value with the bid before signing, and `SWARM_SUBMIT_FLASH=0` switches back. This is the riskiest change for quality.
- **Lead times:** the calculator treated every delivery commitment as "for another material". The brief says a commitment can apply to one position and not another with the same material, so the commitment materials were probably read wrong. The log now records which material each commitment names, so the next run will show it.

**Running now:**
- **F** (`reh_3d86cd104c8eb1b5`): real-time guard, more parallelism, coordinator fix, mail topic searches in parallel.
- **G** (`reh_3d75a2747df66520`): F plus the fixes above.

Both are watched in the background and logged in `INDEX.md`. All 180 unit tests pass. Nothing is committed.

**Earlier, already completed:**
- Compress Qwen prompts and hints with the Caveman skill without losing each agent's purpose.
- Give the coordinator more context.
- Fix signing failures.

**Requests in this segment, in order:**
1. Analyze where Qwen and Clef fit best and move tasks to the right model (done).
2. Run a second sandbox test in the background and monitor its completion (done: run D).
3. Find ways to speed up the TAN. The user asked for options before any code, then said: "implement 1, 2, 3. Also with the gate fight - I believe it is needed for all agents, so they do not interfere against the guard."
4. "Before writing code, evaluate clef run and analyze what can be done better, than continue with TAN changes creating the best solution of all current problems that deliver perfect quality and good run speed."
5. "start sandbox run" (run E).
6. "is it possible, that the guard agent stops the exploring agent as soon as the block is spotted? I don't want the explorers to interact with blocks at all and loose any information. Also start working towards the fix of information missing. It should collect all important information as fast and as precise as possible"
7. "Also one addition. Speed right now is more important, so use as many token as possible for reaching max speed. Keep the quality as precise as possible"
8. "CPU load is not the concern. If there is more to push for - push and than run the sandbox. Also the guard models should scan changes in the realtime. Maybe detect the changes in the website code programatically, not only through screenshots which is slower"

**Standing rules (from CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and memory):**
- Never read, print or commit `.env` or API keys.
- Never copy scenario values from logs, screenshots or answers into the package (code, prompts, notes).
- Never commit `.integration/` or `.swarm/`.
- Never force-push; never push to main.
- No ranked `atira submit` without team agreement.
- Only inspect run data for runs the user identifies as theirs or that were launched for them.
- Commit via PowerShell (the Entire hook hangs under Git Bash).
- Don't block on long waits; use background checks.
- Save pulled run data to `.swarm/runs/` and update `INDEX.md`.
- Caveman style for replies; code, commits and PRs written normally.
- Nothing has been committed yet; all changes are uncommitted on branch `someimprovementsidk`.

2. Key Technical Concepts:

**Swarm architecture:**
- Phases: COLLECT → VERIFY → COMPUTE → SUBMIT, with a blackboard.
- Scrapers:
  - tender, browser 0;
  - spec, browser 1;
  - ERP, browser 2, with `ERP_TABS` tabs;
  - mail, browser 3: index pass plus topic tabs.
- Analysts extract pages to JSON via Qwen (`swarm/extract.py`); business rules are applied in code.
- CollectionCoordinator: code finds gaps, the model plans follow-up jobs, and jobs run via `run_job`.
- `BidCalculator` computes in code.
- `BidSubmitter` drives the tender wizard (browser 0) and gets the TAN from mail (browser 3).
- `WizardPrep` opens the wizard before collection ends.

**browser-use:**
- `Agent` with `on_step_start` / `on_step_end` hooks.
- `Tools.act(action, browser_session, ...)` is overridable; we subclass it as `GuardedTools`.
- Flash mode uses the compact `FLASH_SYSTEM`; `max_history_items`, `step_timeout`, `pause` / `stop` are available.
- The browser-state capture timeout is 30 s; `session._state_timeouts` ends the browse.

**Models:**
- Qwen (OpenAI SDK): every generative or value task — browsing, extraction, brief, coordinator planning, gate code reading via vision, `read_visual`.
- Clef (`swarm/decide.py`, POST `/v1/decide` with choice / noul / score questions): closed decisions — guard triage, site-role mapping, receipt sanity check, access-trouble check.
- Each Clef use falls back to Qwen or to the old behaviour.

**Guard (`swarm/guard.py`):**
- `SCAN_JS` finds dialogs, overlays, inline gates and short pages.
- Decisions are cached per (host, signature).
- Action kinds: click / fill / leave / read_code.
- `WATCH_JS` is a MutationObserver change counter used for real-time detection.

**Timing model:**
- A scored run is 20 min.
- `submit_reserve` is clamped to [600, 660] s; `FINAL_MARGIN_S` is 40.
- Collection ends early once all positions are complete.

**Score:** quality first, then cost × time.

**Fair-play constraints:**
- The model decides navigation.
- Helpers may parse, fill forms, page through model-selected results, and read codes at runtime.

3. Files and Code Sections:

**swarm/decide.py**
- Module docstring describes the Clef/Qwen split.
- Imports `from swarm import timeline`; calls are recorded with `timeline.add("model.call", "clef", started)`.
- New helpers:
  ```python
  def available() -> bool: return bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL") and os.environ.get("CLEF_API_KEY"))
  def picked(answer) -> tuple[str|None, float]  # choice + confidence
  ```
- `choose` now returns `picked(answers["q"])`.

**swarm/guard.py** (major rewrite)
- Constants:
  - `GUARD_INTERVAL_S = 4` (full sweep at least this often);
  - `GUARD_POLL_S = 0.5`;
  - `MAX_ACTIONS_PER_ITEM = 4`;
  - `RETRY_AFTER_S = 30`;
  - `CLASSIFY_TIMEOUT_S = 45`;
  - `EVAL_TIMEOUT_S = 10`;
  - `CLEF_KINDS` = cookie / survey / notice / banner / error / gate / content;
  - `CLEF_KIND_MIN = 0.75`, `CLEF_BUTTON_MIN = 0.6`, `CLEF_TIMEOUT_S = 20`;
  - `MAX_CLEF_BUTTONS = 9`;
  - `NO_TYPING` (field types that need no typed input).
- `WATCH_JS`:
  - installs a MutationObserver once per document (`window.__swarmWatch`);
  - increments `seq` when added or changed elements match `dialog, [role=dialog], [role=alertdialog], [aria-modal=true], input[type=range], [role=slider], iframe`, or are fixed/sticky elements covering ≥3% of the viewport;
  - returns `{seq, fresh}`.
- Helper functions:
  - `clef_question(item)`, `clef_decision(answers, buttons)`;
  - `typed_fields(item)`, `complete_fill(decision, item)` — a fill must give a value for every typed field;
  - `allowed()` permits `read_code` only when not careful.
- `READ_CODE_SYSTEM` prompt: Qwen reads gate field values from the item JSON plus a screenshot.
- `PopupGuard`:
  - constructor: `PopupGuard(ctx, author, careful=False, fill=None, screenshot=None)`;
  - state: `last_handled`, `_seen`, `open_gate`, `_tries` (dict sig → [tries, last_time]);
  - `_may_try(sig)`: a try counter that resets after `RETRY_AFTER_S`;
  - `_read_code(item)`: screenshot → `llm.chat` (image + JSON, `response_format` json) → `parse_json` → complete fill or None;
  - `_decide`: stores the classification task in `_PENDING[key]`;
  - `_pending(site, items)`;
  - `_triage`: Clef first; a Clef "gate" with typed fields becomes `{"action": "read_code", "kind": "gate", "by": "clef"}`;
  - `_classify`: Qwen handles the rest; a Qwen failure only leaves those items uncached; an incomplete fill becomes `read_code`;
  - `sweep(evaluate, gates=True, settle_s=0.0)`:
    - sets `open_gate`;
    - waits for pending classifications when `settle_s > 0`;
    - skips fill/read_code when `gates=False`;
    - takes a per-site lock `ctx.lock(f"gate:{site}")` around gate fills (`_gate_lock`, using `contextlib.nullcontext` without ctx);
    - records `last_handled` kinds;
  - `changed(evaluate, who)`: per-consumer change detection; a fresh document resets all consumers;
  - `loop(evaluate, interval, busy=None)`: polls every 0.5 s, skips while `busy()`, and runs a noise-only sweep on change or every `interval`.
- The log line now includes the decision source ("by" clef/qwen).

**swarm/browser_agent.py**
- Constants and prompts:
  - `GUARD_SETTLE_S = 10` (env `SWARM_GUARD_SETTLE_S`), `GUARD_SWEEP_S = 60`;
  - `CAREFUL_MEMORY` = "running log: each finished step -> what it holds (wizard step -> position, values entered), last action ok/failed, what is next";
  - `FLASH_SYSTEM` uses a `{memory}` placeholder.
- `SYSTEM_EXTRA` guard rule now reads:
  > "A guard owns every block: cookie walls, surveys, notices, error pages and access gates (slider, checkboxes, codes to copy). It clears them before your step and before each action. Never interact with a block … an action answered "not executed: ... covered the page" -> just look again and go on. Gate shows unlocked (e.g. "Entsperrt") but the list/content stays empty -> navigate to the current URL once (reload). Only a gate still there after 2 steps: pass it yourself with ONE fill_form … Download/log bars ("Öffnen") = decoys."

  plus: "Login/gate/error trouble is no capability mismatch: never report_site_capability present=false for it."
- `access_trouble(role, observation, page_text)`: a Clef yes/no check; `report_site_capability(present=false)` is refused when it returns True.
- `PAGE_FREE_ACTIONS = {done, record, share_tip, report_site_capability, get_signing_tan, wait_for_tan_request, wait, navigate, go_back}`.
- `class GuardedTools(Tools)`: `before_action` hook and an `acting` flag. When the hook returns a note, the action returns `ActionResult(extracted_content=note, long_term_memory=note)` without running.
- `build_tools` uses `GuardedTools`.
- `record` honours a refusal: `emit` returns `on_record`'s string, which becomes an `ActionResult` error.
- In `_browse`:
  - `screenshot()` via CDP `Page.captureScreenshot`;
  - the guard gets the screenshot callback;
  - `clear_page()` runs a sweep with settle (60 s cap);
  - `before_action(name)` sweeps only if `guard.changed(evaluate, "action")` or `guard.open_gate`; when something was handled it returns the "'X' not executed: a … covered the page after you looked; the guard cleared it…" note and counts `guard.skipped_actions`;
  - `before_step` calls `clear_page()`, then `guard.changed(evaluate, "action")` to set the baseline;
  - the loop runs with `busy=lambda: tools.acting`.
- Agent settings:
  - `max_actions_per_step` default 6 (was 4);
  - memory = `CAREFUL_MEMORY` if careful;
  - `max_history_items = HISTORY_ITEMS if flash and not careful else None`;
  - `step_timeout = 120 if flash and not careful else SUBMIT_STEP_TIMEOUT_S (75)`;
  - state-timeout threshold `(2 if flash and not careful else 1)`.

**swarm/sites.py**
- `clef_roles()`: one Clef choice question per missing role over the non-invalidated sites (needs ≥2 options), using the brief (8000 chars), sites and observations; keeps picks at confidence ≥ `CLEF_MIN = 0.85`.

**agents/submit_bid.py**

  - `class WaitParams`;

- Flow:
  - `tan_requested = asyncio.Event()`;

- `tan_lookup(mail_site, answer, started, requested, *, standby=False, requested_at="")`:

"""Gate ownership between the popup guard and the agents, and the standby TAN lookup (no network, no browser)."""
import asyncio
import json
import os
import unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
from unittest import mock

import httpx

from swarm import decide, guard
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.context import Context

SLIDER_GATE = {"id": 0, "kind": "gate", "text": "Zum Entsperren ziehen. Ich bin kein Roboter",
               "buttons": [{"i": 0, "label": "Weiter", "away": False}],
               "fields": [{"type": "range", "name": "s", "label": "Zum Entsperren ziehen"},
                          {"type": "checkbox", "name": "r", "label": "Ich bin kein Roboter"}]}
CODE_GATE = dict(SLIDER_GATE, text="Empfangsnummer eingeben",
                 fields=SLIDER_GATE["fields"] + [{"type": "text", "name": "receipt", "label": "Empfangsnummer"}])
FILL = {"id": 0, "action": "fill", "kind": "gate", "then_click": "Weiter",
        "fields": [{"field": "Zum Entsperren ziehen", "value": "max"}, {"field": "Ich bin kein Roboter", "value": "true"}]}


class LLM:
    def __init__(self, reply):
        self.reply, self.calls = reply, 0

    async def ask_json(self, system, user, **kwargs):
        self.calls += 1
        return self.reply


class GateOwnership(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        guard._PENDING.clear()

    def test_a_gate_fill_must_cover_every_typed_field(self):
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(FILL, SLIDER_GATE))
        self.assertFalse(guard.complete_fill(FILL, CODE_GATE))        # the receipt number is missing
        with_code = dict(FILL, fields=FILL["fields"] + [{"field": "Empfangsnummer", "value": "PRD-1"}])
        self.assertTrue(guard.complete_fill(with_code, CODE_GATE))

    async def test_code_gate_is_read_from_a_screenshot_and_passed_by_the_guard(self):
        class VisionLLM(LLM):
            async def chat(self, messages, **kwargs):
                self.calls += 1
                self.image = messages[1]["content"][1]["image_url"]["url"]
                return NS(content=json.dumps({"then_click": "Weiter", "fields": FILL["fields"] + [
                    {"field": "Empfangsnummer", "value": "PRD-7"}]}))
        llm = VisionLLM({"items": [FILL]})                         # the classifier forgot the code field
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=llm), "a", screenshot=lambda: asyncio.sleep(0, "iVBOR"))
        filled = []

        async def fake_fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item_id):
            filled.append(dict(pairs))
            return "ok"
        g.fill = fake_fill

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            return {"url": "https://erp.example/notice", "items": [CODE_GATE]}
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=2), 1)
        key = ("erp.example", guard.signature(CODE_GATE))
        self.assertEqual(guard._DECISIONS[key]["action"], "read_code")
        self.assertEqual(filled[0]["Empfangsnummer"], "PRD-7")
        self.assertTrue(llm.image.startswith("data:image/png;base64,"))
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False), 0)  # never between steps

    async def test_page_change_counter_tells_each_consumer_once(self):
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=None), "a")
        states = iter([{"seq": 1, "fresh": True}, {"seq": 1}, {"seq": 2}, {"seq": 2}, {"seq": 2}, {"seq": 1, "fresh": True},
                       {"seq": 1}])

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            self.assertIn("MutationObserver", js)
            return next(states)
        self.assertTrue(await g.changed(evaluate, "action"))       # new document
        self.assertTrue(await g.changed(evaluate, "loop"))         # first look of this consumer
        self.assertTrue(await g.changed(evaluate, "action"))       # a block-like change
        self.assertFalse(await g.changed(evaluate, "action"))
        self.assertTrue(await g.changed(evaluate, "loop"))         # the loop sees the same change once too
        self.assertTrue(await g.changed(evaluate, "action"))       # navigation: fresh document
        self.assertTrue(await g.changed(evaluate, "loop"))         # ... for every consumer

    async def test_an_action_planned_before_a_block_appeared_is_not_executed(self):
        from swarm.browser_agent import GuardedTools
        tools = GuardedTools()
        ran = []

        async def blocked(name):
            ran.append(name)
            return "not executed: a gate covered the page"
        tools.before_action = blocked
        action = NS(model_dump=lambda exclude_unset: {"click": {"index": 3}})
        result = await tools.act(action, browser_session=None)
        self.assertIn("not executed", result.extracted_content)
        self.assertEqual(ran, ["click"])
        from swarm.browser_agent import PAGE_FREE_ACTIONS
        self.assertTrue({"done", "record", "navigate"} <= PAGE_FREE_ACTIONS)   # no guard wait before these

    async def test_background_sweeps_never_fill_gates_but_the_pre_step_sweep_waits_and_does(self):
        llm = LLM({"items": [FILL]})
        g = guard.PopupGuard(NS(llm=llm), "a", fill=None)
        filled = []

        async def fake_fill(evaluate, pairs, then_click, item_id):
            filled.append(then_click)
            return "ok"
        g.fill = fake_fill

        async def evaluate(js, *args):
            return {"url": "https://mail.example/inbox", "items": [SLIDER_GATE]}
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)                       # starts the classification, never waits
        await asyncio.gather(*guard._TASKS)
        await g.sweep(evaluate, gates=False)
        self.assertEqual(filled, [])
        guard._DECISIONS.clear()
        self.assertEqual(await g.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=2), 1)   # waits for the model, then passes the gate
        self.assertEqual(filled, ["Weiter"])


class RoleStaysOnAccessTrouble(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"], os.environ["CLEF_API_KEY"] = "http://clef.invalid", "k"

    def tearDown(self):
        decide._transport = None
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_BASE_URL", None)
        os.environ.pop("CLEF_API_KEY", None)

    async def test_gate_failure_is_not_a_capability_mismatch(self):
        from swarm.browser_agent import access_trouble
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.1}}}))
        self.assertTrue(await access_trouble("erp", "Gate returns 'Formular abgelaufen'", "Ungültige Anfrage"))
        decide._transport = httpx.MockTransport(lambda r: httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"q": {"noul": 0.9}}}))
        self.assertFalse(await access_trouble("erp", "This is a webmail inbox", "Posteingang"))


class StandbyTan(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_standby_refuses_old_tan_mails_until_the_request(self):
        from agents import submit_bid
        ctx = Context(task={"brief": "", "access": [{"siteId": "m", "url": "https://m.example"}]},
                      board=Blackboard(), llm=None, pool=None)
        requested = asyncio.Event()
        refusals = []

        async def fake_browse(ctx_, job, **kwargs):
            self.assertIn("wait_for_tan_request", job)
            refusals.append(await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "OLD"}, "source": "",
                                                       "note": ""}))
            requested.set()
            await kwargs["on_record"]({"kind": "mail.tan", "data": {"tan": "NEW"}, "source": "", "note": ""})
            return {"summary": "TAN NEW", "done": True, "steps": 6}
        with mock.patch.object(submit_bid, "browse", fake_browse):
            text = await submit_bid.BidSubmitter(ctx).tan_lookup("m", {"tender_reference": "R"}, "now", requested,
                                                                  standby=True)

## atira
Atira Challenges: debug your team's agent system runs. Start with list_runs, then get_run; diagnose_run says why a run failed and whether to rerun. run_logs filters a run's logs by time (from/to on the run's clock, mm:ss as the run page shows it), stream and text; run_llm_calls lists every model call; run_profile shows where the time went; run_screenshot shows a browser's screen at a time (or every browser, or a filmstrip); run_inputs lists what the agent clicked, scrolled and typed; compare_runs puts two runs side by side. run_package shows the package a run or submission used (agent.json and its files) and saves it with out. test_run starts a test run from a folder; wait_for_run waits for it. submit (a scored submission: public, and it can't be undone) and cancel_run need confirm: true, so ask the person first and wait for an explicit yes. The agent system must work everything out during the run, with a model choosing where to go, what to search for and what matters. Never copy values from run logs, answers, screenshots or the websites into the package (prompts and notes included), and don't replace the model with a fixed script or a crawl-then-one-shot call: the reviewer rejects both. Rules at a glance: https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/fair-play.md

## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>

<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>

<?claude block s1?>

<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.
