173	  4 positions vs 1, without more failed browses.
174	
175	## Submission
176	
177	`WizardPrep` opens the bid wizard in browser 0's main tab near the end of collection (entering nothing); at submit
178	start the mail main tab logs in and opens the inbox (no search filter); `check_entries` compares the summary page
179	with the bid in code. `fill_form` prefers a real checkbox/switch over an `<output>` that echoes its text, and finds an
180	unlabelled checkbox by its neighbouring text (a shadow-DOM confirmation box once cost 3.5 signing minutes).

182	start, so 2-hour test runs show the timing of a scored run.

185	
186	- No scenario values anywhere (prices, material numbers, refs, logins, TANs, totals, dates, keys, transaction codes):
187	  not in prompts, hints, defaults, tests or notes. Tests use invented dummy data. Strategy is fine, values are not.
188	- The model decides where to go and what matters. Code may parse, page through model-selected results, validate,
189	  compute, fill forms. No fixed click paths, URL lists, or crawl-everything-then-one-prompt helpers.
190	- Only the provided CDP browsers; no extra Chromium; no hosts besides the platform and the 4 sites; models via the proxy.
191	- Do not write comments addressed to the reviewer.
192	
193	## Robustness settings (learned from the first sandbox runs)
194	
195	- No screenshots per step (`TextSession`): in the sandbox they stalled every step for 30 s. `read_page` covers canvas text.
196	- No browser-use loading animation: it loads a logo from an external host the sandbox cannot reach, which left the tab
197	  "loading" and every navigation in that browser timing out. `RobustSession` also stops a stuck load and retries once.
198	- Qwen's separate reasoning pass is off and replies are forced to a JSON object (`QwenChat`, `LLM.ask_json`): steps
199	  went from 10-75 s to a few seconds and the "invalid JSON / prose reply" failures stop.
200	- Scrapers, ERP items and the submitter retry an agent that stopped early, telling it what is already saved.
201	- Requirements are published early (as soon as a requirement table page is saved) so the ERP work starts sooner.
202	
203	## Speed (each browsing step is one model call of ~14 s, most of it queue wait: fewer sequential steps = faster)
204	
205	- Parallel tabs: the 4-browser limit does not limit tabs. Independent jobs run in tabs of their own (`Tab`,
206	  `browse_in_tabs`); tabs of one browser share its login cookies (most sites; the webmail asks each tab to log in).
207	  New tabs open next to the others in the browser's window (`TAB_WINDOWS=1`: a window each) and close when their job
208	  ends. An agent sees only its own tab and unowned ones (popups), never another agent's tab. Rule: one browse() per
209	  tab at a time.
210	- Every agent tab has focus emulation on: only one window/tab has the real focus, and without it typing and
211	  focus-dependent page scripts silently did nothing in the others.
212	- Lifecycle events are routed per tab (browser-use's single per-client handler dropped other tabs' load events, so
213	  each navigation in a second tab waited 3-8 s). A tab's later jobs continue from its current page.
214	- Flash mode for navigating/extracting agents (default): replies are memory + actions only, with a compact system
215	  prompt (~0.6k instead of ~5k tokens) and a 2000-token reply cap. The bid submitter keeps full reasoning (`flash=False`).
216	- Unused browser-use actions (web search, LLM extract, screenshots, file system, uploads) are excluded: smaller schema
217	  in every prompt, and no wasted steps on them.
218	- Prompt text (goals, hints, rules, tool descriptions) is written tersely: every word is resent on every step.
219	- Small jobs instead of big ones: an ERP job per search / material record / prices / stock finishes inside its step
220	  budget, and materials the search list already rules out are never opened.
221	- Logs: browser-use's own step logs are off (the platform keeps only the tail of a run's log, and they pushed the
222	  swarm's lines out); `browse` logs one line per step, and the board is summarised in one line after COLLECT.
223	
224	## Work split (3 people) and how to iterate on your part
225	
226	| Person | Agents | Iterate with |
227	| --- | --- | --- |
228	| A: tender + spec | `scrape_tender`, `scrape_spec`, `analyze_quantities`, `analyze_requirements` | `SWARM_ONLY=TenderScraper,QuantityAnalyzer` live; analysts on a saved board |
229	| B: ERP | `scrape_erp` (ErpScraper + its tab workers), `analyze_materials` | `SWARM_ONLY=ErpScraper,MaterialMatcher` on a board that has `requirements` |
230	| C: mail + shared | `scrape_mail`, `analyze_discount`, `compute_bid`, `submit_bid`, `swarm/*` | analysts/calculator on a saved board; `tests/test_rules.py` |
231	
232	Loop: run your scraper live once -> it dumps `.swarm/board.json` -> replay your analyst on it as often as needed
233	(`SWARM_BOARD_IN`) -> check the result keys -> tune the goal/hints (strategy only) or the extraction shape -> repeat.
234	Then a sandbox test run (`atira test-run .`) to check timing; debug with `atira logs <run>`.
235	
236	## Open items
237	
238	- Tune goals/hints per site from test-run logs (`atira` MCP: `run_logs`, `run_llm_calls`, `run_screenshot`).
239	- Submitter: watch the first real runs closely (wizard order, TAN timing).
240	- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.
241	
242	
243	## Workflow safeguards and evaluation
244	
245	Requirements are published as specification pages arrive; ERP keeps accepting new requirements until final analysis.
246	Mail stops 150 seconds before the submission reserve, and every completed mail/ERP extraction is retained immediately.
247	At the collection cutoff the orchestrator reconciles completed extractions without another model call.
248	
249	Model attempts time out after 55 seconds (`SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S`); browsing and analyst calls share a concurrency
250	limit of 16. A run has its own monotonic clock. Collection children and guard tasks are cancelled and awaited before
251	signing. Local runs launch persistent CDP browsers so a resumed wizard keeps its tab and login.
252	
253	The submitter starts a background TAN lookup and polls it while retaining the portal wizard. A replacement request
254	explicitly invalidates that lookup. A model `done` result is insufficient: `confirm_submission` must match a quoted
255	receipt on the tender portal. Missing confirmation produces a failed run rather than a misleading success exit.
256	
257	Open shadow roots, visible editable controls, PDF/text/ZIP documents, and explicit visual transcription have helper

260	risks; `scripts/evaluate_navigation.py` runs an opt-in live-model discovery check against two synthetic layouts.
261	
262	Tender positions and Q&A now publish independently as each extraction completes. Specification pages are cached and

# Swarm guide

One process, one asyncio loop, many agents. Agents share a **blackboard**; the **orchestrator** runs them in phases.
Each person owns **one file in `agents/`** (no merge conflicts); shared code is in `swarm/` (change it by PR, small).

```
COLLECT (dataflow: scrapers + analysts, synchronised by done flags)  ->  VERIFY  ->  COMPUTE (plain code)  ->  SUBMIT
 scrapers save pages the MODEL chose; analysts turn them into results                                        enter bid, sign TAN
```

## Data flow (who waits for what)

```
BriefReader ──> results["brief"] (reference, scenario date, bidder, authorised senders), results["sites"] (role -> siteId)
TenderScraper (b0) login + overview, then documents (main tab) || Q&A (2nd tab)
                   ──tender.page──> done.tender ──> QuantityAnalyzer ──> results["tender"], results["quantities"]
SpecScraper   (b1) ──spec.page───> done.spec ───> RequirementAnalyzer ──> results["spec"], results["requirements"]
                                                        (+ Q&A amendments) ──> results["requirements_final"]
ErpScraper    (b2) logs in while waiting for results["requirements"]; then small jobs on up to ERP_TABS tabs: one
                   search per catalogue group -> the listed materials that fit -> record -> prices || stock per active material
                   ──erp.page──> done.erp ──> MaterialMatcher ──> results["erp"], results["materials"]
MailScraper   (b3) logs in while the brief is read; one search for the reference, reads every message about the tender
                   ──> done.mail_core; then a search per brief topic still without a valid message (parallel tabs)
                   ──> done.mail ──mail.page──> DiscountAnalyzer ──> results["discount"], results["mail"], results["mailbox"]
CollectionCoordinator (reasoning model) as each site's first pass + analysis is done: code lists the gaps (facts the
                   bid needs that no saved page holds), the model turns them into focused follow-up jobs on that site,
                   the affected analyses run again ──> results["gaps"] (what is still open when COLLECT ends)
PopupGuard (next to every browse): clears cookie banners, surveys, notices, error pages, access gates
EvidenceVerifier ──> results["verification"];  BidCalculator ──> results["bid"], results["answer"]
BidSubmitter (b0 main tab, full reasoning; TAN via a short browse on b3's main tab) ──> results["submission"]
```

Every scraper sets its `done.<role>` flag in a `finally`, so analysts never wait forever; every wait has a timeout
bounded by `ctx.time_left()`. Missing inputs degrade the bid (omitted positions, blank breakdown fields), never crash it.

## Files

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `swarm/blackboard.py` | `Evidence(kind, site, data, source, author, note)`, `Blackboard` (post/query/set/get/wait_for/dump/load) |
| `swarm/agent.py` | `Agent` base, `Phase`, `@register` |
| `swarm/context.py` | `ctx`: `task`, `board`, `llm`, `pool`, `site(id)`, `brief`, `time_left()`, `seconds_left()`, `lock(name)`, `shared` |
| `swarm/llm.py` | `ctx.llm.chat / ask / ask_json` (Qwen, concurrency-limited, usage counted), `parse_json` |
| `swarm/browser_agent.py` | `browse(ctx, goal, browser=n, tab=..., flash=..., careful=...)`: **browser-use** on our CDP browser + Qwen, with our actions `read_page`, `record`, `fill_form`, `share_tip`, `read_document`, `read_visual`; `Tab` |
| `swarm/guard.py` | `PopupGuard`: runs next to every browsing agent and clears noise (model decides once per kind of popup, cached per site) |
| `swarm/page_text.py` | the page extractor behind `read_page` (iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels, zero-width chars) |
| `swarm/forms.py` | the form filler behind `fill_form` (cascading selects via an apply button) |
| `swarm/extract.py` | analyst helpers: saved pages -> model extraction with a JSON shape (chunked, merged) |
| `swarm/normalize.py` | numbers (de-DE/en-US), dates (MM/DD vs DD/MM, ISO), references, German display format, cent rounding |
| `swarm/sites.py` | role -> siteId mapping (site names differ per dataset) |
| `swarm/scraper.py` | `SiteScraper`: set `role`, `browser`, write `goal()`; `self.browse(job)` for extra passes, `self.browse_in_tabs(jobs)` for parallel ones; `run_job(ctx, role, job)` for the coordinator |
| `swarm/orchestrator.py` | discovery of `agents/*`, phases, timeouts, failure isolation, board dumps |
| `agents/*.py` | the agents. Header comment of each file: OWNER / ROLE / NEEDS / WRITES and the result shapes |

## How the model browses

The model (Qwen via browser-use) decides where to go. Three actions of ours make it fast and exact:

- `read_page(url?, topic?, next_page_link?)`: full text of the page it chose (hidden-but-real content included,
  decoys hidden from people excluded); with `next_page_link` it reads every page of a paged list; with `topic` the
  text is saved as Evidence `"<role>.page"` for the analysts. This is "extract a selected page / paginate a
  model-selected result set" from the rules: the model selects, the helper extracts.
- `record(kind, data, source, note)`: one fact.
- `fill_form(fields, apply_button?, then_click?)`: many fields of a form in one step (bid configurator). Also custom
  toggles without an input (shadow DOM), named by their text; sliders set to 'max' are dragged with real mouse events.
  (browser-use's `evaluate` is off: writing page JavaScript cost whole step budgets.)
- `share_tip(tip)`: a short how-to for the site (a URL pattern that opens results directly, how a record opens); later
  agents on that site get the tips in their hints, so one agent's discovery saves every other agent the search.

`read_page` reads live content by default and preserves URL fragments. Explicit `refresh=false` permits cached
immutable evidence. Failed extractions are retried rather than cached as empty results. The popup guard (`swarm/guard.py`) sweeps the agent's page before every step and every 2 s:
each new kind of dialog / overlay / banner / short error page goes to Clef, then Qwen if needed, once ("click" noise, "fill" an access
gate, "leave" anything an agent works with), and the decision is cached per site for all agents, so a notice that comes
back on every page costs one model call per run. The submitter's guard is careful: clicks on noise without inputs only.
The guard owns every block; explorers never interact with one. It sweeps right before each step AND right before
each page action (`GuardedTools.act`): when it had to clear something that appeared after the model looked, the
action is not executed and the model gets a short note ("not executed: a gate covered the page; look again"), with
its memory intact. Gates: sliders/checkboxes are filled from the cached decision; a gate asking for a typed code
(receipt number drawn in a canvas) is read by Qwen from a screenshot (`read_code`) and filled completely, or not at
all - a continue button is never pressed with a typed field empty (that spent the ERP form 9x in
reh_cabb68e26f532fb8). One gate submission per site at a time (`gate:<host>` lock, tabs share the session). The
background loop clicks noise only, and never while an agent action runs. The sweep before a step waits up to

`report_site_capability present=false` caused by login/gate/error trouble is refused (Clef check), so an access
failure never unassigns a site.

model picks one, the item's single staying button (its x) is used instead; only an error page's retry link may lead
away. Inline gates (a slider to drag to the end, a robot checkbox) are found by their slider and unlocked on every
page; fills that only tick boxes and move sliders are cached like clicks. `read_page` prints list links as `<url>`, so
agents open records and messages by URL instead of clicking through locked or paged lists.

Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).

### Which model does what

| Clef (`swarm/decide.py`: closed choice / yes-no, cheap) | Qwen (`swarm/llm.py`, browser-use: writes text and values) |
| --- | --- |
| guard triage: kind of popup + which button clears it, "leave" for content | every browsing step (navigation, forms, the bid wizard) |
| site-role mapping (one choice per role, kept at confidence >= 0.85) | page extraction to JSON, brief facts, read_visual transcription |
| receipt sanity check in `confirm_submission` (blocks only a clear "no") | follow-up planning (coordinator, thinking on), gate field values |

Every Clef use falls back to Qwen (guard items Clef is unsure about, access gates, unmapped roles) or to the old
behaviour (receipt check) when Clef is missing, slow or not confident, so local runs without Clef work unchanged.

goal names them (e.g. `mail.tan`). Results keys and shapes are documented at the top of each agent file.
Done flags: `done.tender`, `done.spec`, `done.erp`, `done.mail_core`, `done.mail`, `requirements_final`, `mail_final`.
Analysts expose `refresh(ctx)` (module level): re-run on the pages saved so far (ERP and mail pages are extracted once
each and cached), so the coordinator can update results after its follow-up jobs.

## Local development

```powershell
atira models proxy                                   # terminal 1
atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # terminal 2
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # whole swarm; dumps .swarm/board.json after each phase
$env:SWARM_DEADLINE_S="1200"                         # optional: simulate the 20-minute clock locally
$env:SWARM_ONLY="MaterialMatcher,BidCalculator"; $env:SWARM_BOARD_IN=".swarm/board.json"
uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # only these agents, on a saved board (no re-scraping)
uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
```
`SWARM_BOARD_IN` is ignored in scored runs. `.swarm/` holds scouting data: git-ignored, never ship it.
Replaying analysts on a saved board: the done flags are in the board, so waits return immediately.

position (3 steps each), minus the steps WizardPrep already did) x max(13 s, measured median browsing step x 1.15) +

- Prompt text (goals, hints, rules, tool descriptions) is written tersely: every word is resent on every step.
- Small jobs instead of big ones: an ERP job per search / material record / prices / stock finishes inside its step
  budget, and materials the search list already rules out are never opened.
- Logs: browser-use's own step logs are off (the platform keeps only the tail of a run's log, and they pushed the
  swarm's lines out); `browse` logs one line per step, and the board is summarised in one line after COLLECT.

## Work split (3 people) and how to iterate on your part

| Person | Agents | Iterate with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A: tender + spec | `scrape_tender`, `scrape_spec`, `analyze_quantities`, `analyze_requirements` | `SWARM_ONLY=TenderScraper,QuantityAnalyzer` live; analysts on a saved board |
| B: ERP | `scrape_erp` (ErpScraper + its tab workers), `analyze_materials` | `SWARM_ONLY=ErpScraper,MaterialMatcher` on a board that has `requirements` |
| C: mail + shared | `scrape_mail`, `analyze_discount`, `compute_bid`, `submit_bid`, `swarm/*` | analysts/calculator on a saved board; `tests/test_rules.py` |

Loop: run your scraper live once -> it dumps `.swarm/board.json` -> replay your analyst on it as often as needed
(`SWARM_BOARD_IN`) -> check the result keys -> tune the goal/hints (strategy only) or the extraction shape -> repeat.
Then a sandbox test run (`atira test-run .`) to check timing; debug with `atira logs <run>`.

## Open items

- Tune goals/hints per site from test-run logs (`atira` MCP: `run_logs`, `run_llm_calls`, `run_screenshot`).
- Submitter: watch the first real runs closely (wizard order, TAN timing).
- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.


## Workflow safeguards and evaluation

Requirements are published as specification pages arrive; ERP keeps accepting new requirements until final analysis.
Mail stops 150 seconds before the submission reserve, and every completed mail/ERP extraction is retained immediately.
At the collection cutoff the orchestrator reconciles completed extractions without another model call.

Model attempts time out after 55 seconds (`SWARM_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S`); browsing and analyst calls share a concurrency
limit of 16. A run has its own monotonic clock. Collection children and guard tasks are cancelled and awaited before
signing. Local runs launch persistent CDP browsers so a resumed wizard keeps its tab and login.

The submitter starts a background TAN lookup and polls it while retaining the portal wizard. A replacement request
explicitly invalidates that lookup. A model `done` result is insufficient: `confirm_submission` must match a quoted
receipt on the tender portal. Missing confirmation produces a failed run rather than a misleading success exit.

Open shadow roots, visible editable controls, PDF/text/ZIP documents, and explicit visual transcription have helper
support. Failed or unverified form fields prevent the helper's continue click. These mechanisms do not guarantee
compatibility with every framework or website. [The review backlog](REVIEW.md) distinguishes fixes from remaining
risks; `scripts/evaluate_navigation.py` runs an opt-in live-model discovery check against two synthetic layouts.

Tender positions and Q&A now publish independently as each extraction completes. Specification pages are cached and
merged in observed order; late Q&A is reapplied to original revision facts. The default submission reserve is eight
minutes. Connection establishment has an eight-second timeout; browsing clients are reused within a job and closed
when it ends. The runtime capability-report tool can invalidate a previously complete site mapping.

"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.

Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.

When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
Independent jobs run at once with `browse_in_tabs` (one new tab each, closed when its job ends); `self.browse` works
in the browser's main tab.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import timeline
from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab, browse
from swarm.extract import brief_intro
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S = 75     # scrapers stop browsing this long before collecting ends (analysts need the time)
IDLE_STEPS = 10             # a collection browse that saved pages, then saves nothing for this many steps, ends


class SiteScraper(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT
    role: str = ""
    site_id: str = ""
    max_steps: int = 40
    hints: str = ""

    def goal(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def login_text(self) -> str:
        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
        return f"Site ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"

    def task_text(self) -> str:
        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
                 if facts.get(k)}
        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"

    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
        if kind.endswith(".page"):
            timeline.mark(f"first {kind}")

    def stop_extra(self, kwargs: dict) -> float:
        return kwargs.get("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)

    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
        # stop browsing early enough for the analysts to turn the last pages into results before collecting ends
        kwargs.setdefault("stop_extra", ANALYSIS_RESERVE_S)
        kwargs.setdefault("idle_steps", IDLE_STEPS)
        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
                           author=kwargs.pop("author", self.name), **kwargs)
        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
        return out

    def time_for_retry(self, kwargs: dict, need: float = 120) -> bool:
        stop = kwargs["stop_reserve"] if kwargs.get("stop_reserve") is not None else self.ctx.stop_at(self.stop_extra(kwargs))
        return self.ctx.seconds_left() - stop >= need

    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit, a crashed browser agent), start again
        with a note on what is already saved, while time allows. Saved pages are never collected twice."""
        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
        records = []
        for attempt in range(attempts):
            note = ""
            if attempt:
                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is missing.")
                timeline.count("browse.retries")
            try:
                out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - a failed connection is one failed attempt, not the end
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"browse attempt {attempt + 1}: {type(error).__name__}: {error}")
                self.log.warning("browse attempt %d failed: %s", attempt + 1, error)
                out = {"summary": f"failed: {type(error).__name__}", "done": False, "records": [], "steps": 0}
            records.extend(out.get("records") or [])
            rejected = self.ctx.shared.get("site_invalidations", {}).get(self.role, set())
            if self.site_id in rejected:
                self.site_id = await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
                # A reused tab may still show the old application; runtime model navigates the newly assigned URL.
                job += "\nThe prior site assignment was contradicted. Navigate to the newly assigned site URL in Login."
                out["done"] = False
            if out["done"] or not self.time_for_retry(kwargs):
                break
        return {**out, "records": records}

    async def browse_in_tabs(self, jobs: list[str], *, browser: int | None = None, attempts: int = 2,
                             **kwargs) -> list[dict]:
        """Run `jobs` at once, each in a new tab of this scraper's browser (the tabs share its login cookies). Each tab
        is closed as soon as its job ends, so no tab sits idle. A failed job returns {"summary": error, "done": False}."""
        async def one(job: str) -> dict:
            tab = Tab(self.browser if browser is None else browser)
            try:
                return await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=attempts, tab=tab, **kwargs)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"tab job failed: {error}")
                return {"summary": str(error), "done": False}
            finally:
                await tab.close()
        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(one(job) for job in jobs)))

    async def wait_brief(self, timeout: float = 180) -> dict:
        try:
            return await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="brief", timeout=timeout) or {}
        except TimeoutError:
            return {}

    def required(self) -> list[tuple[tuple[str, ...], str]]:
        """Pages that must be saved, as (topic keywords, focused job). After the main browse, a focused browse runs
        for each one whose keywords appear in no saved topic. Override per scraper."""
        return []

    def saved_topics(self) -> str:
        return " | ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page"))

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            out = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal())   # the brief's intro already names the tender: start at once
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", out["summary"])
            await self.required_pass()
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

    async def required_pass(self) -> None:
        for keywords, job in self.required():
            if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                await self.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=15)


def scraper_class(role: str) -> type[SiteScraper] | None:
    from swarm.agent import REGISTRY
    return next((c for c in REGISTRY if isinstance(c, type) and issubclass(c, SiteScraper) and c.role == role), None)


async def run_job(ctx, role: str, job: str, *, max_steps: int = 16, **kwargs) -> dict:
    """One follow-up job on the site of `role`, run by that role's scraper setup (login, hints, browser): in the
    browser's main tab when it is free (logged in already), else in a new tab. For agents/coordinate.py."""
    cls = scraper_class(role)
    if cls is None:
        raise KeyError(f"no scraper for role {role!r}")
    scraper = cls(ctx)
    scraper.name = f"{cls.__name__}.followup"
    scraper.site_id = await site_for(ctx, role)
    main = ctx.lock(f"main_tab.{scraper.browser}")
    if not main.locked():
        async with main:
            return await scraper.browse_until_done(job, attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs)
    return (await scraper.browse_in_tabs([job], attempts=1, max_steps=max_steps, **kwargs))[0]

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py). While waiting, the main tab of browser 2 logs in and
passes the ERP's gates. Then the work runs as small jobs on up to ERP_TABS tabs of browser 2 (they share the login):

1. search: one job per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe): search it, save the result list. Nothing else.
2. As soon as a list is saved, the materials on it that fit a requirement (agents/analyze_materials.search_candidates:
   bore, pressure, mounting, certification equal where shown; stroke equal or covering the usable travel) become three
   jobs each, run in parallel: record (all tabs incl. status and lead times), prices (condition records with the
   quantity-scale register open) and stock (storage-location level).
   A material whose record turns out blocked gets no price/stock job (they wait behind the record jobs).

Small jobs finish inside their step budget (one big job per group used to run out of steps before prices and stock),
and no step is spent on materials the list already rules out. results["done.erp"] is set when the queue is empty.

Scheduling: the next job is chosen when a tab gets free, by what it adds to a submit-ready answer (`priority`): first
focused re-reads of something the bid calculation still misses, then prices and stock of materials that already match
a position (they finish that position), then searches and the best candidate record per requirement, then further
candidates; records of candidates for positions that already have a verified active match come last. A tab never
waits for its page's extraction: that runs in the background and queues the follow-up jobs when it is done. After a
material's prices / stock / record were read, the calculator's open dependencies for it (a condition without its price
unit, scales, stock, lead times, carton size, ...) queue one focused re-read naming exactly what is missing.
"""
import os
import asyncio
import itertools

from agents.analyze_materials import extract_erp, merge_materials, search_candidates
from swarm import Phase, register, timeline  # noqa: F401
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab
from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_TIME_S = 60    # what the material matcher needs after the last ERP page
# parallel ERP jobs (main tab included). 8 once stalled every sandbox browser at once; A/B on 2026-10-11 (same code):
# 6 tabs 17 ERP jobs / 4 positions priced / 10 failed browses (run_1efbfc7e6d2895e0) vs 4 tabs 12 / 1 / 16
# (run_db181692d8232b97); 4 tabs in run_7a11d3a90d55e1ce: 15 / 3. ERP throughput is the collection bottleneck.
ERP_TABS = int(os.environ.get("SWARM_ERP_TABS", "8"))

HINTS = ("Patterns, not requirements. ERP: SAP-style transaction codes (menu lists material display, stock overview, "
         "price conditions); notice/access gate after login (guard passes it, also its shown number; wait, do not "
         "touch); material search help (F4) lists only for narrow term; records with tabs/registers "
         "(basic, technical, planning/status with lead times; condition header + quantity scales; stock per plant/"
         "storage location); status codes in legend/tooltip; short session timeout -> log in again. Save steps: "
         "links of record tabs seen -> ONE read_page(urls=[...]); transactions often take material number in entry field.")

FOLLOWUP, FINISH, SEARCH, BEST_RECORD, RECORD, SPECULATIVE, COVERED = 0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6
MAX_FOCUSED = 1          # focused re-reads per (job kind, material) after the first read


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def describe(item: dict) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])


def search_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    term = item["group"] or "the attributes"
    return (f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{describe(item)}\n"
            "1. Log in if needed, open material search (search help of material display transaction).\n"
            f"2. Search {term}; read_page result list, topic 'erp search {item['group']}', next_page_link for all pages.\n"
            "3. done, list materials + attributes. Do NOT open records (other agents do).")


def material_goal(job: str, material: str, item: dict, missing: str = "") -> str:
    group = f" (catalogue group {item['group']})" if item.get("group") else ""
    find = (f"Open material {material}{group}: type number in transaction's material field, or search "
            f"{item.get('group') or material} in search help, click row of {material}.")
    focus = (f"\nEarlier read did NOT show: {missing}. Find exactly that (other tab/register/record, header vs "
             "detail, tooltip), read_page the page showing it.") if missing else ""
    if job == "record":
        return (f"{find}\nread_page EVERY tab/register of record (basic, technical, planning/status with lead times; "
                f"status legend/tooltip), topic 'erp material {material}', one read_page(urls=[...]) when tabs are "
                f"links. done: status + lead times.{focus}")
    if job == "prices":
        return (f"Price conditions of material {material}{group}: open price condition display transaction, open "
                f"quantity-scale register so every scale row shows, read_page topic 'erp prices {material}' (header "
                "with validity, price unit, condition record number must be in the read); several condition records "
                "(validity periods) -> read each (next_page_link = exact next-record link text). done: validity "
                f"periods, price unit, scale prices.{focus}")
    return (f"Stock of material {material}{group}: open stock overview transaction, open storage-location level "
            f"(quantity per location + stock type), read_page topic 'erp stock {material}'. done: freely usable "
            f"quantity per location.{focus}")


async def _items(ctx) -> list[dict]:
    requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
    used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
            for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
    if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
        requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
    items = work_items(requirements)
    await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
    return items


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 16
    hints = HINTS

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        super().__init__(ctx)
        self.jobs: list[tuple[int, tuple]] = []      # (insertion order, job); the next job is chosen when taken
        self.pending = 0                               # queued + running jobs + background extractions
        self.producer_done = False
        self.seen: set = set()
        self.focused: dict[tuple, int] = {}
        self.rank: dict[str, int] = {}                 # material -> its place among its search's candidates
        self._order = itertools.count()
        self.background: set[asyncio.Task] = set()

    # ---- queue ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def add(self, job: tuple, force: bool = False) -> bool:
        key = job[:2] if job[0] != "search" else ("search", job[1]["group"], repr(job[1]["requirements"]))
        if key in self.seen and not force:
            return False
        self.seen.add(key)
        self.pending += 1
        self.jobs.append((next(self._order), job))
        return True

    def matched(self) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
        """material -> positions it currently matches (verified active exact match)."""
        out: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        for pos, m in (self.ctx.board.get("materials") or {}).items():
            if m.get("material") and not m.get("unverified"):
                out.setdefault(norm_ref(m["material"]), []).append(pos)
        return out

    def positions_of(self, item: dict) -> list[str]:
        refs = {norm_ref(r.get("ref")) for r in item.get("requirements") or []}
        return [str(p.get("position")) for p in (self.ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or []
                if norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref")) in refs]

    def priority(self, job: tuple) -> int:
        """What the job adds to a submit-ready answer (lower first)."""
        kind = job[0]
        if kind == "search":
            return SEARCH
        material, item = job[1], job[2]
        matched = self.matched()
        if len(job) > 3 and job[3]:                    # focused re-read of something the calculation misses
            return FOLLOWUP
        if kind in ("prices", "stock"):
            return FINISH if norm_ref(material) in matched else SPECULATIVE
        positions = self.positions_of(item)
        covered = {p for ps in matched.values() for p in ps}
        if positions and all(p in covered for p in positions):
            return COVERED
        return BEST_RECORD if self.rank.get(norm_ref(material), 0) == 0 else RECORD

    def take(self) -> tuple | None:
        if not self.jobs:
            return None
        best = min(self.jobs, key=lambda j: (self.priority(j[1]), j[0]))
        self.jobs.remove(best)
        return best[1]

    def blocked(self, material: str) -> bool:
        """True if the material's record page (read meanwhile) says it is blocked: its prices and stock are not needed."""
        info = merge_materials(list(self.ctx.shared.get("erp.extracted", {}).values())).get(norm_ref(material)) or {}
        return info.get("is_active") is False

    # ---- jobs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    async def extract_job(self, out: dict) -> dict:
        evidence = []
        for record in out.get("records") or []:
            data = record.get("data") or {}
            text = data.get("text") or data.get("_observed_text")
            if text:
                evidence.append(Evidence("erp.page", self.site_id,
                    {**data, "text": text, "url": data.get("url") or record.get("source"),
                     "topic": data.get("topic") or record.get("kind", "")}))
        return await extract_erp(self.ctx, evidence=evidence)

    def spawn(self, coro) -> None:
        """Background work that may queue jobs: counted as pending so no worker quits while it runs."""
        self.pending += 1
        task = asyncio.ensure_future(coro)
        self.background.add(task)
        self.ctx.shared.setdefault("background", set()).add(task)

        def finished(t):
            self.pending -= 1
            self.background.discard(t)
            if not t.cancelled() and t.exception() is not None:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"extraction: {type(t.exception()).__name__}: {t.exception()}")
        task.add_done_callback(finished)

    async def after_search(self, item: dict, out: dict) -> None:
        found = search_candidates(await self.extract_job(out), item)
        self.log.info("search %s: candidates %s", item["group"], found)
        for i, material in enumerate(found):
            self.rank.setdefault(norm_ref(material), i)
            self.add(("record", material, item))

    async def after_material(self, kind: str, material: str, item: dict, out: dict) -> None:
        await self.extract_job(out)
        from agents import analyze_materials
        await analyze_materials.publish(self.ctx)            # the match (and so the priorities) follows at once
        if kind == "record" and not self.blocked(material):
            self.add(("prices", material, item))
            self.add(("stock", material, item))
        self.focus(kind, material, item)

    def missing_for(self, kind: str, material: str) -> str:
        """What the bid calculation still misses from this material's `kind` pages ('' if nothing / not matched)."""
        from agents.compute_bid import build_bid
        try:
            bid = build_bid(self.ctx)
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.log.debug("draft for focus failed: %s", error)
            return ""
        dep = (bid.get("dependencies") or {}).get(f"erp {kind} {norm_ref(material)}")
        return dep["need"] if dep else ""

    def focus(self, kind: str, material: str, item: dict) -> None:
        """One focused re-read when the calculation still misses something this kind of page should show."""
        if norm_ref(material) not in self.matched() or self.blocked(material):
            return
        missing = self.missing_for(kind, material)
        key = (kind, norm_ref(material))
        if missing and self.focused.get(key, 0) < MAX_FOCUSED:
            self.focused[key] = self.focused.get(key, 0) + 1
            self.log.info("%s %s still misses: %s -> focused re-read", kind, material, missing[:160])
            timeline.count("erp.focused")
            self.add((kind, material, item, missing), force=True)

    async def do(self, job: tuple, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        extra = ANALYSIS_TIME_S
        if job[0] == "search":
            item = job[1]
            out = await self.browse_until_done(search_goal(item), attempts=2, tab=tab, max_steps=14, stop_extra=extra)
            self.spawn(self.after_search(item, out))
            return
        kind, material, item = job[:3]
        missing = job[3] if len(job) > 3 else ""
        if kind != "record" and self.blocked(material):
            self.log.info("%s %s skipped: material blocked", kind, material)
            return
        out = await self.browse_until_done(material_goal(kind, material, item, missing), attempts=2, tab=tab,
                                           max_steps=16, stop_extra=extra)
        self.spawn(self.after_material(kind, material, item, out))

    async def worker(self, tab: Tab | None) -> None:
        """Takes jobs until none is queued and no running job or extraction can add more (or time is up)."""
        try:
            while self.ctx.time_left() > 0:
                if self.ctx.time_left() <= ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
                    # too late for a new job now, but the live reserve may shrink again (e.g. the wizard warm-up
                    # finishing): wait instead of quitting (run_e38e6666df284e76 ended collection with time unused)
                    if self.pending <= 0 and self.producer_done and not self.jobs:
                        return
                    await asyncio.sleep(2)
                    continue
                job = self.take()
                if job is None:
                    if self.pending <= 0 and self.producer_done:
                        return
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                    continue
                label = f"{job[0]} {job[1] if job[0] != 'search' else job[1]['group']}"
                try:
                    with timeline.span("erp.job", label):
                        await self.do(job, tab)
                except Exception as error:
                    self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{label}: {error}")
                finally:
                    self.pending -= 1
        finally:
            if tab is not None:
                await tab.close()

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse_until_done("Log in (the guard handles cookies, notices and the access gate), open "
                                             "material search help of material display transaction. Do NOT search "
                                             "yet. done once search form open.", attempts=1, max_steps=12)

            async def produce():
                try:
                    while self.ctx.time_left() > 0:
                        for item in await _items(self.ctx):
                            self.add(("search", item))
                        if self.ctx.board.get("requirements_final"):
                            return
                        await asyncio.sleep(2)
                finally:
                    self.producer_done = True
            async with asyncio.TaskGroup() as group:
                group.create_task(produce())
                group.create_task(self.worker(None))
                for _ in range(ERP_TABS - 1):
                    group.create_task(self.worker(Tab(self.browser)))
            if self.background:                       # the last extractions (time is up for new jobs)
                await asyncio.wait(set(self.background), timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

"""Browsers for agents. In a run: CDP browsers 1-4 from the sandbox (never launch your own). Locally: one Chromium."""
import browsers
import os
import json
import socket


class BrowserPool:
    def __init__(self, REDACTED):
        self._pw = REDACTED
        self._contexts: dict[int, object] = {}   # slot -> browser context
        self._local = []

    async def prepare(self):
        """Give local runs the same persistent CDP/tab lifecycle as sandbox runs."""
        if self._pw is None or browsers.cdp_urls():
            return
        urls = []
        for _ in range(4):
            with socket.socket() as sock:
                sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
                port = sock.getsockname()[1]
            browser = await self._pw.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1",
                                                    args=[f"--remote-debugging-port={port}"])
            self._local.append(browser)
            urls.append(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
        os.environ["CDP_URLS"] = json.dumps(urls)

    async def close(self):
        if self._local:
            for browser in self._local:
                await browser.close()
            os.environ.pop("CDP_URLS", None)
            self._local.clear()

    async def context(self, index: int = 0):
        n = len(browsers.cdp_urls())
        slot = index % n if n else 0             # locally everything shares one Chromium
        if slot not in self._contexts:
            _, page = await browsers.connect(self._pw, slot)
            self._contexts[slot] = page.context
        return self._contexts[slot]

    async def new_page(self, index: int = 0):
        """A fresh tab in browser `index`; tabs are unlimited, browsers are not (max 4)."""
        return await (await self.context(index)).new_page()

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Run the swarm (or some agents) locally against the public scouting sites, headless, and save the whole log as
  Markdown in .swarm/local/ (git-ignored, never packaged). Nothing entered with scouting logins counts.

  Needs `atira models proxy` running (the local Qwen proxy). Locally every browse starts its own Chromium.

.EXAMPLE
  .\scripts\local-run.ps1 -Only "BriefReader,BidSubmitter" -Name submitter
  .\scripts\local-run.ps1 -Only "BriefReader,MailScraper,DiscountAnalyzer" -Name mail -Board .swarm/board.json
#>
param(
    [string]$Only = "",          # SWARM_ONLY: comma-separated agent names (empty = whole swarm)
    [string]$Name = "local",     # label for the log file
    [string]$Board = "",         # SWARM_BOARD_IN: start from a saved board (skip scraping that is already done)
    [switch]$Visible             # show the browsers (default headless)
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ".swarm/local" | Out-Null
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMdd-HHmm")
$log = ".swarm/local/$stamp-$Name.md"

atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
$env:SWARM_ONLY = $Only
$env:SWARM_BOARD_IN = $Board
$env:HEADLESS = if ($Visible) { "0" } else { "1" }
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING = "utf-8"

Set-Content -Encoding utf8 $log ("# Local run $stamp ($Name)`n`nSWARM_ONLY=$Only; SWARM_BOARD_IN=$Board`n`n" + '```text')
cmd /c "uv run --no-sync python agent.py 2>&1" | ForEach-Object { Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $log $_ }
Add-Content -Encoding utf8 $log '```'

async def browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
                 max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False,
                 stop_reserve: float | None = None, stop_extra: float = 0.0, extra_tools=None,
                 max_actions_per_step: int = 6, flash: bool = True, careful: bool = False, dedupe_reads: bool = True,
                 stop_on_record: str = "", idle_steps: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """See `_browse`. Measured as one span; the agent context variable names `author` inside."""
    token = timeline.AGENT.set(author)
    started = timeline.now()
    try:
        out = await _browse(ctx, goal, browser=browser, tab=tab, site_id=site_id, on_record=on_record,
                            max_steps=max_steps, hints=hints, author=author, use_vision=use_vision,
                            stop_reserve=stop_reserve, stop_extra=stop_extra, extra_tools=extra_tools,
                            max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step, flash=flash, careful=careful,
                            dedupe_reads=dedupe_reads, stop_on_record=stop_on_record, idle_steps=idle_steps)
        if not out.get("done"):
            timeline.add("browse.failed", out.get("summary", "")[:60], started)
        return out
    finally:
        timeline.AGENT.reset(token)


async def _browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
                  max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False,
                  stop_reserve: float | None = None, stop_extra: float = 0.0, extra_tools=None,
                  max_actions_per_step: int = 6, flash: bool = True, careful: bool = False,
                  dedupe_reads: bool = True, stop_on_record: str = "", idle_steps: int | None = None) -> dict:
    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.

    `tab`: the tab to work in (default: the main tab of `browser`). Screenshots are off by default
    (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page` already reads canvas labels and
    hidden text. `flash`: short replies + compact prompt (see module doc). `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this
    many seconds left (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)` may register more actions. Pages read with a
    `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
    A PopupGuard (swarm/guard.py) clears popups, notices and error pages next to the agent; `careful=True` limits it to
    noise without inputs (the bid submitter). `dedupe_reads`: read_page of a URL another agent already saved returns
    the saved text instead of opening it again (off for mails that change, such as TANs). `idle_steps`: after the
    first saved page/fact, stop once this many steps in a row saved nothing new (the caller resumes).
    """
    records: list[dict] = []
    progress = {"saved_at": None, "idle_stop": False}     # step of the last saved page/fact

    def reserve() -> float:
        """Seconds-left mark at which this browse stops: fixed, or the live submission reserve plus `stop_extra`."""
        if stop_reserve is not None:
            return stop_reserve
        return ctx.stop_at(stop_extra) if ctx is not None and hasattr(ctx, "stop_at") else stop_extra

    async def emit(rec: dict):
        """Pass a record on; `on_record` may return a string to refuse a fact (the record action reports it)."""
        if on_record:
            refused = await on_record(rec)
            if isinstance(refused, str) and refused:
                return refused
        records.append(rec)
        progress["saved_at"] = len(step_started)
        return None

    step_started: list[float] = []
    tools = build_tools(ctx, site_id, author, emit, dedupe_reads=dedupe_reads, stop_on_record=stop_on_record)
    if extra_tools:
        extra_tools(tools)

    tab = await responsive_tab(tab or main_tab(browser))
    await tab.open()
    session = make_session(ctx, tab, vision=bool(use_vision))
    memory = CAREFUL_MEMORY if careful else "1-4 short sentences: last step ok/failed, facts to keep, next goal"
    prompt = dict(flash_mode=True, override_system_message=FLASH_SYSTEM.format(max_actions=max_actions_per_step,
                                                                                memory=memory)) if flash else {}
    tips = site_tips(ctx, site_id)
    hints = hints + ("\nTips from other agents on this site:\n- " + "\n- ".join(tips) if tips else "")
    # A tab an agent already worked in is on the site (logged in, past gates): start from its current page instead of
    # browser-use opening the site's start URL from the goal again.
    reused = tab.used and bool(browsers.cdp_urls())
    tab.used = True
    browsing_llm = make_llm(flash)
    browsing_llm._usage_ctx = ctx
    agent = Agent(task=goal + ("\n\nThis tab is already on the site: start from the current page." if reused else ""),
                  llm=browsing_llm, browser_session=session, tools=tools, use_vision=use_vision,
                  use_judge=False, generate_gif=False, max_failures=6, max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step,
                  llm_timeout=min(CALL_TIMEOUT_S, BROWSE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S if flash else SUBMIT_MODEL_TIMEOUT_S) + 2,
                  step_timeout=120 if flash and not careful else SUBMIT_STEP_TIMEOUT_S, directly_open_url=not reused,
                  max_history_items=HISTORY_ITEMS if flash and not careful else None,
                  max_clickable_elements_length=DOM_CHARS,
                  REDACTED,
                  extend_system_message=SYSTEM_EXTRA + (f"\n{hints}" if hints else ""), **prompt)
    async def screenshot() -> str:
        cdp = await session.get_or_create_cdp_session()
        shot = await cdp.cdp_client.send.Page.captureScreenshot(params={"format": "png"}, session_id=cdp.session_id)
        return shot["data"]

    guard = PopupGuard(ctx, author, careful=careful, screenshot=screenshot,
                       fill=lambda pairs, then_click, item_id: fill_page(session, pairs, "", then_click, item_id))
    evaluate = lambda js, *a: _evaluate(session, js, *a)  # noqa: E731
    guard_task: asyncio.Task | None = None

    async def clear_page() -> int:
        with timeline.span("guard", "sweep"):
            try:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(guard.sweep(evaluate, settle_s=GUARD_SETTLE_S), GUARD_SWEEP_S)
            except Exception as error:
                log.debug("guard sweep failed: %s", error)
                return 0

    async def before_action(name: str) -> str | None:
        """The guard owns every block: one that appeared since the model looked is cleared and the action skipped.
        A full scan only when the page's change counter moved (or a gate is still open): most actions pay one tiny
        page call."""
        if not (await guard.changed(evaluate, "action") or guard.open_gate):
            return None
        if not await clear_page():
            return None
        timeline.count("guard.skipped_actions")
        kinds = ", ".join(sorted(set(guard.last_handled))) or "popup"
        return (f"'{name}' not executed: a {kinds} covered the page after you looked; the guard cleared it. Look at "
                "the page again and continue your plan (nothing was lost).")
    tools.before_action = before_action

    async def before_step(_agent) -> None:
        nonlocal guard_task
        if ctx.seconds_left() <= reserve():
            agent.stop()
            return
        await clear_page()          # the page the model is about to see: cleared first
        await guard.changed(evaluate, "action")     # what the model sees now is the baseline for its actions
        if guard_task is None:  # from now on also between steps (popups that appear while the model thinks)
            guard_task = asyncio.create_task(guard.loop(evaluate, busy=lambda: tools.acting))
        step_started.append(timeline.now())

    secrets = [str((s.get("credentials") or {}).get("password") or "") for s in (ctx.task.get("access") or [])] \
        if ctx is not None else []

    async def after_step(_agent) -> None:
        if step_started:
            line = "no reply" if not agent.history.history or agent.history.history[-1].model_output is None else "step"
            timeline.add("browse.step", line, step_started[-1])
            if line == "no reply":
                timeline.count("steps.no_reply")
        try:
            line = _step_line(agent)
            for secret in secrets:        # the model's memory sometimes repeats the login
                if len(secret) >= 4:
                    line = line.replace(secret, "***")
            log.info("%s step %d: %s", author, agent.state.n_steps - 1, line)
        except Exception as error:
            log.debug("step line failed: %s", error)
        if idle_steps and progress["saved_at"] is not None and len(step_started) - progress["saved_at"] >= idle_steps:
            # it saved evidence, then went on without saving anything (run_7b060fa870cea9b6: 6 min on a decoy mail)
            log.warning("%s: %d steps without new evidence; ending so the caller can continue from what is saved",
                        author, idle_steps)
            timeline.count("browse.idle_stops")
            progress["idle_stop"] = True
            agent.stop()
        if session._state_timeouts >= (2 if flash and not careful else 1):
            log.warning("%s: repeated browser-state timeouts; ending this connection so the caller can reattach", author)
            timeline.count("browse.state_timeouts")
            tab.suspect = True
            agent.stop()

    failure = ""
    _ACTIVE.add(tab)
    # Hard ceiling for a step that never returns. The live stop mark is checked before every step; the reserve can
    # still shrink later (measured pace), and the orchestrator ends collection at the real cutoff anyway.
    from swarm.context import MIN_RESERVE_S
    ceiling = stop_reserve if stop_reserve is not None else min(reserve(), MIN_RESERVE_S + stop_extra)
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(max(1, ctx.seconds_left() - ceiling)):
            history = await agent.run(max_steps=max_steps, on_step_start=before_step, on_step_end=after_step)
    except TimeoutError:
        history = agent.history
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - the caller decides on a retry; saved records stay saved
        # A browse that crashed (browser-use raised out of its run loop) used to take the whole scraper down with it
        # (run_9bb728285d9bd88c: the mail scraper died 3 min in). Its records are already on the board; report it as
        # an unfinished attempt so the caller can resume with what is saved.
        failure = f"browser agent failed: {type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}"
        log.warning("%s: %s", author, failure)

        # each other in the live view).
        params = {"url": "about:blank", "newWindow": True} if os.environ.get("TAB_WINDOWS") == "1" else \
            {"url": "about:blank", "background": True}
        made = await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.createTarget(params=params))
        self.claim(made["targetId"])

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the tab and the popups it adopted (the main tab itself stays open)."""
        if self.replacement is not None:
            replacement, self.replacement = self.replacement, None
            await replacement.close()
        targets = list(self.popups) + ([self.target_id] if self.target_id and not self.main else [])
        self.popups = set()
        if not self.main:
            self.target_id, self.used = None, False
        for target in targets:
            _OWNERS.pop(target, None)
        if not targets:
            return
        try:
            await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: asyncio.gather(
                *(c.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": t}) for t in targets), return_exceptions=True))
        except Exception as error:      # already closed / browser gone
            log.debug("closing tab failed: %s", error)


_UNRESPONSIVE: dict[int, float] = {}   # browser index -> time.monotonic() when it last failed to answer
DEAD_FOR_S = 60                          # a browser that did not answer is skipped this long before it is tried again


async def browser_responds(browser: int, timeout: float = 12) -> bool:
    """Does browser `browser` answer over CDP at all? (A hung page once left a sandbox browser unreachable for the rest
    of the run; every reconnect then failed after 15 s.)"""
    if not browsers.cdp_urls():
        return True
    seen = _UNRESPONSIVE.get(browser)
    if seen is not None and time.monotonic() - seen < DEAD_FOR_S:
        return False
    try:
        await asyncio.wait_for(_with_cdp(browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.getTargets()), timeout)
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeout, refused, closed: all mean "not usable now"
        _UNRESPONSIVE[browser] = time.monotonic()
        log.warning("browser %d does not respond (%s)", browser, type(error).__name__)
        return False
    _UNRESPONSIVE.pop(browser, None)
    return True


TAB_PROBE_S = 8          # a page that cannot evaluate `1` within this long is hung
CHECK_EVERY_S = 20       # a browser whose tabs were checked this recently is not checked again for a healthy tab

_ACTIVE: set["Tab"] = set()            # tabs with a browse() running right now
_HUNG_AT: dict[int, list[float]] = {}  # browser index -> when a tab of it was closed as hung
REPEAT_HANG_S = 300                    # a second hang within this long moves the work to another browser
_CHECKED: dict[int, float] = {}        # browser index -> time.monotonic() of its last clean hung-tab check


def may_close(target_id: str, mine: "Tab | None") -> bool:
    """A recovery check may close only the caller's own tab (and its popups), tabs nobody owns, and owned tabs no
    browse is using. Another agent's active tab is never touched: a slow page there is that agent's business (its own
    browse ends after repeated state timeouts and recovers itself); closing it destroyed healthy work in progress."""
    owner = owner_of(target_id)
    return owner is None or owner is mine or owner not in _ACTIVE


async def close_hung_tabs(browser: int, keep: str | None = None, mine: "Tab | None" = None) -> list[str]:
    """Close the tabs of `browser` whose page no longer runs JavaScript. browser-use attaches to every tab when it
    connects; one hung tab made each connect time out after 15 s, although the browser itself still answered (two
    sandbox runs: the submitter failed 5 times that way). `keep` is never closed, nor another agent's active tab
    (`may_close`). Returns the closed target ids."""
    async def probe(client) -> list[str]:
        targets = (await client.send.Target.getTargets())["targetInfos"]
        pages = [t for t in targets if t.get("type") == "page" and t["targetId"] != keep
                 and may_close(t["targetId"], mine)]

        async def hung(target) -> bool:
            try:
                async with asyncio.timeout(TAB_PROBE_S):
                    attached = await client.send.Target.attachToTarget(
                        params={"targetId": target["targetId"], "flatten": True})
                    await client.send.Runtime.evaluate(params={"expression": "1"}, session_id=attached["sessionId"])
                    await client.send.Target.detachFromTarget(params={"sessionId": attached["sessionId"]})
                return False
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - timeout or a target that vanished: only a timeout counts as hung
                return True

        verdicts = await asyncio.gather(*(hung(t) for t in pages))
        closed: list[str] = []
        for target, is_hung in zip(pages, verdicts):
            if is_hung:
                try:
                    await asyncio.wait_for(client.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": target["targetId"]}), 5)
                    _OWNERS.pop(target["targetId"], None)
                    closed.append(target["targetId"])
                    log.warning("browser %d: closed a hung tab (%s)", browser, str(target.get("url"))[:80])
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    continue
        return closed

    if not browsers.cdp_urls():
        return []
    try:
        return await asyncio.wait_for(_with_cdp(browser, probe), TAB_PROBE_S + 15)
    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
        log.debug("hung-tab check on browser %d failed: %s", browser, error)
        return []


async def responsive_tab(tab: "Tab") -> "Tab":
    """The tab to work in: `tab` if its browser answers, else a new tab of the next browser that does. Any browser can
    open any site, so one dead browser must not take a whole role (or the signing) down with it. A healthy tab of a
    browser checked within CHECK_EVERY_S skips the check (it cost every browse a CDP round trip)."""
    urls = browsers.cdp_urls()
    if not urls:
        return tab
    if tab.replacement is not None:          # work already moved to another browser: keep using that tab
        return await responsive_tab(tab.replacement)
    recent = time.monotonic() - _CHECKED.get(tab.browser, -1e9) < CHECK_EVERY_S
    if recent and not tab.suspect:
        return tab
    with timeline.span("recovery", f"check browser {tab.browser}"):
        if await browser_responds(tab.browser):
            closed = await close_hung_tabs(tab.browser, mine=tab)
            if closed:
                timeline.count("tabs.hung_closed", len(closed))
            else:
                _CHECKED[tab.browser] = time.monotonic()
            if tab.target_id and tab.target_id in closed:
                now = time.monotonic()
                recent = [t for t in _HUNG_AT.get(tab.browser, []) if now - t < REPEAT_HANG_S]
                _HUNG_AT[tab.browser] = recent + [now]
                timeline.count("tabs.replaced")
                if recent:            # hung again on this browser (run_db181692d8232b97: twice while signing)
                    others = [(len([t for t in _HUNG_AT.get(b, []) if now - t < REPEAT_HANG_S]), b)
                              for b in range(len(urls)) if b != tab.browser]
                    for _, other in sorted(others):
                        if await browser_responds(other):
                            log.warning("browser %d hung again: continuing in a new tab of browser %d",
                                        tab.browser, other)
                            timeline.count("tabs.moved_browser")
                            tab.renew()
                            tab.replacement = Tab(other)      # closed together with `tab` by its owner
                            return tab.replacement
                log.warning("browser %d: this agent's tab was hung and closed; continuing in a new tab", tab.browser)
                tab.renew()           # same Tab object: its owner still closes it, and a main tab stays the main tab
            tab.suspect = False
            return tab
        for step in range(1, len(urls)):
            other = (tab.browser + step) % len(urls)
            if await browser_responds(other):
                log.warning("browser %d is unreachable: continuing in a new tab of browser %d", tab.browser, other)
                timeline.count("tabs.moved_browser")
                moved = Tab(other)
                tab.replacement = moved         # closed together with `tab` by its owner
                return moved
    return tab   # none answers: try the original again (the caller's retry logic takes over)


def main_tab(browser: int) -> Tab:
    return _MAIN_TABS.setdefault(browser, Tab(browser, main=True))


_OPENERS: dict[str, str] = {}      # target id -> id of the target that opened it (popups), from Chrome's target info


def owner_of(target_id: str) -> Tab | None:
    """The tab a target belongs to: its own claim, else the owner of the tab that opened it (popup of a popup too)."""
    seen = set()
    while target_id and target_id not in seen:
        seen.add(target_id)
        if target_id in _OWNERS:
            return _OWNERS[target_id]
        target_id = _OPENERS.get(target_id, "")
    return None


_all_page_targets = SessionManager.get_all_page_targets


def _visible_page_targets(self) -> list:
    """What a session sees as "the browser's tabs": its own tab first, then popups its pages opened; never another
    agent's tab or popups. A tab nobody owns and no owned tab opened (the browser's first tab) is visible only to the
    browser's main tab, which claims it. browser-use derives its tab list, focus and new-tab reuse from this."""
    targets = _all_page_targets(self)
    tab = getattr(self.browser_session, "_tab", None)
    if tab is None:
        return targets
    mine = [t for t in targets if t.target_id == tab.target_id]
    rest = [t for t in targets if t.target_id != tab.target_id
            and (owner_of(t.target_id) is tab or (owner_of(t.target_id) is None and tab.main))]
    return mine + rest


SessionManager.get_all_page_targets = _visible_page_targets

_handle_target_attached = SessionManager._handle_target_attached


ISOLATE_TABS = os.environ.get("SWARM_ISOLATE_TABS", "1") != "0"


def _sees(tab: "Tab", target_id: str) -> bool:
    """Does the session working in `tab` see this page target? Same rule as _visible_page_targets."""
    owner = owner_of(target_id)
    return target_id == tab.target_id or owner is tab or (owner is None and tab.main)


async def _handle_target_attached_with_opener(self, event) -> None:
    """Record popup openers, and keep each agent's connection to its own pages. browser-use attaches every session to
    EVERY tab of the browser and enables Page, lifecycle and Network events on each: with 8 agents in one browser
    every navigation's events went to all 8 connections, and a navigation took 40 s instead of 0.4 s (local
    benchmark, 8 sessions on 16 tabs; the ERP browser in the sandbox ran 8 tabs). A foreign page is detached at
    once, before any domain is enabled; its frames then never attach either."""
    info = event.get("targetInfo") or {}
    if info.get("openerId"):
        _OPENERS[info["targetId"]] = info["openerId"]
    tab = getattr(self.browser_session, "_tab", None)
    if ISOLATE_TABS and tab is not None and info.get("type") == "page" and not _sees(tab, info.get("targetId", "")):
        root = self.browser_session._cdp_client_root
        if root is not None and event.get("sessionId"):
            try:
                await root.send.Target.detachFromTarget(params={"sessionId": event["sessionId"]})
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - the tab closed meanwhile
                log.debug("detach from a foreign tab failed: %s", error)
        return
    await _handle_target_attached(self, event)


SessionManager._handle_target_attached = _handle_target_attached_with_opener

_initialize_existing_targets = SessionManager._initialize_existing_targets


async def _initialize_own_targets(self) -> None:
    """At connect, attach only to the pages this session sees (browser-use attaches to all and then waits up to 2 s
    for every one of them to be ready: with foreign pages detached, each connect would wait the full 2 s)."""
    tab = getattr(self.browser_session, "_tab", None)
    if not ISOLATE_TABS or tab is None:
        return await _initialize_existing_targets(self)
    client = self.browser_session._cdp_client_root
    infos = (await client.send.Target.getTargets())["targetInfos"]
    for info in infos:
        if info.get("openerId"):
            _OPENERS[info["targetId"]] = info["openerId"]
    wanted = [t["targetId"] for t in infos if t.get("type") == "page" and _sees(tab, t["targetId"])]
    for target_id in wanted:
        try:
            await client.send.Target.attachToTarget(params={"targetId": target_id, "flatten": True})
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - closed meanwhile
            log.debug("attach to own tab failed: %s", error)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 8         # 8 agents connecting at once took up to 6 s
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        sessions = [self._get_session_for_target(t) for t in wanted]
        if all(s is not None and getattr(s, "_lifecycle_events", None) is not None for s in sessions):
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)


SessionManager._initialize_existing_targets = _initialize_own_targets

_enable_page_monitoring = SessionManager._enable_page_monitoring


async def _enable_page_monitoring_routed(self, cdp_session) -> None:
    """browser-use registers one lifecycle handler per page target, but the CDP client keeps only ONE handler per event
    (the last one), and that handler drops events of every other target. With several tabs in a browser, navigations
    in all but the last-attached tab then waited for load events that never came (3-8 s per navigation). Here one
    handler per client routes each event to the queue of its own target."""
    await _enable_page_monitoring(self, cdp_session)
    events = getattr(cdp_session, "_lifecycle_events", None)
    if events is None:
        return
    # A target usually has TWO sessions here (browser-use's explicit attach and Chrome's auto-attach), and navigation
    # waits on whichever one the session pool hands out (a set: random per tab). Routing the events to one session's
    # queue only made about half of all navigations wait their full readiness timeout (3-8 s, "Page readiness
    # timeout" in every sandbox log; local benchmark: 0.33 s vs 8.3 s for the same page). Every queue gets them.
    routes = self.__dict__.setdefault("_lifecycle_routes", {})
    queues = routes.setdefault(cdp_session.target_id, [])
    if not any(q is events for q in queues):
        queues.append(events)

    def route(event, session_id=None):
        target = self.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if session_id else None
        item = {"name": event.get("name", "unknown"), "loaderId": event.get("loaderId", "none"),
                "timestamp": asyncio.get_event_loop().time()}
        for queue in routes.get(target, ()):
            queue.append(item)

    cdp_session.cdp_client.register.Page.lifecycleEvent(route)


SessionManager._enable_page_monitoring = _enable_page_monitoring_routed


class RobustSession(BrowserSession):
    """A BrowserSession whose navigation recovers from a tab stuck while loading: stop the old load and retry once.
